description:
**Description**
 Are you ready to shape how millions of EU customers discover and engage with Prime — both on Amazon and across the digital landscape? EU Prime Marketing \& Incentives Tech is seeking a Software Development Engineer II to build scalable and robust systems at the intersection of generative AI, personalization, and large\-scale distributed architecture. You'll leverage GenAI and ML technologies to power Prime customer engagement across marketing channels — from social media platforms to emerging digital channels.
   

  

 This role offers the unique opportunity to start with EU\-scale challenges while building solutions for worldwide impact. You'll architect cloud\-native systems on AWS that drive how Prime reaches customers wherever they are, combining serverless, event\-driven, and microservices patterns with AI\-driven innovation. Bring your ownership mindset and passion for end\-to\-end delivery as you translate ML models into production systems that enhance customer experiences at massive scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implement scalable, cloud\-native distributed systems using serverless architectures, event\-driven patterns, and microservices on AWS to support EU Prime customer engagement across marketing channels
* Collaborate with data scientists and product teams to integrate GenAI/LLM technologies and ML pipelines into production systems that drive personalized customer experiences at scale
* Participate actively in the full software development lifecycle including code reviews, architecture reviews, testing, deployment, and operational excellence activities while mentoring team members on high\-quality engineering practices
* Drive technical decisions and design solutions for ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives that balance new feature development with system reliability, performance optimization, and maintainability
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving team operations, documentation, and processes to reduce single\-threaded dependencies and build team resilience


 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll design and ship features that leverage GenAI\-powered services and modern AWS architectures, collaborating closely with scientists to translate ML models into reliable production systems. Your day balances building innovative capabilities with maintaining operational excellence — participating in architecture and code reviews, using AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, and ensuring systems perform reliably at scale. You'll work across teams to shape technical direction while staying current with emerging technologies like GenAI and ML to solve real customer problems.
   

  

**About The Team**
 EU Prime Marketing \& Incentives Tech builds the technology powering Prime customer engagement across marketing channels. Our scope spans personalized onsite experiences to large\-scale marketing integrations — including social media platforms, YouTube, and emerging digital channels — driving Prime acquisition, retention, and engagement for millions of EU customers. We're a collaborative team that values deep technical ownership and continuous learning, embracing GenAI and modern engineering practices to solve complex challenges at the intersection of marketing technology, audience targeting, and multi\-channel content delivery. Every engineer has autonomy to shape how Prime reaches customers wherever they are — on Amazon and beyond.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
About Us

**Sciative Solutions** is an AI\-powered pricing technology company helping businesses optimize pricing decisions through intelligent automation. Our products serve industries including Travel, Retail, and Hospitality, enabling organizations to maximize revenue using data\-driven pricing strategies.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager who can build and execute marketing initiatives that strengthen our brand, generate qualified leads, and support business growth.

**Job Summary**

As a Marketing Manager, you will own the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Leadership to develop marketing strategies that improve brand visibility, generate demand, and drive customer engagement.

The ideal candidate combines creativity with analytical thinking and has experience managing multiple marketing channels while measuring campaign performance.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Plan, launch, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, email, and other relevant platforms.
* Generate qualified leads through inbound and outbound marketing initiatives.
* Manage the company's website, SEO, and content marketing strategy.
* Create and oversee marketing collateral including brochures, presentations, case studies, blogs, whitepapers, videos, and social media content.
* Plan webinars, industry events, product launches, and customer engagement campaigns.
* Collaborate with Sales to improve lead generation, nurturing, and conversion.
* Monitor campaign performance using marketing analytics and recommend improvements.
* Manage marketing budgets and optimize ROI across channels.
* Coordinate with designers, agencies, freelancers, and content creators when required.
* Maintain brand consistency across all communication channels.
* Conduct competitor analysis and identify market opportunities.
* Prepare regular reports on marketing KPIs and campaign effectiveness.

**Required Skills :**

* Strong understanding of Digital Marketing and Demand Generation
* SEO and SEM
* Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads
* Email Marketing Automation
* Content Marketing
* Social Media Strategy
* Marketing Analytics
* Google Analytics (GA4\)
* CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, or similar)
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Campaign planning and execution
* Budget management
* Project management

**Qualifications :**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* MBA in Marketing is preferred.
* 4–7 years of experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, technology, or digital marketing.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proven track record of successful marketing campaigns.

**Preferred Qualifications :**

* Experience in SaaS, AI, Travel Tech, Retail Tech, or Hospitality Technology.
* Familiarity with marketing automation platforms.
* Knowledge of performance marketing and lead attribution.
* Experience managing agencies and external vendors.
* Basic understanding of design tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

**Success Metrics :**

* Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)
* Cost per Lead (CPL)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Lead\-to\-Customer Conversion Rate
* Website Traffic Growth
* Organic Search Rankings
* Campaign ROI

**Email Engagement Metrics :**

* Social Media Growth
* Brand Awareness

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with cutting\-edge AI products solving real\-world business problems.
* Opportunity to build and scale the marketing function.
* Collaborative and fast\-paced work environment.
* High ownership and visibility with leadership.
* Continuous learning and professional growth opportunities.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

description:
**About the Role**
  

  

The Social team is responsible for telling Uber's story in an engaging, inspiring, humanizing and innovative way across global channels, and to a global audience. We develop creative programming ourselves, build relationships with key influencers and creators, and launch new products and partnerships in a Social\-first way.
  

  

As the Head of Social Media Manager for India and Sri Lanka, you will play a crucial role in developing and executing strategic social plans to evolve and elevate our social media presence for Uber in India and Sri Lanka.
  

  

You will work closely with cross\-functional partners to bring new products, partnerships (comms, marketing and policy), campaigns, owned programming and events to life on our channels. This role requires excellent written and verbal communication skills, iPhone shooting and editing skills, an eye for graphic design, thumb\-stopping content ideas, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

**What You'll Do**  

  

  

* **Set the Social Strategy** : Develop, execute and launch the channel strategies for Uber and Uber Eats across Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Manage day\-to\-day social media responsibilities for Uber India's consumer channel, earner's channel, and Uber Sri Lanka channel, which support both the mobility and delivery businesses.
* **Drive Cultural Relevance:** Identify trends, conversations, and opportunities where our brands can show up with POV, humor, speed, and creativity. Create culturally relevant, platform\-native ideas that tap into trends, moments, and consumer behavior in smart, strategic ways.
* **Create \& Lead Creators** : Shoot, edit, and create original content for new products, partnerships, and campaigns, as well as manage folks who will do the same. Ensure the work is cohesive, high\-quality, and consistently on brand.
* **Partner Internally \& Externally** : Collaborate with comms, marketing, policy, product, and external partners to align on messaging, visuals, and storytelling priorities.
* **Champion Experimentation** : take thoughtful risk\-taking, drive testing, and iteration to uncover new creative opportunities.

  

  

**Basic Qualifications**  

  

  

* 8\+ years of social\-first creative roles at brands, agencies, or media companies.
* Bachelor's degree
* A deep understanding of major social platforms (Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube) and their respective audiences, features, and best practices.
* Proven track record building and scaling social channels with highly engaging, culturally relevant content.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience managing creators, influencers, contributors, or creative teams.  
* 

  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

  

* 10\+ years of social\-first creative roles at brands, agencies, or media companies.
* A passion for food, pop culture, entertainment, creators, and internet trends.
* Understands the importance of activating policy\-driven social in India
* Strong creative instincts and ability to concept platform\-native ideas that ladder up to brand goals.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-visibility environment that requires both strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.
* A go\-getter who looks forward to rolling up their sleeves, building things from the bottom up, and excels in a fast\-paced environment.
* A creative strategist who can spot a trend from a mile away and leverages data\-driven insights to craft impactful, relevant content that aligns with Uber's business goals.
* A team player who enjoys working closely with cross functional stakeholders and stays calm under pressure. Success at Uber depends on the ability to partner internally and externally, and organize around shared goals.
* Communications, editorial planning, and graphic design / video editing experience.
* Influencer, creator and talent management experience.
BrandWatch, Dash Social, and Sprinklr experience.  
* 

  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

**Location:** In\-office  
**Type:** Internship (Full\-time)  
**Duration:** 03 \-06 months  
**Please note candidate must have his/her own laptop.**

**About Martech Simplified:**  
Martech Simplified is a dynamic digital marketing consulting agency that specializes in B2B marketing strategies. We help businesses scale by designing data\-driven marketing campaigns, optimizing their online presence, and enhancing customer engagement. If you're passionate about digital marketing and want hands\-on experience working with a diverse range of clients, we want to hear from you!

**Role Overview:**  
We are looking for a creative and driven Digital Marketing Intern to join our team. This role is perfect for students or recent graduates who are eager to develop their skills in digital marketing, learn from industry experts, and contribute to impactful campaigns. You’ll work directly with our team to assist in planning and executing strategies across various digital channels.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in planning, executing, and monitoring digital marketing campaigns (SEO, SEM, PPC, email marketing, social media, etc.).
* Create and curate content for social media platforms, including Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities.
* Support the team in analyzing performance metrics and preparing campaign reports.
* Help with keyword research and optimization for SEO and paid ads.
* Assist with email marketing campaigns and automation workflows.
* Stay up\-to\-date with digital marketing trends and best practices.

**Requirements:**

* Strong interest in digital marketing, with a basic understanding of SEO, social media marketing, and content marketing.
* Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads, and social media management platforms is a plus.
* Excellent communication and writing skills.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment.
* Creative mindset and eagerness to contribute fresh ideas.
* Self\-motivated with a willingness to learn and take initiative.

**What You'll Gain:**

* Hands\-on experience with real\-world digital marketing campaigns.
* Mentorship from experienced marketers and business professionals.
* Exposure to a wide range of B2B clients and industries.
* Flexible work hours with the opportunity to work with a team.
* Potential for full\-time employment after the internship based on performance.

**How to Apply:**  
Send your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your interest in digital marketing and why you’d be a great fit for Martech Simplified to **anukamna.sonkar@martechsimplified.com**.

Join us and be part of a growing team where your ideas and creativity can make a real impact!

description:
**JLL Supports The Whole You, Personally And Professionally.**
 Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you've got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you're looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

**What this job involves:**
 Are you the person who sees a business problem and instinctively starts looking for a data\-driven solution? This role is for a proactive owner and strategic thinker who is motivated not just by analyzing data, but by transforming it into measurable business impact. You will be empowered to audit our existing analytics portfolio, drive enhancements through automation and AI, and partner with business leaders to turn ambiguous challenges into clear, actionable insights.
   

  

 As a key member of JLL Business Services (JBS), you will help shape the organization's journey toward data\-driven operations. This role goes beyond traditional reporting, combining business acumen, analytical depth, and solution ownership to influence how decisions are made across the organization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, analytical depth, AI fluency, stakeholder influence, and hands\-on technical capability to independently drive high\-impact analytics initiatives from concept through adoption.
   

  

**Job Title: Manager, Operational Intelligence**
**Key Responsibilities**
**End\-to\-End Solution Ownership:** 
 Operate as an autonomous analytics partner to business stakeholders, translating high\-level objectives into tangible roadmaps. Take full ownership of the solution lifecycle from strategic requirements gathering and logical data modeling to driving project implementation, stakeholder collaboration, and user adoption.
   

  

**Advanced Solution Development:** 
 Design and develop robust, scalable analytics solutions that provide actionable, prescriptive insights. This includes hands\-on ownership of the technical build: from designing data models and writing advanced SQL to creating compelling, executive\-level dashboards and data narratives in Power BI or Tableau.
   

  

**Portfolio Optimization and Enhancement:** 
 Proactively audit and own the team's existing portfolio of analytics solutions. Identify and execute opportunities for enhancement through workflow automation (e.g., Power Automate), refined analytical methodologies, improved user experience, and the strategic application of AI tools to increase efficiency and impact.
   

  

**Innovation and AI Advocacy:** 
 Champion the practical use of AI as a strategic lever for problem\-solving. Act as a thought partner by proactively experimenting with and recommending how modern tools (JLLGPT, Claude, AI\-enabled BI features) can be applied to accelerate analysis, generate deeper insights, and solve complex business challenges.
   

  

**Leadership \& Mentorship** 
 : Provide technical leadership and project guidance to 1\-2 analysts through a matrix reporting structure. Guide their work assignments and ensure delivery excellence. Administrative management responsibilities remain with their functional reporting line.
   

  

**Required Experience And Skills**
* 10\-13 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or related data\-focused roles, with a demonstrated track record of turning ambiguous business problems into practical, adopted solutions.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data insights to operational, financial, and strategic business outcomes.
* Proactive, curious, and comfortable challenging existing assumptions constructively to improve business performance and decision\-making.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior leaders and translating analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Comfortably operating with a high degree of autonomy, managing multiple priorities, and navigating evolving business requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau, with the ability to independently build intuitive, high\-impact analytics products.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing scalable data models for analytics. Adept at translating complex business requirements into logical data structures. Hands\-on proficiency with advanced analytical SQL for data exploration and validation is essential. Experience working with enterprise data platforms like Snowflake or Databricks is highly preferred.
* A strong interest in and aptitude for leveraging AI and AI\-enabled analytics tools to accelerate analysis and support strategic thinking, coupled with strong critical thinking and business judgment.
* Experience with modern workflow automation tools including Power Automate, API integration, SharePoint, or M365 integration is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts in a clear, business\-relevant manner. Skilled at storytelling with data and presenting to executive audiences.
* Experience working in global organizations and across cross\-functional or multicultural teams is preferred.
* Estimated compensation for this position offer will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, internal equity and alignment with market data.


**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Hybrid with at least 2\-3 days working in office.)
   

  

**Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:**
 JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
   

  

**About JLL:**
 We're JLL, a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That's why we're committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We're using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
   

  

 Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we're honoured to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
   

  

 Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we're headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation, and succeed together.

Established in 2004,
 
**OLIVER**

 is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in\-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. **Role:**

 APAC Consumer Apps, Product Marketing Specialist
 

  
 




**Location:**

 Bengaluru, India
 

  
 




**Work timings:**

  7:00am to 4:00pm
 

  
 







  
 




**About the role:**

  
 





 As a Product Marketing Specialist, you'll lead product launch marketing for our Technology client, ensuring go\-to\-market success. You'll define the product's voice and build a loyal following, collaborating with a wide range of teams.
 
  
   

  
   


 On the regional team, you'll coordinate product launch roadmap and related processes, and execute multi\-channel strategies to drive visibility of launches with our key audiences. Your expertise in crafting a compelling GTM strategy and impactful content will be critical. You'll identify the most effective channels and drive integrated marketing efforts to fuel product growth and success.
 

  
 







  
 




**What you will be doing:**

  
 



* Own the end\-to\-end launch process, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to understand product roadmap and launch strategy for APAC markets.
* Directs the end\-to\-end execution of regional Go\-To\-Market (GTM) creative strategies. This involves synchronizing product launch GTM across diverse markets including India, Japan, Korea, and SE Asia to ensure a unified brand voice. Oversees the creation of storyboards and static/video assets for product launches and social campaigns
* Establish efficient GTM operations to enable rapid product launches, while navigating a complex matrix of internal stakeholders (Regional Marketing, Legal, Product) and external partners.
* Manage launch timelines, track progress, and coordinate with country and cross\-functional teams to ensure successful execution.
* Conduct and coordinate rigorous pre\-launch scaled testing and channel feedback to product and engineering teams.
* Contribute to content creation for targeted outreach initiatives, driving product usage and awareness in alignment with regional goals.



  
 



**What you need to be great in this role:**

  
 



* Passionate about AI, with strong understanding of industry trends, Google’s and competitors’ products and position in the industry
* Ability to manage ambiguity and constant change
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent project management skills
* Strong communication skills, ability to create clarity amidst uncertainty and provide detailed, clear instructions to local teams and agencies
* Proven track record of success in delivering projects on time and within budget
* Knowledge of localization and translation processes
* Experience with go\-to\-market planning and execution
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Passion for and inquisitive about AI and new technologies
* Understanding and knowledge of AI tools is beneficial, but ability to learn and digest benefits and features of AI tools is critical.

description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Principal Enterprise Solutions Architect – Marketing is a critical role within CyberEA (Cyber and Enterprise Architecture) group of General Mill’s D\&T (Digital and Technology) organization who interfaces across business and technology stakeholders. The Enterprise Solution Architect will understand business needs, assess the current state and design the target state solution that meets business needs while driving clarity, enabling enterprise agility, and mitigating risk.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide leadership and accountability for technology decisions across all segments/business units.
* Design and architect end\-to\-end MarTech solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing systems and platforms.
* Define architectural patterns, standards, and guidelines for the MarTech domain.
* Evaluate and recommend MarTech technologies and platforms based on business requirements, technical feasibility, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Create and maintain architectural artifacts, including solution blueprints, diagrams, and documentation.
* Visibility into all projects impacting the Marketing domain and platforms.
* Ensure technical components of our top initiatives are on track.
* Contribute to Tech solutions catalog, Tech Selection and Tech Intake process.
* Provide inputs to RFI/RFP \- technical criteria, weightage, evaluating vendors.
* Match solutions with the requirements of stakeholders and enterprise principles, policies, and standards.
* Ensure solution compliance with non\-functional requirements (Security, Platform, Integration, Data, Operations, etc.)
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including marketing, engineering and vendor/partner teams, to ensure alignment on architectural direction and solution delivery.
* Communicate architectural decisions and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Facilitate architectural reviews and governance processes to ensure compliance with standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with other Enterprise and Solution Architects to create Technology Reference Models, Reference Architecture; conduct market scans, Architecture PoV (Point of View) based on industry research and implement PoC (Proof of concepts) solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams.
* Stay abreast of the latest MarTech technologies and trends, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies and approaches to improve marketing effectiveness and efficiency.
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of MarTech solutions, and identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree required; Computer Science, MIS, or Engineering preferred.
* 8\+ years of IT experience
* 3\+ years of leading complex IT projects through solutioning, designing, and architecture.
* 5\+ years of experience in architecting and strategizing the digital marketing technology solutions in the areas of MarTech (e.g. CMS, DAM, MRM, CDP, Marketing Automation), AdTech (DSP, DMP) and adjacent digital technologies.
* In\-depth knowledge and experience in the MarTech domain with expertise in CMS, DAM, MRM, Social Relationship Management, Collaboration Work Management, Personalization Engines and Campaign Management technologies.
* Deep understanding of consumer data (1st, 2nd and 3rd party data and consent management) and how it relates to enable marketing use cases – personalization, targeting, consumer analytics, insights.
* Experience in architecture and design of marketing, advertising and marketing data/analytics platforms from big MarTech vendors (e.g. Adobe, Salesforce, Google) as well as niche players (e.g. Sprout Social etc.).
* Understanding of marketing \& advertising platform ecosystems and interplay of MarTech/AdTech components with the broader enterprise ecosystem (e.g. Sales and Service Tech stack, Datalake).
* Hands\-on experience designing and deploying enterprise solutions to the public cloud and/or SaaS.Experience with reporting systems like Tableau or Looker.
* Broad understanding of integration concepts and experience with MuleSoft or similar integration technologies.
* Broad understanding of Cloud Computing concepts, processes \& tools required for cloud adoption including cloud security, governance, integration, and performance.
* Strong relationship management and leadership skills.
* Experience with vetting packaged solutions against business/technical requirements.
* Proficiency in architecture diagraming tools (LucidChart, Visio, etc.).
* Experience with content generation and content automation tools using GenAI is a plus.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Software Development experience
* Experience with agile techniques and methods
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD and Cyber Security
* Experience with Data \& Analytics concepts and tools
* Experience with modern Software Engineering principles
* Experience at CPG companies

 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:
**Company Description**  

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.


For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description** **Job Summary**  

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
* You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product\-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area\-level, product\-level, and overall sales targets.
* You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
* You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
* You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential \& preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.
 **Qualifications** **Educational qualification\-** Graduate with science background.  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  

  

**Skills \& attributes**  

**Technical Skills**  

* Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.


  

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.
 **Additional Information** **About the Department**  

**Global Generics India**  

Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  

  

**Benefits Offered**  

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  

  

**Our Work Culture**  

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  

For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/\#!/**

description:
**Job Description**
 As an Analyst within the Global Technology Controllers in Corporate Sector Controllers, you will be responsible for providing controllership support to the technology function, including accounting for technology in accordance with US GAAP and JPMC standards.
   

  

 Global Technology Controller provide controllership support to technology function in to Hardware, Software, Professional services and other direct expense lines. Team is also responsible for capitalization of tangible or intangible assets.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Determine expense versus capitalization treatment, ensure timely disposal recognition, and post close entries with appropriate support and approvals.
* Partner with Technology, P\&A, Business Management, and Procurement to align on project scope, in\-service dates, and cutover timing, and maintain SOX\-compliant controls and audit\-ready evidence.
* Perform ongoing review of work\-in\-process ledger balances, including aging analysis, root\-cause identification, and timely clearing to fixed assets or expense when criteria are met.
* Reconcile WIP balances to upstream project and procurement systems and validate against purchase orders, capitalization requests, and approvals.
* Capitalize qualifying assets by evaluating projects against thresholds and criteria and determining start/stop capitalization dates, place\-in\-service dates, useful lives, and residual values.
* Validate operational impacts and future benefit assumptions with Technology and business stakeholders and record entries accurately and timely in the general ledger.
* Ensure balance sheet positions are appropriately supported to maintain a strong fortress balance sheet.
* Document analytics through estimates, walk\-forwards, controller financial reviews, and flash reports.
* Analyze, communicate, and resolve material variances between the general ledger and upstream systems, as defined by the line of business.


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* 3 years of related experience
* General Ledger experience
* Experience with financial reporting and month end close responsibilities
* Comfortable liaising with business and risk managers
* Able to build and maintain partnerships within the various product aligned businesses and across other corporate financial, treasury, and accounting groups
* Able to understand business drivers and requirements and influence middle and front office partners to deliver solutions to business issues and problems
* Strong analytical skills: Ability to quickly understand workings of a complex processing system and general ledger systems across the infrastructure and their interrelationships and dependencies
* Excellent desktop/spreadsheet/database skills
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Able to multi\-task in a constantly changing environment
* Able to critically challenge with the goal of identifying control issues


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Existing relationships and networks within the firm's IB community an advantage
* Shift Timing: Mid\-day shift 1pm to 10pm

You will be a valued member of the IOA team and work collaboratively with IOA business leaders, global corporate marketing and communications teams, sales, solutioning, delivery, client\-facing teams, analysts, agencies, and regional stakeholders.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end IOA messaging and positioning strategy, including differentiated AI, automation, and agentic AI narratives for clients, analysts, employees, and internal stakeholders.
* Drive an always\-on, multi\-channel marketing presence across the IOA website, social media, practice decks, campaigns, events, digital platforms, and sales enablement assets.
* Build a robust case study and proof\-point library by partnering with delivery teams, client partners, and service line specialists to translate client impact into compelling market\-facing stories.
* Partner with sales and solutioning teams on strategic pursuits by developing bespoke narratives, tailored presentations, credentials decks, competitive battlecards, capability briefs, and RFP content.
* Lead IOA’s annual marketing strategy, roadmap, performance rhythm, analyst recognition communications, regional marketing support, executive communications, and people communications.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen).


**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in marketing and/or communications, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Deep understanding of technology, particularly AI, automation, and digital transformation in the BPS, IT services, or professional services industry.
* Proven track record of building and leading integrated marketing and communications functions within a global services or technology organization.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with strong storytelling capability for C\-suite audiences, employees, clients, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong executive presence and stakeholder influence, with the ability to counsel senior leaders and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed global environment.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing, cross\-functional teams while managing multiple priorities with strong project management discipline.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, \& Leading the Business.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, \& Own It.


**These will help you succeed**
* Experience in the BPS industry, especially within AI\-powered operations, business process automation, or digital transformation services.
* Experience working with analyst firms such as Everest, HFS, Gartner, or IDC to support market visibility and recognition initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable editorial workflows, case study engines, reusable sales enablement assets, and thought leadership programs.
* Experience adapting global marketing strategies for regional markets while maintaining brand consistency and local relevance.
* Ability to work with creative, digital, design, and agency partners to produce high\-quality visuals, multimedia, video, interactive content, and digital experiences.


**Work model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3\-4 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations

 We are India's leading political consulting organisation, dedicated to providing high\-quality professional support for political campaigns. We strongly believe that the nation will best benefit from an enlightened political leadership in the form of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and are proud to have previously contributed in a similar capacity in the momentous election campaigns of 2014, 2019 and 2024, as well as various state elections.
 



  





 Our work includes envisioning and executing innovative electioneering campaigns, facilitating the capacity building of grassroots cadre, and shaping governance. We add professional aspects to the strengths of the scores of grassroots workers supporting the Prime Minister and ensure optimal electoral results, not as an end in itself, but to add to the Prime Minister's vision for a developed India. Our work leverages on\-ground activities, data analytics, research, and new\-age media as force multipliers for the Prime Minister's messages and actions.
 



  





 We comprise a diverse group of dedicated individuals\-including former management consultants, lawyers, engineers, political theorists, public policy professionals, and experts from other varied sectors, all hailing from premier institutes and corporates\-with the unified objective of meaningfully contributing to the nation's polity.
 



  





 Nation with Namo is looking for a Marketing Manager who is able to manage multiple advertising work streams and is dynamic, enthusiastic and keen\-eyed enough to go beyond the obvious, draw complex insights and provide actionable to the team and the client.

* Creating and maintaining relationships with clients, advertising partners, influencers and publishers

* Open\-minded, curious, and a strong problem\-solver

Founded in 2019, Gumlet helps businesses automatically process, optimize, and deliver high\-performance media across web and mobile apps \- without complex developer workflows. Trusted by 10,000\+ customers, including BookmyShow, Tata 1mg, TV9 Network, Spinny, Snapdeal, Ethos Watches, PocketFM, and other high\-scale digital brands, Gumlet powers the delivery of 4\+ billion media files every day. Serving industries such as E\-commerce, EdTech, OTT, Travel, Consumer Apps, and News Media. description:
**About Us:**




  





 We are India's leading political consulting organisation, dedicated to providing high\-quality professional support for political campaigns. We strongly believe that the nation will best benefit from an enlightened political leadership in the form of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and are proud to have previously contributed in a similar capacity in the momentous election campaigns of 2014, 2019 and 2024, as well as various state elections.
 



  





 Our work includes envisioning and executing innovative electioneering campaigns, facilitating the capacity building of grassroots cadre, and shaping governance. We add professional aspects to the strengths of the scores of grassroots workers supporting the Prime Minister and ensure optimal electoral results, not as an end in itself, but to add to the Prime Minister's vision for a developed India. Our work leverages on\-ground activities, data analytics, research, and new\-age media as force multipliers for the Prime Minister's messages and actions.
 



  





 We comprise a diverse group of dedicated individuals\-including former management consultants, lawyers, engineers, political theorists, public policy professionals, and experts from other varied sectors, all hailing from premier institutes and corporates\-with the unified objective of meaningfully contributing to the nation's polity.
 



  





**Join us in building high\-impact digital campaigns that engage millions of citizens through regional creator networks, data\-driven outreach, and compelling public narratives.** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a dynamic Influencer Marketing Associate with 2–4 years of experience to build, manage, and scale creator partnerships that drive public engagement, narrative amplification, and campaign outreach. If you have a passion for creator ecosystems, regional content networks, digital mobilisation, and data\-driven campaign execution, we want you on our team!
 



  





**Eligibility** 



* MBA in Marketing, Communications, Media, Public Relations, Political Communication, or a related field from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 2–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, political communication, digital campaigns, or social media management.
* Strong understanding of the Indian creator ecosystem across Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, and emerging regional platforms.
* Experience in managing regional influencers, community pages, youth creators, or public affairs campaigns.
* Exposure to election campaigns, advocacy initiatives, social impact organisations, or fast\-paced startup environments is a plus.



  





**Skills:\-** 




  





**Influencer Strategy \& Network Building** 




 Ability to identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage creators across multiple geographies, languages, and audience segments
 



**Campaign Execution \& Relationship Management** 




 Experience in negotiating collaborations, briefing influencers, coordinating approvals, managing publishing schedules, and ensuring timely campaign delivery
 



**Narrative Monitoring \& Social Listening** 




 Strong understanding of online conversations, sentiment tracking, trend identification, and rapid\-response coordination across digital platforms.
 



**Performance Analytics \& Optimisation** 




 Ability to analyse reach, engagement, impressions, CPV, CPM, CTR, and audience response metrics to improve campaign effectiveness.
 



**Cross\-Team Collaboration** 




 Work closely with content, research, design, communications, and field teams to ensure consistent messaging and coordinated campaign execution.
 



**Presentation \& Report\-Making** 




 Strong skills in preparing campaign reports, influencer performance evaluations, trend analyses, and stakeholder presentations.
 



  





**Job Description** 



* Influencer Discovery \& Management: Build and maintain a robust database of creators, meme pages, regional influencers, youth communities, and digital opinion leaders segmented by geography, language, category, and audience profile.
* Campaign Planning \& Execution: Plan and execute influencer\-led outreach campaigns, coordinating creator onboarding, negotiations, content approvals, publishing timelines, and post\-campaign follow\-ups.
* Narrative Amplification: Support the dissemination of campaign messages through relevant creator networks, ensuring alignment with communication objectives and audience targeting strategies.
* Social Listening \& Trend Tracking: Monitor emerging conversations, viral trends, sentiment shifts, and competitor activity to identify opportunities for proactive engagement and rapid\-response communication.
* Performance Monitoring \& Reporting: Track campaign performance using platform analytics, Meta Insights, X analytics, YouTube analytics, and reporting dashboards. Prepare actionable post\-campaign analyses with recommendations for optimisation.
* Content Coordination: Collaborate with creative and communications teams to develop influencer briefs, messaging frameworks, and content guidelines while ensuring consistency across platforms.
* Project Management: Manage multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously, ensuring timely execution, budget adherence, stakeholder coordination, and achievement of outreach targets.
* Flexibility: Be able to adapt to meet our dynamic campaign and communication needs that may change or evolve over time.



  





 Note\- This is a contractual job till June,2027\.

 Strong preference for candidates with hands\-on performance marketing experience in Jewellery, Fashion, D2C, or E\-Commerce. Candidates from outside this domain may be considered only with a clearly demonstrated track record of scaling D2C\-style funnels. 
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 Cao Jewellery is a handcrafted statement jewellery brand on a mission to change the way the world experiences jewellery. We believe that beautifully crafted, meaningful pieces shouldn't be reserved for the few, they should be within reach of every person who desires them. We're looking for a highly driven, data\-oriented Performance Marketing Executive to scale our digital growth across paid channels. You'll own customer acquisition, funnel optimization, and ROAS scaling across Meta, Google, and other platforms — turning ad spend into a predictable revenue engine. 
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), other platforms.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance marketing funnel — Awareness → Consideration → Conversion— and the metrics at every stage.
 



 Drive customer acquisition and revenue growth while holding the line on target ROAS and CPA.
 



 Analyze campaign performance daily, spot trends early, and scale winning audiences, creatives, and placements.
 



 Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and ad copy — and turn learnings into the next round.
 



 Partner closely with creative, content, and brand teams to brief and ship high\-converting ad assets, including UGC and influencer\-led creatives.
 



 Track and report key metrics — CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, LTV — in clean, decision\-ready dashboards.
 



 Optimize landing pages and conversion funnels in collaboration with the website/Shopify team for better CVR.
 



 Plan and allocate monthly budgets across platforms, channels, and campaigns to maximize blended ROAS.
 



 Stay ahead of platform updates, algorithm shifts, and competitor strategies — and translate them into our roadmap.
 



  





 REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS
 



  




1. 3\+ years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, preferably in jewellery, fashion, or D2C e\-commerce.
2. Proven track record of scaling paid campaigns with strong, sustained ROI / ROAS.
3. Hands\-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), and other platforms.
4. Sharp analytical skills and a data\-driven mindset — you make decisions with numbers, not gut alone.
5. Working knowledge of tracking tools — Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, and UTM tracking.
6. Solid understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and funnel diagnostics.
7. Experience managing high ad spends with consistent, predictable performance.
8. Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage stakeholders across creative, brand, and leadership teams.



  





 YOU'LL STAND OUT IF YOU HAVE
 



  




1. Experience running performance marketing for a Shopify or similar D2C e\-commerce stack.
2. A strong point of view on influencer / UGC\-driven performance creatives — what works, what doesn't, and why.
3. Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and Microsoft Clarity.
4. A bias for action, ownership mentality, and hunger to grow a brand from the inside.



  





 WHY JOIN US
 



  




1. Chance to work with a growing premium fashion brand.
2. Opportunity to scale Ad spends and Brand Visibility.

description:
**What We Do** 




 FlytBase builds the world's leading drone autonomy software, powering operations for 300\+ customers in 40\+ countries—including Fortune 500 companies like Xcel Energy, Airbus, and Anglo American. Check out some of our critical deployments here.
 



  





 Headquartered in California with a fast\-moving engineering base in Pune, FlytBase is powering the shift from human\-operated to self\-driven skies. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team works in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI isn't a side project, it's the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As Product Marketing Manager at FlytBase, you'll be the bridge between what we build and how the market understands it. You'll own positioning and messaging across verticals—translating deep technical capabilities into language that resonates with enterprise buyers in energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure. You'll arm sales with materials that actually get used, turn customer wins into compelling proof points, and ensure every product launch lands with clarity and impact.
 



  





 This role lives in the messy middle between product, sales, and the market. You'll spend as much time talking to customers and prospects as you do with internal teams. You'll need to understand the technical details well enough to distill them into buyer language—which is why a background in drones, robotics, or a related technical field will help you ramp fast and earn credibility quickly.
 



  





 The right person for this role has sharp marketing instincts, genuine curiosity about the product, and the ability to context\-switch between a product spec doc and a sales call without missing a beat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 • Positioning and messaging—sharpening how FlytBase talks about itself across verticals, personas, and use cases. You'll define the narrative, not just document it.
 



 • Sales enablement—battlecards, pitch decks, one\-pagers, objection handling guides, and competitive comparisons. The stuff sales actually pulls up before a call.
 



 • Product launches—working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing to ensure new features and releases land with the right story, materials, and market awareness.
 



 • Competitive intelligence—tracking the landscape, understanding alternatives, and keeping sales and leadership informed on how we win (and where we're vulnerable).
 



 • Customer evidence—building a library of case studies, testimonials, and reference customers that make the value tangible.
 



 • Buyer and market research—understanding what enterprise buyers care about, how they evaluate solutions, and what's blocking deals.
 



 • Partner marketing—working with 50\+ integration partners to ensure co\-marketing efforts are consistent, accurate, and compelling.
 



  





**Best Suited For** 




 • 2\-4 years in product marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise tech, or technical products.
 



 • Drone, robotics, or electronics background strongly preferred. If you've worked in or around hardware, autonomous systems, or industrial tech, you'll hit the ground running.
 



 • At minimum, a technical background that lets you read a product spec, understand an integration, and translate it for a non\-technical buyer.
 



 • Experience working closely with sales—you understand deal cycles, objections, and what reps actually need to close.
 



 • Strong messaging instincts—you can take a complex technical differentiator and turn it into a sentence a buyer remembers.
 



 • Customer\-facing comfort—you'd rather be on a call with a customer or prospect than in an internal planning meeting.
 



 • Experience with AI tools for research, writing, and presentation creation is expected. You use them to move faster, not as a crutch.
 



  





**What Makes You a Flyter** 




 • Customer obsession: You learn more from one customer call than from a week of internal meetings. You're always looking for excuses to talk to the market.
 



 • Sales partner, not sales support: You work with sales, not for them. You'll push back on bad messaging requests and propose better alternatives.
 



 • Clarity as craft: You believe good positioning is a competitive advantage. You sweat the words because you know a single sentence can change a deal.
 



 • Technical credibility: You can sit in a product review and follow along. Engineers and PMs respect your input because you've done the homework.
 



 • Launch discipline: You don't just announce features—you ensure the market understands why they matter and sales knows how to sell them.
 



 • Competitive awareness: You always know what the other players are saying and how we stack up. Not out of anxiety—out of clarity.
 



  





**What We Don't Want** 




 • Marketers who treat sales enablement as a chore rather than a lever for revenue.
 



 • People who create decks and documents that sit in a folder and never get used.
 



 • PMMs who avoid direct customer contact and rely only on secondhand insights.
 



 • Anyone who needs a technical co\-pilot to understand what we're building. You should be able to get 80% of the way there yourself.
 



 • Folks who wait for product to hand them messaging instead of proposing it themselves.
 



 • "Process people" who need perfect inputs before they can create outputs. If you can't handle ambiguity, this isn't the place.
 



  





**Why FlytBase?** 




 • H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
 



 • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
 



 • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
 



 • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
 



 • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
 



  





**The Perks** 




 • High agency team and sense of purpose
 



 • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet)
 



 • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events
 



 • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
 



 • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster
 



 • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most
 



 • Top\-tier health coverage for you
 



 • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)

**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a Distribution Manager to set up and scale Atica’s distribution vertical from scratch. This is a high\-ownership role where you will design processes, build relationships with demand partners, manage a small team, and directly influence Atica’s growth in the US hospitality market.
 



 The right candidate is proactive, entrepreneurial, and has high agency and urgency. They must also bring strong communication skills to engage confidently with senior US hotel stakeholders and demand partners, and ideally have email marketing expertise to strengthen Atica’s outreach and campaign execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Vertical Setup \& Strategy** 



* Build the Distribution vertical from the ground up, establishing SOPs, systems, and best practices.
* Identify, evaluate, and segment demand partners (OTAs, RFP platforms, distribution channels) into Tier 1 / Tier 2 / niche categories.
* Establish virtual connects with demand partners to explore opportunities, negotiate priorities, and align on hotel\-specific fit.
* Document and store all partner evaluations, insights, and performance data in a structured way for future decision\-making and scale.



  





**Distribution, Campaign Execution \& Partner Communication** 



* Own end\-to\-end execution of distribution campaigns while actively engaging with partners to drive visibility, performance, and revenue growth.
* Manage hotel listings, offers, campaigns, and updates across distribution platforms, and direct distribution channels.
* Work closely with distribution partners (e.g., Hotelbeds, WebBeds, etc.) to ensure campaigns are live, visible, and prioritized within their platforms.
* Use email marketing tools (e.g., Lemlist, LSQ) and direct partner communication to improve campaign reach, activation, and performance.
* Drive partner alignment on promotions, placements, and demand opportunities to maximize campaign impact.
* Track campaign and partner performance, identifying gaps in visibility, conversion, or contribution, and take corrective actions.
* Proactively communicate with partners to resolve issues, push for better outcomes, and ensure Atica hotels are not deprioritized.
* Demonstrate clear, structured, and assertive communication—able to follow up rigorously, push back when required, and influence partner\-side decisions.
* Maximize partner penetration and revenue contribution across all active distribution channels.



  





**Visibility \& Reporting** 



* Build dashboards and trackers for hotels and revenue teams.
* Maintain full clarity on campaign execution, rates, and content.



  





**Process \& Optimization** 



* Standardize workflows and continuously improve systems for efficiency.
* Identify scalable solutions for recurring distribution challenges.



  





**Leadership \& Team Enablement** 



* Train, mentor, and monitor associates to ensure flawless day\-to\-day execution.
* Foster a culture of ownership, urgency, and quality delivery.



  





**Cross\-Functional Alignment** 



* Collaborate with Sales and Revenue teams to align on hotel objectives.
* Liaise directly with US hotel stakeholders (DOS, RMs) for smooth execution.



**Work closely with Product \& Tech teams:** 



* Report and track bugs affecting distribution workflows.
* Raise feature requests for new processes and enhancements.
* Continuously optimize internal tools for accuracy and speed.



  





**Quality \& Compliance** 



* Audit content, pricing, and offers for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain SLA adherence and partner agreements.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* % of hotels live on campaigns within SLA.
* Accuracy of rates, data, and content.
* Revenue contribution from distribution activities.
* Strength and quality (Escalation handling and solutioning) of the demand partner ecosystem.
* Associate performance and delivery quality.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2–6 years of relevant experience in hotel distribution, sales (KNR/Global Sales), or related commercial roles in hospitality.
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills—clear, structured, and assertive; able to manage partner conversations, push back when required, and influence outcomes in a commercial context.
* Deep understanding of distribution channels including OTAs, RFP platforms, GDS, and direct booking ecosystems.
* Proven process\-builder with the ability to design workflows, implement SOPs, and optimize for scale.
* Outstanding communication skills—able to confidently engage with senior US stakeholders and demand partners.
* Email marketing expertise (e.g., Lemlist, LSQ, or similar tools) to strengthen partner outreach and campaign execution.
* Strong relationship management: skilled at building and maintaining demand partner and hotel stakeholder connections.
* People leadership exposure with experience mentoring or managing associates (preferred).
* High agency and urgency, thriving in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial startup environment.
* Willingness to work US night shifts.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build a vertical from scratch—not just manage one.
* Competitive salary \+ performance\-linked bonus.
* CTC aligned with experience \& market benchmarks.
* Direct exposure to demand partners, US hotel stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Clear career growth path in Distribution \& Operations leadership.

Pickle Designs is a boutique branding and digital marketing agency based in Ahmedabad. We partner with brands across real estate, hospitality, manufacturing, FMCG and events to create memorable brand experiences through strategy, design, social media and performance marketing. As a boutique agency, we work collaboratively with every client, combining creativity, thoughtful execution and measurable results.
 



  





**SALARY** 




 ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month, depending on experience.
 



  





**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 



 1\. Performance Marketing
 * Plan, launch and optimise Meta \& Google Ads campaigns.
* Drive lead generation while maintaining cost efficiency.
* Monitor performance and conduct A/B testing.


 2\. Social Media Strategy
 * Develop monthly growth strategies for assigned clients.
* Define content pillars aligned with business goals.
* Recommend campaigns, trends and platform opportunities.


 3\. Creative Strategy
 * Create briefs for ad campaigns.
* Guide hooks, messaging, CTAs and creative direction.
* Recommend improvements based on performance data.


 4\. Analytics \& Optimisation
 * Track key metrics including CPL, CPC, CTR, CPM, conversions and ROAS.
* Turn data into actionable recommendations.


 5\. Reporting
 * Prepare weekly performance updates and monthly reports.
* Share insights and recommend next steps.


 6\. Research \& Innovation
 * Stay updated on platform changes, trends and best practices.
* Explore new campaign strategies, tools and features.


 7\. Collaboration
 * Coordinate with Account Managers to understand client goals.
* Work closely with the creative team on campaign execution.
* Maintain clear communication on progress and timelines.



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 You will be successful in this role if you can:
 


* Deliver high\-quality leads while maintaining efficient CPL.
* Consistently grow followers and engagement across client accounts.
* Think beyond ad execution by contributing strategic marketing ideas.
* Work collaboratively with the creative team to improve campaign performance.
* Independently manage multiple client accounts with minimal supervision.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign results and help clients achieve their business objectives.

 Core Responsibilities (Primary Scope)
 



***Paid Media Strategy \& Execution***



* Own and optimize campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen), LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, and programmatic/DSP platforms (The Trade Desk, DV360\)
* Manage real budget ownership with full accountability for CAC, ROAS, and pipeline contribution, not just CTR/CPC

-

* Own GA4 instrumentation and reporting; build dashboards in Looker Studio or Power BI for real\-time performance visibility

- 


***MarTech \& Funnel Operations***



* Maintain integration health across CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), ad platforms, and automation tools
* Flag and help resolve funnel drop\-off points using funnel and behavior analytics (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity)

**Company Description:** 




   Chennai Chess Club is one of India’s leading chess learning institutes,committed to making high\-quality chess education accessible to learners worldwide. With over 2,000 students and a presence across 35\+ countries, we are building one of the fastest\-growing chess education communities globally.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 We are looking for an experienced business leader with a track record of managing and scaling a medium\-sized business or business unit, ideally driving 3–4x growth. The ideal candidate will have 6–10 years of experience in leadership roles across operations, business development, marketing, or general management, preferably within education, fitness, consumer services, or other high\-growth businesses.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Revenue \& Financial Management** 



* Own revenue targets, profitability and cost efficiency.
* Review revenue, collections, profitability, and key business metrics with leadership on a regular basis.
* Approve spending and vendor contracts in alignment with financial goals.



**2\. Strategic Leadership** 



* Develop and execute the academy’s long\-term vision and annual operational plan.
* Oversee all departments – Marketing, sales, operations, HR, and finance.
* Identify growth opportunities (online expansions, new verticals, partnerships, etc.).



**3\. Operations Management** 



* Design and continuously improve scalable workflows, processes, and accountability systems across teams.
* Develop and improve processes that enhance the student experience and maximise student retention.
* Monitor scheduling, attendance, and punctuality of coaches and students using measurable KPIs and tools.
* Implement quality control checks on classes and coach performance.



**3\. Team Management** 



* Lead, mentor, and evaluate staff including operations team, sales teams, marketing team, support staff and Coaches.
* Conduct regular team meetings and reviews.
* Drive performance through clear KPIs and team accountability.



**4\. Student Feedback \& Improvement** 



* Ensure high student satisfaction through quality training, transparent updates, parent communication and prompt issue resolution.
* Establish and improve systems to measure student progress and parent satisfaction, retention, and issue resolution.



**6\. Sales \& Marketing Leadership** 



* Coordinate with the marketing team to run campaigns, events, and promotions.
* Continuously improve the sales process, conversion rates, and overall revenue performance.
* Oversee branding, social media presence, and public representation of the academy.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 6–10 years of experience, including significant people leadership experience in a consumer\-facing, education, fitness, services, or high\-growth business.
* Demonstrated experience managing cross\-functional teams and being accountable for measurable business outcomes such as revenue growth, profitability, customer retention, or operational efficiency.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex ideas clearly to clients and internal teams.
* Excellent analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving abilities, with comfort working with data, KPIs, and performance dashboards.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a Tier\-1 University/College in Business, Marketing, Management, Engineering or a related field; MBA or equivalent professional qualification is an advantage.
* Chess knowledge and Edtech experience are a huge bonus \- apply now if you’re ready to build something meaningful.
