description:
WE'RE HIRING \| SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER

**ALLOY DESIGN STUDIO \| Mumbai**

ALLOY is looking for a **Social Media Manager** with around **2 years of experience** to take ownership of our social media and digital presence.

We are looking for someone who understands that **marketing a design practice is different from marketing a product**. The role requires someone who can turn spaces, people, processes, and ideas into compelling stories — while maintaining a strong and consistent visual identity.

THE ROLE

This is a highly **hands\-on, creative, and execution\-driven** role. You will work closely with the design team, Founders, and external collaborators to conceptualise, create, shoot, edit, and publish content across ALLOY's platforms.

The ideal candidate has a **strong aesthetic and design sense**, understands storytelling, learns quickly, and is comfortable taking an idea from *"we should do this"* to actually making it happen.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Develop and manage ALLOY's **monthly content and social media calendar**.
* Come up with fresh content ideas, campaigns, formats, and ways to communicate our projects and brand.
* Develop content around **projects, design processes, materials, people, studio culture, site execution, and the thinking behind our work**.
* Edit project images and social media content while maintaining ALLOY's visual language and aesthetic.
* Conceptualise, plan, and coordinate **photoshoots and video shoots**, including locations, shot lists, props, talent, photographers, videographers, and production requirements.
* Participate actively in shoots and be comfortable directing or assisting with content production on the ground.
* Write and develop **scripts, captions, reels, interview formats, and other content**.
* Assist in conceptualising and producing **podcasts, founder interviews, conversations, and other long\-form content**.
* Regularly visit project sites to identify content opportunities and document the design and execution process.
* Coordinate with designers, photographers, videographers, editors, PR agencies, and other external collaborators.
* Identify relevant **design awards, publications, features, and industry opportunities**, and manage submissions from start to finish.
* Keep up with social media trends and identify which ones can be meaningfully adapted to ALLOY without compromising the brand.
* Monitor performance and use insights to continuously improve content and engagement.
* Maintain consistency across ALLOY's **visual identity, tone of voice, and overall brand positioning**.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* **2\+ years of experience** in social media, content, digital marketing, or brand marketing.
* Experience marketing **service\-based businesses** is strongly preferred — particularly architecture, interior design, hospitality, real estate, luxury, lifestyle, or other creative industries.
* A **strong aesthetic eye** and genuine understanding of design, composition, imagery, typography, and visual storytelling.
* Strong content ideation and storytelling skills.
* Comfortable with **image editing and basic content production tools**.
* Strong writing and communication skills.
* Someone who is highly **hands\-on** and comfortable being involved in everything from planning a shoot to being on\-site during one.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, people, vendors, and deadlines.
* A fast learner who can understand a brand's language and evolve with it.
* Proactive, resourceful, and willing to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
* Someone who notices details, has opinions, and can bring fresh thinking to the table.

THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for someone who simply **posts on Instagram**.

We're looking for someone who can **think like a marketer, see like a designer, and execute like a producer**.

Someone who can walk into a finished space and immediately see five stories worth telling. Someone who can organise a shoot, write the script, coordinate the team, get on site, edit the content, and make sure it goes out well.

If you are curious, creatively driven, hands\-on, and excited by the intersection of **design, culture, storytelling, and marketing**, we'd like to hear from you.

**Role:** Full\-time

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
**Designation**\- Brand Marketing Manager
  

  

**Experience** \- 5 Years
  

  

**Position Description** – Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.
  

In the capacity of a Brand Marketing Manager, you will ensure the efficient execution of business plans to meet future brand expectations and targets. You will also take part in the development of short\-term tactical Brand Management marketing plans. You will ensure brand integrity by guiding efforts across multiple channels and functions and support the development and execution of offline, digital, and paid social advertising programs for the business.
  

The role entails the management of media campaigns from the beginning to the end and is also responsible for the execution across all media channels inclusive of TV, Radio, Digital, Print, and Paid Social. The Brand Marketing Manager reports directly to the Director\- Womennovator.
  

  

**The Impact You'll Make in this Role** \-
  

  

**Strategy :** You will play part in the development of the brand marketing strategies in order to establish strategic direction and program positioning. In this capacity, the Brand Marketing Manager, you will develop marketing partnerships with media partners, and other external partners in an attempt to broaden the reach of the business’s brand messaging.
  

You will also play part in the development and execution of paid social programs on advertising platforms inclusive of Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, and Twitter etc. along with supporting the brand’s paid media programs. At this capacity, you will contribute to the development and execution of all online/offline events, promotions for the business/brand.
  

  

**Management:** You will play a managerial role in the production process for all offline marketing materials, for example, project timelines, and so forth. You will be tasked with the maintenance of the lower department’s operational production budget, ensuring that there is a continuous effective and economical allocation of resources. You will also supervises multiple external agencies in developing creative advertising, high\-impact promotions, and media planning,event sponsorship.
  

You will additionally manage media timelines and executes plans across all media channels, that is, TV, Social, Radio, and Print etc. you will effectively supervisethe junior marketing staff/team, managing workflow, providing direction, and overseeing constant skill development. You will strike a balance in ensuring all branding and key information strategies are in line with overall business strategy without compromising the brand’s integrity.
  

  

**Collaboration:** You will work closely with Director, in reviewing and approving all branded elements for advertising and launch materials inclusive of printed collateral, product packaging, online assets, launch toolkits, product logos, and videos etc..
  

In this collaboration, he/she also provides feedback and insight on the performance of program campaigns and relays them for further strategic development and solution formulation. You will serves as a collaborative partner and liaison between all internal product departments in ensuring integrated campaigns and cohesive strategies. Youwill also be tasked with collaborating with external partners in ensuring that all media plans are aligned with the business’s values and goals, are executed on\-time and on\-budget.
  

  

**Analytics:** You will also play an analytical role where you will conduct research and analyses, translating campaign performance into communication documents and reports, which are distributed to management and key stakeholders. Some of these documents are marketing briefs, competitive analyses, campaign recap decks, and so forth.
  

At this capacity, You will track spending on all media campaigns for the purpose of ensuring that brand marketing efforts always stay within the allocated budget. Here, you will actualize cost reports per project at the completion of each brand marketing campaign. You will prepare account management, expenditure, progress, and other related reports. Additionally, you will review targeted spends and make real\-time adjustments to optimize brand marketing campaign performance.
  

  

**Knowledge and Opportunity:** You will also conduct regular and consistent research and keep the business and the brand marketing department informed on best practices and the latest trends in brand marketing that ensure that the business does not lag behind of its competition and also in order to provide growth opportunity for the brand by capitalizing on the acquisition potential that alternative branding strategies/approaches may hold.
  

At this capacity, you will ensure that the product/service maintains a consistent tone that is relevant to the business’s brand and the audience, solidifying the brand identity by ensuring consistent, on\-time and accurate development, deliveryfor each brand marketing campaign.
  

  

**Other Duties:** You will also performs other tasks as designated by the Director.
  

  

**To set you up for success in this role from day one, Womennovator is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:**  

  

  

* MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing (Completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university


* Five (5\) combined years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing


* Three (3\) years people leadership experience


* Strong communications (written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal) skills, including tact, diplomacy, and ability to influence and navigate across a diverse and complex organization.


* Highly proficient in Ms Word, PowerPoint, and Ms Excel


  

**Age:** Preferably below 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of application

In this time we have created over 550 Cr for 300\+ brands combined.



  





**Introduction About Role –** 





 We're looking for Account Managers experienced in managing clients for performance marketing for DTC brands, people who are great understanding of the creative \+ website \+ retention \+ ads ecosystem, and have a master\-level approach towards client management and timelines.
 




  






 Here are the key responsibilities in a nutshell:
 





 1\. Manage the day\-to\-day internal operation coordination.
 





 2\. Manage the brand founders and their team in terms of requirements, goals, communications \& satisfaction.
 




  





**\*Must have about 2 years of experience in working for a performance marketing agency.**

* Coordinate the internal work timelines on different platforms ads (FB, Google, Snapchat, Tiktok etc).

**Day\-to\-Day –**

* Easy work timelines
* Remote work with mindful working hours
* No 9\-5 work environment

* Structured work

**Digital \& Customer Engagement Support**

**Vendor \& Budget Management**
* Identify and manage marketing agencies, event partners, and production vendors.
* Negotiate contracts and ensure optimum utilization of marketing budgets.
* Track campaign expenses and ensure adherence to approved budgets.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Monitor campaign ROI and prepare performance reports.
* Analyze passenger behavior, footfall trends, and promotional outcomes.
* Present campaign results and recommendations to management.


**Qualifications**

* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Mass Communication, Event Management, or related field.
* 5\-8 years of experience in BTL marketing, event management, retail marketing, mall marketing, hospitality, aviation, or experiential marketing.
* Experience in managing large\-scale consumer engagement activities preferred.


**Key Skills**
* BTL Marketing
* Event Management
* Brand Activation
* Retail Marketing
* Vendor Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Budget Management
* Communication \& Negotiation
* Campaign Planning \& Execution
* Data Analysis \& Reporting

* Passenger engagement levels.

* Retail/F\&B sales uplift from campaigns.

* Concessionaire participation and satisfaction.
* Budget adherence and execution efficiency.

title: Specialist - Brand, Marketing & Communication- Graphic Design
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Specialist —Designer
   

  

 If you’re a marketer, creative, communicator, storyteller, or strategist, our unique blend of talented pros needs one more ingredient: you. Deloitte’s full\-service Brand, Marketing \& Communications organization is seeking collaborative creatives, skilful strategists, and marketing masterminds to lead our businesses in exciting new directions. At Deloitte, we combine world\-class creativity and business knowledge, insightful strategic thinking, and Deloitte’s powerful brand equity to create undeniable impact. If you find opportunity where others don’t, thrive in a supportive and diverse team environment, keep your finger on the pulse of cultural trends and the latest technology, and apply new ideas to challenge the status quo, then we want your talents in our mix. Together we’ll discover new ways to transform out\-of\-the\-box concepts into work that feels like marketing magic.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll contribute to the growth and development of the organization in a variety of ways. Everyday you’ll have the opportunity to use your skills to bring big ideas to life. We celebrate inquisitive team players who can regularly anticipate, adjust, and act in a rapidly changing market and marketing landscape—and find new opportunities within it.
   

  

**The work you’ll do**
* Design high\-quality external visual assets across print, digital, web, video, and internal communications formats within established brand guidelines.
* Create design work across all phases of development, from creative consultation and concepting through execution, revision, and final production.
* Translate stakeholder input and strategic direction into clear, visually compelling design solutions.
* Build storyboards, rough layouts, and design concepts that communicate ideas effectively and support business objectives.
* Collaborate with design managers, writers, and stakeholders to solve creative challenges and refine output.
* Ensure design work is accurate, on\-brand, visually cohesive, and production\-ready.
* Contribute to the team’s vision by sharing ideas, visual references, and practical design recommendations.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Creative team within the Growth and Purpose office brings together the strength of Deloitte’s brand and the expertise of inspired marketing and creative professionals to deliver meaningful business impact. By combining strategic insight with world\-class creative thinking, the team develops compelling, data\-informed work that supports key business priorities. When stakeholders need next\-level solutions that support their business priorities, Brand, Marketing \& Communications is the partner that can transform big ideas into big impact .
   

  

**Location** 
 :
 **Hyderabad**
**Work timing** 
 :
 **2:00 PM–11:00 PM (IST)**
**Required**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Graphic Design and Visual Design.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating work across print, digital, and illustration\-based deliverables.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Strong illustration capability, including digital illustration; freehand illustration skills are a plus.
* Ability to translate strategic direction into high\-quality design within an established brand system.
* Strong understanding of layout, typography, iconography, composition, and visual storytelling.
* A wholistic understanding of AI and trends in design.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively within a process\-driven environment


**Preferred**
* Experience working in an advertising agency or large, matrixed, global organization.
* Familiarity with executive communications, integrated campaigns, or internal communications.
* Experience working with Wacom and presentation tools


 \#BM\&C\_G\&P
   

  

 \#BMC\_Creative

 Full\-time

 Freshers and junior creators are welcome

 ₹7,000–₹10,000 per month, depending on skills and portfolio
 


 About the Role
 
 We’re looking for a creative, detail\-oriented person who can turn ideas into
 **social media images and short\-form reels using AI tools, Canva and video\-editing tools.** 




 You’ll work on visual content for multiple client brands, following supplied briefs, copy and brand guidelines. This is a hands\-on creative role—ideal for someone who enjoys experimenting with AI while making sure the finished content looks polished and is ready to publish.
 



**This role focuses on creating images and reels. It does not include SEO, ad management, social media posting or client servicing.** 



 Key Responsibilities
 * **Create social media images:** 
 Design static posts, carousels, promotional creatives, festival greetings and story visuals using Canva and AI tools.
* **Produce short\-form reels:** 
 Turn client photographs, supplied footage and AI\-generated visuals into engaging reels with clear storytelling, text overlays, subtitles, transitions and suitable music.
* **Generate and refine AI content:** 
 Write and improve prompts, evaluate results, and correct visual errors rather than relying on the first generated output.
* **Follow each brand’s identity:** 
 Use the correct colours, fonts, logos and messaging. Preserve supplied logos and actual property or product photographs without unwanted alterations.
* **Prepare final deliverables:** 
 Check spelling, readability, cropping, image quality and video pacing; export in the required formats and organise editable files.
* **Handle feedback and deadlines:** 
 Make revisions accurately and manage assigned work across different client brands.

 * Working knowledge of
 **Canva, Gemini and other AI image or video\-creation tools** 
 , plus basic reel\-editing skills.
* A good eye for layout, typography, colour, composition and visual consistency.
* The ability to follow a brief, pay attention to details and improve work based on feedback.
* A portfolio showing both image designs and short\-form videos.
 **Personal projects and practice work are welcome.**



 You do not need to be an expert in every tool. We’re more interested in your creative judgment, willingness to learn and ability to turn an idea into a finished visual.
 


 What We Provide
 
 Clear creative briefs, brand assets, feedback and access to the required paid tools. You’ll gain hands\-on experience creating content for real client projects in a growing agency.

 Send your

 to

 .

 Application – AI Content Creator – \[Your Name]

title: CBS-BMC-Brand and Marketing-Supervising Associate-Creative Projects Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY Global Delivery Services (GDS), we work hand in hand with the business to build awareness of our services and solutions; to bring our purpose — building a better working world — to life for our people, clients and communities; to engage our people and build a high performing culture; and to build the commercial value and emotional resonance of the EY and the GDS brand.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high\-impact, high\-quality and on–brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human — across multiple media platforms.
   

  

 As a Supervising Associate — Creative Projects Manager, you will be responsible for the end delivery of creative projects within the CoE. You will own the creative and visual direction and design for creative collaterals across multiple formats, ensuring that all creatives are on\-brand, user\-centric and aesthetically proficient. With a passion for problem\-solving and creative strategy, you lead creative brainstorms with stakeholders and content and digital marketing teams to produce best\-in\-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. With your impeccable aesthetic sense and design sensibility, you are a versatile and reliable leader who can elevate any creative conceptualization, storyboard or creative direction for projects across multiple channels.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Act as a single point contact for designated/assigned Creative Services Projects
* Provide creative leadership to the design teams to deliver a range of collaterals (i.e., brochures, placemats, illustration, layouts, infographics, on\-screen presentations, proposals, microsites, motion graphic content and social media collaterals)
* Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post\-production
* Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency
* Stay up\-to\-date with current and future designs, web standards, concepts and industry trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
* Provide creative and art direction support to the team, coordinate with team members and others to resolve issues, as necessary
* Proactively identify opportunities to employ pop culture trends, creativity, executional approaches and techniques to create exceptional user experiences
* Communicate effectively with various customers/customer groups while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
* Lead project discussions with customers with a customer\-centric mindset
* Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
* Mentor junior team members on best design practices
* Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
* Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A user\-centric mindset with creative, innovative and analytical approach
* Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
* Exceptional project management, risk management and team management
* Proven track record of delivering high\-quality output on time and within budget
* An innovative mindset that takes a client problem and delivers compelling and inspiring creative solutions
* Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Understanding of current and future visual trends


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor's degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline) \*
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign, Adobe DC and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word and Excel)
* Experience across a range of digital, social, and integrated media
* Knowledge of social platforms (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest etc)
* Strong visual design and creative thinking capability
* At least 10 years of overall experience in a fast\-paced global environment (team management experience mandatory)


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills


**What We Look For**
* Strong business acumen along with creative vision
* Creative problem\-solving mindset with a flexible can\-do attitude
* A growth mindset creative who loves to collaborate, ideate and deliver breakthrough work
* Experience in leading and managing creative teams, as well as developing junior creative talent
* Self\-starter who loves challenges and makes big things happen by working together
* Experience working with global clients
* Confidence, maturity and ability to build strong client relationships
* A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others


**What We Offer**
 EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Good communication and client\-handling skills.

* Experience in schema markup implementation.
* Understanding of content SEO and keyword mapping.

title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:
Capsicum Mediaworks® is a Mumbai\-based SEO and Digital Marketing agency working with clients across India and globally. We specialize in delivering result\-oriented SEO strategies that help businesses improve their online visibility, organic growth, and digital presence.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a **Senior SEO Specialist** with strong hands\-on experience in **On\-Page SEO, Off\-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Local SEO, and SEO Strategy** to join our Mumbai office.

This is a **full\-time, 100% onsite role** where you will independently manage SEO projects, develop and execute data\-driven strategies, identify growth opportunities, troubleshoot ranking and technical issues, and collaborate with Content, Design, and Development teams to achieve measurable organic growth.

**Note:** Only candidates currently residing in **MUMBAI** are eligible to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and manage SEO strategies for multiple client websites from planning through execution and performance optimization.
* Develop **data\-driven SEO strategies and roadmaps** based on business objectives, search demand, competition, website performance, and industry trends.
* Conduct comprehensive **Technical, On\-Page, Off\-Page, Content, and Local SEO audits** and identify opportunities for organic growth.
* Perform advanced **keyword research, competitor analysis, search intent analysis, keyword mapping, and content gap analysis**.
* Execute and oversee On\-Page SEO activities including metadata optimization, internal linking, content optimization, URL structures, image optimization, heading structures, schema markup, and topical relevance.
* Identify and troubleshoot Technical SEO issues related to **crawling, indexing, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, duplicate content, broken links, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and website performance**.
* Work closely with developers to communicate and implement technical SEO recommendations and verify their successful implementation.
* Plan and execute effective **Off\-Page SEO and link\-building strategies** focused on improving website authority, relevance, and organic visibility.
* Develop and manage **Local SEO strategies**, including Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword targeting, citations, reviews, and local search visibility.
* Analyze website performance using **Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Search Console, and SEO tools**, identifying trends, issues, opportunities, and actionable insights.
* Collaborate with **Content Writers, Designers, Developers, and other internal teams** to ensure SEO best practices are incorporated throughout the website and content lifecycle.
* Review and guide SEO implementation performed by junior team members and provide recommendations for improving execution quality.
* Support the team in developing **SEO processes, checklists, SOPs, and best practices** to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to improve efficiency across keyword research, content optimization, competitor analysis, SEO audits, data analysis, reporting, and workflow automation while ensuring all outputs are manually reviewed for accuracy and quality.
* Stay updated with **Google algorithm updates, AI\-driven search developments, Search Generative Experience, evolving SERP features, and emerging SEO trends**, and proactively adapt strategies accordingly.
* Experiment with new SEO approaches and tools to identify opportunities for improving organic visibility, rankings, traffic, and conversions.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum **3 years of proven hands\-on SEO experience**, preferably in an agency environment managing multiple live websites.
* Strong practical and strategic knowledge of **On\-Page SEO, Off\-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Local SEO, Keyword Research, Competitor Analysis, Content SEO, Website Audits, and SEO Reporting**.
* Strong understanding of **Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4\), WordPress, Basic HTML, Google Business Profile, and SEO reporting**.
* Hands\-on experience using **Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Keyword Planner, PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, and KWFinder** is essential.
* Strong understanding of **crawling, indexing, canonicalization, redirects, sitemap management, robots.txt, structured data/schema, Core Web Vitals, and technical website optimization**.

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Technical SEO Executive** to strengthen our digital marketing and organic search performance. The ideal candidate should have strong technical SEO expertise, a solid understanding of website architecture, and proven experience working in the **IT Services industry**.

The candidate will be responsible for improving organic visibility, identifying technical SEO opportunities, analyzing competitors, and collaborating with content and marketing teams to drive qualified traffic and business growth.

Key Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Digital Marketing**, or a related field.
* Minimum **3\- 5 years of hands\-on SEO experience**, preferably within the IT Services or technology sector.
* Strong understanding of **search engine algorithms, SEO guidelines, ranking factors, and industry best practices**.
* Working knowledge of **PPC, Social Media Marketing, and Email Marketing**.
* Strong expertise in both **on\-page and off\-page SEO**.
* Good technical understanding of **HTML, CSS, website architecture, and web technologies**.
* Experience with SEO and analytics platforms such as **Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools**.
* Strong analytical, research, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, content writers, designers, and marketing teams.
* Capable of working independently while handling multiple SEO initiatives and priorities.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform comprehensive **keyword research** to identify high\-value search terms and opportunities aligned with business objectives.
* Evaluate keyword difficulty, search intent, trends, and competitive landscapes to support SEO and content strategies.
* Optimize website pages, including **content, title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and other on\-page elements**.
* Develop and improve **internal linking strategies** to strengthen website authority, crawlability, and user navigation.
* Conduct regular **technical SEO audits** and identify issues affecting organic search performance.
* Diagnose and resolve technical problems such as **crawl errors, broken links, duplicate content, indexing issues, redirects, and website performance concerns**.
* Work with development teams to improve **website structure, page speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, and overall technical health**.
* Review and optimize website architecture to ensure that search engines can efficiently crawl, understand, and index important pages.
* Monitor organic search performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Analyze website data using **Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms** to measure traffic, rankings, conversions, and other key performance indicators.
* Conduct regular **competitor and industry analysis** to identify gaps, emerging trends, content opportunities, and potential threats.
* Establish SEO benchmarks and track performance against key industry competitors.
* Support **online reputation management**, including monitoring social profiles, brand mentions, and customer reviews.
* Coordinate with content teams to optimize existing content and promote new content across relevant external platforms.
* Stay informed about **search engine updates, SEO trends, emerging technologies, and changes in ranking algorithms**.
* Work closely with marketing and cross\-functional teams to align SEO activities with broader digital marketing goals.

**Company:** Elite Screens India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product Division:** Advaning – Awnings, Door Awnings, Canopies \& Related Outdoor Products  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 years  
**Department:** Sales \& Marketing  
**Reports to:** Management

1\. Job Purpose

The Marketing Manager – Advaning Products will be responsible for developing and expanding the market for **Advaning awnings, door awnings, canopies and other related outdoor products** across India.

The position requires a proactive marketing professional who can identify new market opportunities, develop dealers and distributors, generate project enquiries, build relationships with architects, builders and contractors, and drive sales growth and brand awareness for Advaning.

2\. Key Responsibilities

**Market Development**

* Develop and implement marketing strategies for Advaning products across India.
* Identify new markets, customer segments and business opportunities.
* Study competitor products, pricing, distribution and market trends.
* Develop strategies to increase Advaning's market share and brand visibility.
* Identify potential applications for awnings in residential, commercial, hospitality and other projects.

**Dealer \& Distributor Development**

* Identify, appoint and develop dealers and distributors in key markets.
* Build strong relationships with dealers, distributors and channel partners.
* Support channel partners with product knowledge, quotations, marketing materials and sales support.
* Regularly monitor dealer performance and develop action plans for improving sales.
* Expand the Advaning dealer network across major cities and regional markets.

**Project \& Institutional Sales**

* Develop business opportunities with architects, interior designers, builders, contractors, hotels, resorts, commercial establishments and other institutional customers.
* Generate and follow up on project enquiries from initial enquiry through order closure.
* Conduct product presentations and demonstrations for potential customers.
* Coordinate with the technical and operations teams for project requirements and execution.

**Sales \& Marketing**

* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Prepare and execute territory\-wise marketing plans.
* Conduct dealer visits, customer meetings, product presentations and market surveys.
* Develop promotional campaigns and local marketing activities.
* Generate leads through digital marketing, exhibitions, dealer networks and direct market development.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and ensure timely follow\-up of all enquiries.

**Product \& Market Feedback**

* Collect regular feedback from dealers, customers and the market regarding products, pricing, quality and competition.
* Identify new product opportunities based on market requirements.
* Work closely with management to recommend product improvements, new sizes, designs and applications.
* Monitor competitor activities and report significant market developments to management.

**Reporting \& Management**

* Submit weekly and monthly sales and marketing reports.
* Maintain updated records of enquiries, leads, dealer visits, project opportunities and sales conversions.
* Prepare sales forecasts and market development plans.
* Monitor outstanding enquiries and ensure systematic follow\-up.
* Be accountable for achieving agreed sales and market\-development objectives.

3\. Qualification

* **Bachelor's Degree** in any relevant discipline.
* **MBA in Marketing – Desirable.**
* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience** in marketing and sales of:
* Door awnings
* Window awnings
* Retractable awnings
* Canopies
* Outdoor shading products
* Building products
* Architectural products
* Other related products

Candidates with experience in the **awning, façade, building\-materials, architectural\-products or outdoor\-living industry** will be preferred.

4\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* **Fluent English and Hindi** communication is essential.
* Knowledge of **Tamil and/or other regional Indian languages** will be an advantage.
* Strong sales and negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of dealer and distributor management.
* Ability to independently develop new markets.
* Strong relationship\-building and networking skills.
* Ability to identify and convert new business opportunities.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel and presentation tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented and capable of working independently.
* Good commercial awareness and understanding of pricing and margins.

5\. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on marketing professional rather than purely an office\-based marketing executive**.

He should have:

* Proven experience in developing markets from scratch.
* Existing contacts with dealers, distributors, architects, builders or contractors.
* Experience in selling technical or architectural products.
* Ability to travel extensively and meet customers personally.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and ability to convert enquiries into orders.
* Ability to take ownership of the Advaning business and develop it into a significant revenue stream.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Marketing Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly and annual sales achievement.
* New dealer/distributor appointments.
* Active dealer productivity.
* Number and value of new project enquiries.
* Project conversion rate.
* New customer acquisition.
* Market expansion into new cities/regions.
* Enquiry\-to\-order conversion.
* Dealer and customer retention.
* Collection and payment discipline.
* Development and liquidation of existing inventory.
* Overall profitability and contribution of the Advaning division.

7\. Important Requirement

**This position involves extensive travel. The candidate must be willing to travel across India as required for dealer development, customer meetings, project visits, exhibitions and market development.**

title: Product Marketing Growth
description:
**About Finrep:** 




 Finrep is building AI\-powered financial reporting for CFO teams at public and pre\-IPO companies. Finance, accounting, investor relations, and legal teams use us to get their SEC filings done faster: the 10\-K and 10\-Q (the annual and quarterly reports every US public company has to file), plus proxies, S\-1s, and 8\-Ks. Work that takes them hours today, like finding how other companies worded a similar disclosure, takes seconds with us.
 



  





**We are early, backed by Accel, and growing quickly.** 




  





**The Role:** 




 Our marketing systems already work. We are hiring you to push past them: open channels we have not tried, run growth experiments, and scale the ones that earn it.
 



  





**You will sit inside the GTM team and own product marketing and growth as one job:** 
 how we describe the product, where that description shows up, and whether it moves numbers. That covers positioning, LinkedIn, the blog, use case pages, paid experiments, and SEO. You get the current playbook to build on, and the freedom to break the parts that have stopped working.
 



 The range here is real. If your experiments land, GTM operations is yours to run.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**•** 
 Own Finrep's positioning: what we say we do, who we say it to, and how that shows up across every channel.
 



 • Write LinkedIn content that a technical accountant would actually stop for. This audience spots shallow content instantly, so every piece is grounded in real filings, FASB updates, or SEC comment letter data.
 



 • Run content and growth experiments across LinkedIn, Twitter, and YouTube. Set the hypothesis, ship it, read the numbers, kill what does not work.
 



 • Own paid experiments end to end: copy, creative, targeting, and the honest call on whether a channel deserves more budget.
 



 • Drive SEO enrichment: backlinks, affiliates, and partner outreach.
 



 • Write and optimise use case pages, blog posts, and landing pages for both search engines and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
 



 • Track competitors and turn the gaps in how they position themselves into angles we can own.
 



 • Grow the top of the funnel and scale whatever works.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 • Prior marketing experience with a portfolio or personal site we can read. Show us the work, not the job titles.
 



 • Product thinking. You can look at Finrep, work out what an SEC reporting lead is actually trying to get done that week, and write from there.
 



 • Basic engineering literacy. You know what a server does, roughly how a website is built and deployed, and you can read code without panicking. You will be shipping pages and wiring up tools yourself.
 



 • Fluency with AI and agentic tools such as Claude, Codex, and ChatGPT. You should already be building with them daily, not testing them on weekends.
 



 • Self\-direction. You see the gap, propose the experiment, and ship it without waiting for a brief.
 



 • Genuine excitement about a lean team where what you ship on Monday is live by Wednesday.
 



  





**Major Pluses:** 




 • Startup experience, especially at the early stage.
 



 • SEO, AEO, or GEO work you can point to and explain.
 



 • A track record of B2B content that earned real engagement from a professional audience.
 



 • Curiosity about finance, accounting, or regulation. You do not need domain knowledge on day one. You need the appetite to build it fast.
 



 • Comfort with Figma, Canva, Semrush, or HubSpot.
 



  





**What This Is Not:** 




 • Not a scheduling role. You create original content, not reposts and templates.
 



 • Not a role with a brief waiting for you every Monday. You propose the work.
 



 • Not a place to learn marketing from scratch. The team is small and the bar is practitioner grade.
 



  





**Why This Role:** 




  





 • You own the entire content and growth surface from day one: writing, web, paid, partnerships, and experimentation.
 



 • Direct access to the founders. Your ideas reach the decision table the same day.
 



 • A clear path to owning GTM operations if you perform.
 



 • A product solving a real, painful problem for an audience that rewards substance over flash.

title: Associate Marketing Manager, RBS Retail Efficiency
description:
**Description**
 Are you customer centric, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, entrepreneurial, and passionate about protecting brands? Do you want to be part of one of the fastest growing and most innovative brand protection businesses? Are you interested in a high impact, high ownership role that sits at the intersection of product authenticity, brand trust, and customer confidence? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. Come join our team and help define the course of Amazon's product authenticity and brand protection business.
   

  

 Amazon's vision is to be Earth's most customer\-centric company and the most trusted place for brands to grow and protect their business. We build programs and solutions that help brand owners verify product authenticity, secure their supply chain through serialization, and build customer trust — delighting millions of brands and customers every day.
   

  

 We are looking for a smart, metrics and results\-oriented Associate Manager \- Product Marketing to independently own our most important brand\-facing product authenticity initiatives — the "big rocks" that move the business. You will set the go\-to\-market and adoption roadmap for our product authenticity and serialization programs, build and scale marketing campaigns across the funnel, and define the dashboards and mechanisms that track enrollment, adoption, engagement, and retention.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Owning and driving the biggest, product marketing initiatives for brand protection and authenticity programs end to end — from strategy through execution and measurable business impact.
* Designing and scaling account\-based marketing (ABM) programs that target high\-value brands and segments with tailored, high\-touch messaging around supply chain integrity and anti\-counterfeiting solutions.
* Owning the full marketing funnel — awareness, lead generation, enrollment, activation, and retention — and independently driving conversion improvements at each stage.
* Building and scaling lifecycle and nurture programs (email, social, webinars, outbound, onboarding journeys) that move brands from awareness to active adoption of authenticity solutions.
* Leading go\-to\-market strategy for major new feature and program launches, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, and cross\-program placements.
* Defining the metrics, dashboards, and mechanisms used to measure program health (enrollment rates, serialization adoption, scan rates, brand engagement), and reporting performance and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Developing content and thought\-leadership strategies (case studies, playbooks, webinars, brand\-facing events) that drive awareness and enrollment at scale for product authenticity programs.
* Establishing best practices and reusable playbooks, and mentoring peers and junior team members to raise the bar across the org.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience in a marketing role


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with a Content Management System (e.g. Wordpress, Drupla, Joomla, etc.)
* Experience using integrated campaigns to solve brand/business challenges

title: Marketing Operations Associate I
description:
**Our Mission**
 Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
   

  

 Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in\-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200\+ specialties and \+12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
   

  

 We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.
   

  

**Your Impact On Our Mission**
 The Marketing Operations team supports marketing functions across the organization. You’ll play a critical role in helping to grow our lifecycle marketing program. Your work will play an integral part in driving provider acquisition, engagement and retention via thoughtful, tailored experiences by leading execution and reporting across email marketing campaigns.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and comfort with Q/A processes

* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave

* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022\-2026

 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. title: Business Marketing Manager
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
   

  

 Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
   

  

 We are looking for a Business Marketing Manager, Radiation Oncology Solutions (ROS), to join our Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) Business Management team. Reporting to the Head of Business Management, ROS APJ, this role will focus on working with product marketing teams on business planning, performance management \& portfolio strategy, and develop competitive strategies and tactics that accelerate profitable growth. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capability with commercial judgement and cross\-functional leadership to influence priorities across regional, zone and global teams.
   

  

 Business Planning and Performance Management
   

  

* Support the Director of Product Marketing on the APJ annual and long\-range business planning process for assigned ROS portfolios, translating strategic priorities into market assumptions, growth targets, resource requirements and executable initiatives.
* Build robust business cases, market projections, forecasts and scenario analyses using market size, installed\-base, pricing, funnel, revenue, margin and adoption data.
* Define clear objectives, KPIs and governance routines; track performance against plan, identify gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Partner with Finance, Sales and marketing teams in APJ zones, as well as the Head of Business Management to align assumptions and maintain a fact\-based view of opportunities, risks and priorities.
* Prepare concise executive recommendations and decision materials for APJ and global leadership.
* Analyze sales, market, customer, and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.
* Support the Director of Product Marketing on the pricing quality initiatives to improve the quality of product and service pricing.


 Portfolio Strategy and optimization
   

  

* Support the Director of Product Marketing and the product marketing managers to develop and maintain a coherent APJ portfolio strategy across the product lifecycle, from pre\-launch and launch through adoption, upgrades, upsell and transition planning.
* Assess portfolio attractiveness, strategic fit, differentiation, profitability and market readiness to recommend investment, sequencing and resource priorities.
* Support the Director of Product Marketing and the team in driving the regional installed base (IB) adoption for upgrades, upsell, replacement, and end\-of\-support transitions.
* Translate the IB\-related product roadmap changes e.g. high margins upsells and upgrades into regional customer, commercial and lifecycle actions, in collaboration with zone teams, product marketing, commercial excellence and customer service teams.
* Establish disciplined IB sales opportunity management and forecasting, identify and implement improvements to IB sales processes, tools and ways of working to increase visibility, forecast accuracy, conversion and execution efficiency.
* Work closely with Commercialization Excellence team to design, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports using business intelligence tools.


- 

 Market Landscape and Strategic Insights
   

  

* Develop and maintain an integrated APJ market landscape covering market size and growth, customer segments, installed base, clinical and technology trends, reimbursement, regulation, channels and access barriers.
* Combine primary and secondary research, voice\-of\-customer insights and internal data to identify unmet needs, whitespace opportunities and emerging risks.
* Create repeatable analytical frameworks, dashboards and market models that improve planning quality and support evidence\-based decision\-making.
* Shape segmentation framework, targeting, positioning, value propositions, pricing and channel approaches for diverse APJ markets, together with the product marketing teams.
* Translate complex market information into clear implications and recommended actions for product, commercial and leadership teams.


 Competitive Strategy and Tactical Execution
   

  

* Establish a structured competitive intelligence process to monitor competitor portfolios, value propositions, pricing, partnerships, evidence, channels and go\-to\-market moves.
* Develop competitive strategies, market\-specific plays, battlecards, objection\-handling guidance and account\-level tactics that enable differentiated customer engagement.
* Anticipate competitor responses and define countermeasures, including positioning, pricing, evidence generation, stakeholder engagement and channel actions.
* Equip regional and zone teams with actionable insights and capability\-building programmes; capture field feedback and continuously refine tactics based on outcomes.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership and Execution
   

  

* Lead cross\-functional programmes spanning Product Management, Sales, Finance, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Service, Applications and Marketing Communications.
* Convert strategy into prioritised workplans with clear owners, milestones, decision points and measurable outcomes.
* Influence without direct authority, challenge assumptions constructively and build alignment across countries, functions and seniority levels.
* Drive disciplined review cycles and adapt strategies and tactics as market conditions, customer needs and portfolio priorities evolve.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor degree or above. Oncology related or Business degree with extensive oncology or business management field acceptable.
* A total of 10\+ years of relevant experience in business management, strategic planning, portfolio or product management, or related roles within a large healthcare or medical technology solutions company, preferably including regional or global responsibility. A strong background in oncology is preferred; experience in a Radiation Oncology department and expertise in treatment planning are additional advantages.
* Proven presentation \& communication skills and ability to influence colleagues.
* Possesses high energy, self\-directed, team player and detail oriented with a sense of excitement both internally and externally for our products and our company.
* Strong interpersonal skills and communication skills.
* Demonstrated capability in business planning, financial and market modelling, scenario development, forecasting, KPI design and performance management.
* Proven experience developing portfolio, segmentation, positioning, pricing, lifecycle and go\-to\-market strategies in complex, multi\-country markets.
* Strong market research and competitive intelligence skills, with the ability to synthesize diverse data into clear strategic implications and practical tactics.
* Willing to travel \>30% of the time. Flexibility to travel and work on the weekends as this position requires to support country in the entire APJ region.
* Flexible work hours due to global communication needs of the position which will involve some early morning and evening calls.
* Must possess excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills with excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Working Location: Any of the countries in Asia Pacific – Singapore/Japan/ Korea/ Malaysia/Thailand


**Preferred Skillsets**
* Strong leadership experience with the ability to manage, develop and lead a diverse group across various locations.
* Experience leading strategic planning, portfolio management, market landscaping and competitive strategy in healthcare, medical technology or another complex B2B environment.
* Knowledge, experience and understanding of working within the Asia Pacific markets.
* Advanced analytical capability using market, financial, customer, installed\-base and competitive data to build business cases and guide investment decisions.
* Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise. Able to communicate effectively with people from different levels, and across different functions.


**Requirements**
* Bachelors degree or equivalent.
* Background or experience in fields related to radiation or other oncology areas strongly preferred.
* At least 10 years of solid relevant working experience, preferably with a few years in regional or global context in healthcare MNCs
* Willing to travel.


 Attributes \& skills
   

  

* Strong leadership experience with the ability to manage, develop and lead a diverse group across various locations.
* Knowledge, experience and understanding of working within the Asia Pacific Japan markets.
* Strong customer\-focused mindset.
* Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise. Able to communicate effectively with people from different levels, and across different functions.
* Natural collaborative work ethic and approach.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English.


**Key VARIAN Competencies Required**
* Strategic thinking.
* Lead change.
* Collaborate across boundaries.


**Who we are** 
 : We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision\-making and treatment pathways.
   

  

**How we work**

We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. title: Performance Marketing Specialist (D2C)
description:
**About us:** 




 Seventh Triangle is a Shopify Premier Partner martech and commerce agency led by former D2C founders. We run performance, retention, SEO/AEO, CRO and Shopify development for 40\+ D2C brands across India, the UK, US and Middle East. We work in short sprints, decide on data, and are accountable to clients for revenue, not impressions.
 



  





**The role:** 




 You will own paid media and retention for 4 to 5 Indian D2C brands, with monthly budgets from ₹5L to ₹50L per account. This is not a media\-buying seat. We expect you to understand unit economics, know why a brand's repeat rate matters and not just ROAS, and have a view on what the ad should say before the designer comes up with the first draft. You report to a Senior Marketing Manager and join client calls from week three.
 



  





**What you will do:** 



* Plan, run and scale Meta (Advantage\+, catalogue, creative testing) and Google (PMax, Shopping, Search) campaigns against CAC, contribution margin.
* Own the retention layer for your accounts: Email and WhatsApp flows, segmentation, and lifecycle campaigns on Klaviyo, Zepic or similar.
* Write creative briefs from customer and competitor insight, and work with our design, video and UGC team to ship and test them weekly.
* Contribute to brand positioning and messaging for your accounts, not just the ad copy
* Read GA4, Shopify analytics and ad platform data to find what is actually driving revenue, and change the plan accordingly
* Present weekly and monthly performance to clients, present the numbers, and recommend next moves.
* Coordinate with our Tech, CRO, Design and SEO teams so campaigns land on pages that convert.



  





**What good looks like at 90 days:** 




 You are running your accounts without hand\-holding, clients trust your numbers, at least one retention flow you built is producing measurable repeat revenue, and creative you briefed is beating the brand's previous best.
 



  





**What this role is not:** 



* A reporting role where someone else decides the strategy
* A pure CRM or lifecycle role with no paid media
* Lead generation, B2B or SaaS marketing



  





**You should have:** 



* 3\+ years running Meta and Google Ads for D2C or ecommerce brands, ideally in an agency handling multiple accounts
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and at least one retention tool (Klaviyo, Zepic, WebEngage, MoEngage, Interakt or WATI)
* Working knowledge of D2C economics: CAC, LTV, contribution margin, repeat rate
* A track record of briefing creative, not just running what you were given
* Comfort presenting to founders and marketing heads
* GA4 and spreadsheet fluency; attribution tool experience is a plus



  





**Why here:** 




 You learn D2C from people who have built and sold D2C. You see 4 to 5 categories at once instead of one brand for three years. Your work is measured in client revenue, and so is your growth here.

title: Director, Destination Marketing - South Asia
description:
**Job Description**
 The Director, Destination Marketing – South Asia is the in\-market business strategist for marketing and eCommerce performance across India, Nepal and Sri Lanka. This role translates South Asia business and Asia Pacific (APAC) marketing and loyalty functional strategy into market and hotel priorities that capture demand, grow direct and digital revenue, improve channel performance and strengthen the return on marketing investment.
   

  

 You will be the voice of the business, the function and the customer for South Asia—turning consumer insight, local market context and commercial performance into clear decisions on where to focus, how to allocate resources and which capabilities hotels and markets need to build next. The region’s scale, growth pipeline, diverse consumer segments, multilingual context and rapidly evolving digital ecosystem require a leader who can combine strategic clarity with practical, market\-level execution.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Director, Regional Marketing \& eCommerce – APAC, you will lead the South Asia agenda and serve as the primary interface between the regional discipline and regional commercial, revenue management, distribution, operations, property commercial and marketing leaders, owners and management companies. You will create a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning and continuous improvement that turns insight into measurable revenue, channel and share outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT**
 Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.
   

  

**What Your Day\-to\-day Will Be Like**
* Own the South Asia marketing and eCommerce performance strategy, translating APACx and market priorities into clear growth plans, hotel and cluster priorities, targets, investment choices and accountability.
* Serve as the senior regional interface between Marketing \& eCommerce and regional and on\-property commercial teams, partnering across functions to review performance, identify demand and conversion opportunities, align investments and drive measurable outcomes.
* Lead performance management across direct, digital, paid, owned, and relevant third\-party channels, using revenue, conversion, acquisition efficiency, channel mix, contribution and share metrics to prioritize action.
* Guide hotels and markets in building practical, insight\-led marketing plans for rooms, food and beverage, weddings, meetings and events, balancing local business needs with regional priorities and available resources.
* Improve adoption and effectiveness of Hilton enterprise programs and digital capabilities, including Hilton Honors, WhatsApp for Business, Dine Like a Member and other relevant platforms, while identifying capability gaps and escalating performance requirements to regional and global partners.
* Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing South Asia team, setting clear standards for commercial thinking, stakeholder partnership, analytical rigor, pace and quality of execution.


**How You Will Collaborate With Others**
* Partner closely with APAC marketing and loyalty and South Asia regional teams to connect marketing and eCommerce priorities to hotel, portfolio and market business plans.
* Act as the primary above\-property contact for key and priority hotel marketing and commercial leaders, including participation in performance deep\-dives, hotel business reviews and need\-hotel action planning.
* Work with APACx and global Marketing, eCommerce, Media, CRM, Loyalty, Analytics, Technology and Product teams to pull through global platforms and playbooks, provide market feedback and enable adoption; this role does not own brand positioning, brand campaigns or eCommerce product roadmaps.
* Build trusted relationships with owners, management companies, agencies, media partners and commerce platforms, ensuring performance issues are surfaced early and actions are followed through across India, Nepal and Sri Lanka.
* Partner with relevant teams to introduce and scale new brands across South Asia, ensuring hotels are equipped with the marketing strategy, eCommerce capabilities, channel presence, content, tools and performance frameworks required to build demand and achieve commercial success from opening and beyond.


**What Deliverables You Will Take Ownership Of**
* The South Asia marketing and eCommerce strategy, annual operating plan and market prioritization framework, with clear growth opportunities, investment choices, service levels and success measures.
* A consistent performance\-management rhythm across commercial and hotel teams, including scorecards, forecasts, channel and market diagnostics, business reviews and action plans.
* A scalable hotel marketing and eCommerce enablement model covering plan quality, budget allocation, platform adoption, content and channel audits, training, playbooks, automation and measurement.
* Commercial launch and ramp\-up support for new and converted hotels, ensuring the marketing and eCommerce fundamentals, channel presence, demand\-generation plans and reporting are in place early.
* Design and implement proactive and reactive regional campaigns that respond to business priorities, market opportunities, need periods and performance signals, driving demand, conversion, revenue and channel performance across South Asia.
* Lead proactive engagement with priority owners and management companies to review performance and align cohesive marketing and eCommerce strategies and plans.


**Qualifications**
**WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT**
**You Have These Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Hospitality, Communications, Economics, Analytics or a related field.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in hospitality, travel, consumer, retail, digital marketing, eCommerce or a closely related commercial discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience leading regional, cluster, multi\-market or cross\-functional teams in a matrixed organization.
* Proven experience developing marketing and eCommerce strategies that improve business performance across multiple hotels, markets, brands or customer segments.
* Strong understanding of digital performance levers, including demand generation, conversion, acquisition efficiency, direct booking growth, channel mix, CRM or loyalty engagement and measurement.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret commercial and customer data, build recommendations, manage budgets and connect marketing activity to revenue, share and return on investment.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders, hotel leaders, owners, management companies, agencies and market teams without relying solely on direct authority.
* Ability to travel approximately 25%.


**It Would Be Useful If You Have**
* Experience working across India’s diverse regional, language, city\-tier and consumer segments.
* Experience operating in a hotel owner, franchise, management company or distributed\-market model.
* Experience with experimentation, incrementality, media effectiveness, performance marketing, metasearch, online travel intermediaries, mobile\-first commerce or digital payments.
* Experience building hotel marketing capability through onboarding, training, playbooks, audits, coaching and change management.
* MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics or a related discipline.

 .

* Strong relationship\-building and coordination skills.

* Understanding of creator commercials, content usage rights, and collaboration models.
* Existing understanding of creators across finance, lifestyle, business, tech, or related categories.



**What We're Looking For** 



* Confident communicator.
* Strong at building and maintaining relationships.
* Curious about creators, digital culture, and internet trends.
* Proactive and persistent with follow\-ups.
* Good understanding of what makes a
 **brand integration feel natural rather than forced** 
 .
* Self\-starter who takes ownership of tasks.
* Detail\-oriented with strong execution skills.



 Comfortable receiving feedback and moving quickly
