title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing \& Growth Specialist

**Company:** TestOwl  
**Location:** Ahmedabad / Remote  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About TestOwl

TestOwl is a no\-code test automation platform that helps engineering and QA teams automate regression testing without the overhead of writing and maintaining test scripts.

We’re looking for a **hands\-on Digital Marketing \& Growth Specialist** who can own TestOwl’s growth across **SEO, AEO, GEO, content, LinkedIn, backlinks, performance marketing, and demand generation.**

This is not a role where you simply manage agencies or post content. **You will own execution, experimentation, and measurable growth.**

**What You'll Own**

**1\. SEO \& Organic Growth**

* Own and execute TestOwl’s overall SEO strategy.
* Conduct keyword research and identify high\-intent keywords and content opportunities.
* Optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, documentation, and product pages.
* Build topic clusters and topical authority around software testing, QA automation, test automation, and related topics.
* Handle technical SEO including indexing, crawlability, internal linking, schema, site structure, Core Web Vitals, etc.
* Monitor rankings, organic traffic, signups, demos, and conversions.
* Identify opportunities to increase qualified organic traffic and pipeline.

**2\. AEO \& GEO**

* Develop strategies to improve TestOwl’s visibility across AI\-powered search and answer engines.
* Optimize content for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other emerging discovery platforms.
* Identify questions and topics where TestOwl should appear as a trusted answer/source.
* Build content around search intent, entities, topical authority, FAQs, comparisons, and problem\-based queries.
* Track TestOwl’s visibility across traditional and AI search.

**3\. Performance Marketing \& Paid Acquisition**

* Own TestOwl’s paid acquisition strategy across relevant channels.
* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns on platforms such as:
* Google Ads
* LinkedIn Ads
* Meta Ads
* Retargeting/display platforms where relevant
* Develop campaigns targeting QA leaders, engineering leaders, CTOs, founders, and other relevant B2B SaaS audiences.
* Build and test different campaign types, audiences, creatives, messaging, landing pages, and offers.
* Manage campaign budgets and allocate spend based on performance.
* Track CAC, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, signup rates, demo bookings, and pipeline generated.
* Set up retargeting campaigns for website visitors and engaged audiences.
* Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels and campaigns.
* Work closely with the founder to identify and test new growth opportunities.
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate strong unit economics and quickly cut campaigns that don't perform.

**4\. Content Marketing**

* Develop a monthly content strategy based on business goals, search opportunities, customer pain points, and industry trends.
* Create and/or manage high\-quality blogs, landing pages, comparison pages, use cases, guides, and other content.
* Create content targeting QA leaders, engineering leaders, CTOs, founders, and software teams.
* Repurpose long\-form content into LinkedIn posts, carousels, videos, and other formats.
* Turn product insights, customer conversations, and industry trends into useful content.

**5\. LinkedIn \& Social Media**

* Own TestOwl’s LinkedIn content strategy.
* Create, schedule, and publish content consistently.
* Create:
* Text posts
* Single\-image posts
* Carousels
* Short videos
* Product\-led content
* Founder\-led content
* Educational content
* Industry commentary
* Experiment with hooks, formats, topics, and posting frequency.
* Track reach, engagement, profile visits, website traffic, signups, and leads generated.
* Support LinkedIn paid campaigns when required.

**6\. Backlinks \& Digital PR**

* Develop and execute a sustainable backlink acquisition strategy.
* Identify relevant websites, publications, blogs, directories, communities, and industry platforms.
* Conduct outreach for guest posts, partnerships, resource links, product listings, and other legitimate link\-building opportunities.
* Build relationships within QA, software testing, DevTools, engineering, and SaaS communities.
* Monitor backlink quality and identify opportunities to improve domain authority.
* Avoid spammy or black\-hat SEO practices.

**7\. Growth \& Conversion Optimization**

* Analyze the complete funnel from **impression → click → website visit → signup → demo → customer**.
* Identify drop\-offs and opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Run A/B tests on landing pages, CTAs, messaging, forms, and campaigns.
* Experiment with different acquisition channels, content formats, offers, and audiences.
* Continuously improve CAC, conversion rates, activation, and lead quality.

**8\. Analytics \& Reporting**

* Set up and monitor Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, ad platform analytics, and other relevant tools.
* Build clear reporting around:
* Organic traffic
* Paid traffic
* Keyword rankings
* Leads
* Signups
* Demo bookings
* CAC
* CPL
* ROAS
* Conversion rates
* Backlinks
* LinkedIn performance
* Use data to determine what is working and where to invest more resources.

**9\. Competitor \& Market Research**

* Monitor competitors’ SEO, content, paid advertising, backlinks, social media, and positioning.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities TestOwl can own.
* Research emerging trends in software testing, QA automation, AI\-generated software, developer tools, and SaaS.
* Identify new channels where potential customers are actively researching solutions.

What We're Looking For

You should be a **T\-shaped growth marketer** — broad enough to understand the complete digital marketing funnel and hands\-on enough to execute without depending on agencies.

**Must have:**

* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, SEO, or B2B SaaS marketing.
* Strong practical SEO knowledge.
* Experience running Google Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads.
* Experience with keyword research and content strategy.
* Experience creating content for LinkedIn.
* Experience with backlink building and outreach.
* Strong copywriting skills.
* Understanding of technical SEO.
* Experience with analytics and conversion tracking.
* Ability to analyze campaign and funnel data.
* Strong research and experimentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**Good to have:**

* Experience marketing B2B SaaS or developer\-focused products.
* Experience in DevTools, QA, software testing, cybersecurity, or SaaS.
* Experience with AEO/GEO and AI search optimization.
* Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, Google Tag Manager, etc.
* Basic design skills using Canva/Figma.
* Basic video editing skills.
* Experience with email marketing and marketing automation.
* Experience with Reddit, Product Hunt, Hacker News, Quora, and relevant online communities.

**Who Will Be a Great Fit?**

You will be a great fit if you:

* Are **hands\-on** and comfortable executing yourself.
* Can take an idea from research → content/campaign → distribution → measurement → optimization.
* Think beyond traffic and impressions and care about **leads, signups, CAC, and revenue**.
* Are comfortable managing both organic and paid channels.
* Enjoy experimenting and trying unconventional growth ideas.
* Can write compelling copy.
* Understand that SEO is more than publishing blogs.
* Are curious about how AI is changing search and content discovery.
* Can work independently in a fast\-moving startup environment.

**What This Role Is NOT**

This is **not** a role for someone whose primary experience is:

* Only managing social media.
* Only writing blogs.
* Only running paid ads without understanding organic growth.
* Managing agencies without hands\-on marketing experience.
* Generating large volumes of generic AI\-written content.
* Reporting vanity metrics without connecting them to business outcomes.

We need someone who can **own TestOwl’s entire digital growth engine.**

**Success in the First 90 Days**

Within the first 90 days, you should be able to:

* Build TestOwl’s SEO, content, AEO/GEO, and paid acquisition strategy.
* Identify our highest\-value keywords and growth opportunities.
* Improve important website and landing pages.
* Establish a consistent LinkedIn publishing engine.
* Publish high\-quality SEO content consistently.
* Start generating relevant backlinks.
* Launch and optimize initial Google/LinkedIn paid campaigns.
* Establish retargeting and conversion tracking.
* Build clear growth dashboards and reporting.
* Identify measurable improvements in qualified traffic, signups, demos, and pipeline.

**How to Apply**

Please send:

* Your resume.
* Examples of websites/companies you've worked on.
* SEO results you have achieved.
* Paid campaign results you have achieved, including budgets and key metrics where possible.
* Examples of LinkedIn/content work you've created.
* Examples of successful backlink/outreach campaigns.
* Tools you have hands\-on experience with.
* A brief answer to:

**“If you joined TestOwl tomorrow, what would you do in your first 30 days to increase organic visibility, generate qualified leads, and build a predictable acquisition engine?”**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

 Bangalore

You will translate product capabilities and customer insights into compelling content, stories, and campaigns that help customers unlock greater value from the product.

 5\-8 years of experience in product marketing, customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, content marketing, or a related role.
 



 Strong experience marketing to an existing customer base.
 



 Excellent storytelling, content, and communication skills.

title: Product Marketing
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Marketing Specialist to drive the growth and market positioning of assigned business units. The candidate should be capable of working independently with Business Unit leaders to plan, execute, and track end\-to\-end marketing initiatives that strengthen both business growth and brand health. The role requires close collaboration with sales, product, and subject matter experts to deliver impactful go\-to\-market strategies, demand generation campaigns, and sales enablement programs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Build and execute GTM plans for products, solutions, and services aligned with business unit objectives, ensuring successful product launches and market adoption.
* Content Development: Create and manage high\-quality marketing and sales content, including brochures, presentations, solution briefs, case studies, emailers, campaign assets, website content, and thought leadership materials.
* Campaign Execution: Plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns across digital, email, webinars, events, social media, and partner channels to drive brand awareness, demand generation, and pipeline growth.
* Funnel Management: Own and monitor the end\-to\-end marketing funnel, tracking key conversion metrics from awareness to qualified pipeline. Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and marketing contribution to revenue.
* Sales Enablement: Develop sales enablement assets such as pitch decks, battle cards, competitive positioning, solution briefs, and objection\-handling guides. Partner with sales teams to ensure they have the right messaging, content, and insights to accelerate deal closure.
* Win\-Loss Analysis: Conduct win\-loss analysis by gathering feedback from sales teams and customers to understand buying decisions, competitive dynamics, and market trends. Translate insights into actionable recommendations to refine product positioning, messaging, campaigns, and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Market Research: Conduct market research to understand customer needs, industry trends, analyst insights, and regulatory developments, enabling informed marketing and business decisions.
* Competitive Analysis: Continuously monitor competitor offerings, positioning, messaging, pricing, and go\-to\-market strategies to strengthen SISA's market differentiation.
* Marketing Performance \& Reporting: Track and analyze marketing KPIs, campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution, and ROI. Provide regular performance reports and recommend optimization strategies based on data\-driven insights.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with business units, product teams, sales, customer success, analysts, and subject matter experts to ensure alignment across product messaging, campaigns, customer engagement, and business objectives.

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
Brillio is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to lead marketing programmes for the BFSI vertical. This role will be responsible for building and executing integrated field marketing, ABM, demand generation, executive engagement, and sales\-aligned campaigns for priority BFSI accounts.
 



 The role requires strong B2B technology marketing experience, BFSI industry understanding, and the ability to work closely with sales, Client Partners, growth leaders, alliances, and marketing teams to create access, open new buying centres, source pipeline, and accelerate opportunities.
 



 The ideal candidate will have experience in field marketing, ABM, campaign execution, stakeholder mapping, event marketing, CRM/marketing automation, and pipeline reporting. Experience in IT services, consulting, digital transformation, SaaS, or enterprise technology marketing is preferred.
 



  





**Role Title** 




**Field Marketing Manager – BFSI Vertical** 




**Location** 




 Bangalore / Hybrid / Flexible based on business requirements
 



**Function** 




 Marketing
 



**Reporting To** 




 Director / Senior Director – Field, Digital \& Demand Marketing
 



**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a high\-impact
 **Field Marketing Manager – BFSI Vertical** 
 to drive Brillio’s marketing strategy, demand generation, account\-based marketing, and executive engagement programmes for Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance accounts.
 



 This role will work closely with BFSI vertical leaders, Client Partners, Growth teams, Sales, Alliances, Practice Marketing, Digital Marketing, and Marketing Operations to build and execute integrated marketing programmes that create new demand, open buying centres, accelerate opportunities, and expand relationships within strategic BFSI accounts.
 



 The ideal candidate will bring strong B2B technology marketing experience, a sharp understanding of BFSI business priorities, strong sales alignment, and the ability to translate industry themes such as AI, data modernisation, customer experience, risk, compliance, cloud, ServiceNow, and digital transformation into pipeline\-generating campaigns.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. BFSI Vertical Marketing Strategy** 



* Own and execute the field marketing plan for the BFSI vertical across priority existing accounts and net\-new target accounts.
* Translate BFSI business priorities into integrated GTM campaigns, account plays, executive engagement programmes, and sales enablement assets.



**2\. Account\-Based Marketing and Demand Generation** 



* Develop and execute ABM programmes for priority BFSI accounts, including account research, buying\-centre mapping, persona segmentation, campaign orchestration, and engagement tracking.
* Build tailored campaigns for banking, capital markets, cards and payments, insurance, asset and wealth management, and financial services technology buyers.
* Drive lead generation, meeting creation, opportunity influence, and measurable pipeline contribution.



**3\. Sales and Client Partner Alignment** 



* Serve as the primary marketing partner for BFSI sales leaders, Client Partners, and Growth teams.
* Build strong working relationships with account teams to understand account plans, whitespace opportunities, active pursuits, competitive context, and stakeholder priorities.
* Support account teams with campaign assets, executive briefing materials, personalised outreach messaging, account intelligence, deal\-specific proof points, and event follow\-up plans.
* Help sales teams expand into new lines of business, buying centres, and decision\-maker groups within existing BFSI accounts.



**4\. Executive Engagement and Field Programmes** 



* Plan and execute high\-value BFSI field programmes such as CXO roundtables, private dinners, innovation forums, account\-specific workshops, alliance\-led events, and industry conferences.
* Manage end\-to\-end field programme execution including audience strategy, invitee lists, messaging, speaker coordination, sales alignment, logistics, follow\-up plans, and ROI tracking.
* Partner with leadership and subject\-matter experts to deliver compelling BFSI narratives and differentiated Brillio points of view.



**5\. Campaign Content and Messaging** 



* Work with content, design, practice marketing, and solution teams to develop BFSI\-specific assets such as POVs, solution briefs, case studies, executive emails, campaign landing pages, event themes, pitch narratives, and social content.
* Build messaging around BFSI transformation themes including:
* AI\-led banking and insurance transformation



**6\. Marketing Operations, Measurement and Reporting** 



* Track and report campaign performance across engagement, MQLs, meetings, opportunities, pipeline influenced, pipeline sourced, opportunity acceleration, and revenue impact.
* Use platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot/Marketo, Demandbase/ABM tools, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, analytics dashboards, and intent platforms to manage campaigns and measure outcomes.



**7\. Alliance and Partner Marketing** 



* Collaborate with strategic alliance teams to build BFSI\-focused partner campaigns with platforms such as Microsoft, AWS, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and other relevant ecosystem partners.
* Identify partner\-led entry points into strategic BFSI accounts and build joint value propositions, campaign themes, and executive engagement motions.
* Support co\-marketing programmes, joint events, solution showcases, partner webinars, and account\-specific alliance plays.



**Required Experience and Qualifications** 



* 7–10 years of B2B marketing experience, preferably in IT services, consulting, digital transformation, SaaS, technology, or enterprise services.
* Strong experience in field marketing, vertical marketing, demand generation, ABM, or integrated campaign management.
* Experience working with BFSI clients or marketing to banking, financial services, insurance, capital markets, payments, asset management, or wealth management audiences.
* Proven ability to partner with sales and Client Partner teams to build marketing programmes that influence pipeline and accelerate opportunities.
* Strong understanding of enterprise buying committees, account\-based marketing, stakeholder mapping, and persona\-based engagement.
* Hands\-on experience with campaign planning, event execution, email marketing, paid media, social campaigns, webinars, executive engagement, and content\-led demand generation.
* Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, ABM, and analytics platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Demandbase, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Power BI, or similar tools.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to convert complex technology and industry themes into compelling business narratives for senior BFSI audiences



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior experience in a digital engineering, consulting, IT services, or enterprise technology organisation.
* Exposure to AI, data and analytics, cloud, customer experience, ServiceNow, cybersecurity, intelligent automation, or enterprise platform transformation.
* Experience building marketing programmes for named strategic accounts.
* Strong comfort with data\-driven decision\-making and campaign performance analysis.
* Ability to work across global teams and support campaigns for US, UK, Europe, or India markets.
* Experience managing executive roundtables, closed\-door leadership forums, industry events, analyst\-led programmes, or alliance\-led GTM campaigns.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to influence without authority.



  





**Leadership Qualities** 



* Customer Advocacy \- Ensures customer success on stated and unstated business priorities through strategic advice and market leading solutions.
* Owner’s Mindset \- Is passionate about Brillio’s business, deeply committed to its success and makes decisions that are in the best interest of the firm.
* Innovation Ethos \- Embraces ambiguity and adopts relentless experimentation to challenge current practices and enable continuous growth.
* Execution with Pace \- Displays agility to deliver high quality results in the face of changing stakeholder expectations.
* Big Picture Thinking \- Creates a common definition of shared success and sets bold targets that inspire the team towards new horizons.
* Winning Through Teams \- Enables a culture of collaboration and empowers teams to "raise their game” in order to create a winning formula.

title: Marketing Programs Manager - Europe Strategic Market Unit
description:
Job description:

Proactively collaborating with stakeholders across the business to drive integrated programs aligned to ABM, Events, and Campaigns to enhance Wipro’s reputation in the market.

 Orchestrate key marketing programs at a Pan\-Europe level in close collaboration with the Field Marketing leads across the region. Specifically:

Coordinate marketing resources to deliver relevant industry content and a joined\-up approach, feeding 1\-to\-1 and Industry cluster ABM.

 •    Alliance Partner collaboration: Work proactively with Alliance Partner marketing colleagues and Wipro’s regional Partner leaders to build regional programs that attract MDF and can be rolled out across Europe to enhance our brand reputation and client outreach efforts.
   

 •    KPI Measurement \& Data Insights: Utilize analytics platforms working closely with the MarTech team to understand program impact and create dashboards/reports to interpret and visualize outcomes to guide others.
 


 E͏xperience:
 
 We’re looking for an energetic Enterprise B2B Marketing professional, with experience working in fast\-paced, large matrix environments. The successful candidate will be a strong communicator and proactive collaborator, capable of leading teams and projects, and a track\-record of driving change and impact within the function. Specifically:
   

 •    Minimum 10 years’ B2B marketing experience, preferably working in IT Services, SaaS or Technology industries. Ideally with experience aligned to the Europe region.
   

 •    A strong team player who demonstrates good communication skills and initiative.

 •    Excellent knowledge of marketing channels, technology and platforms, ideally Salesforce.com, Marketo, and 6Sense or similar.
   

 •    Good organizational skills, experience of working in a fast\-paced environment, and ability to effectively coordinate multiple stakeholders.
   

 •    Strong analytical skills with ability to highlight key insights in an impactful and simple way.
   

 •    High energy self\-starter with a can\-do attitude, and ability to learn quickly.
 


 ͏
 




 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions. 
 



 Applications from people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.

title: Manager - Content and Marketing
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a strategic and experienced communications and marketing leader to drive the media, content, communications and brand storytelling agenda for Inspire Institute of Sport (IIS). The role is responsible for shaping how IIS is positioned and represented across media, digital platforms, athlete storytelling, institutional communications and key sporting moments. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, working closely with athletes, coaches, leadership, partners, donors, agencies and internal teams.
 



  





 The role will serve as a key custodian of the IIS brand narrative — defining what we say, how we say it, where we say it and how we build sustained visibility for IIS, its athletes, programmes and impact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Media, Communications \& Brand Strategy** 



* Develop and lead the annual media, communications and content strategy for IIS, aligned with organisational priorities, sporting calendars and long\-term brand objectives.
* Own IIS's external narrative across earned media, digital, social, institutional and stakeholder communications.
* Develop proactive media strategies around major sporting milestones, athlete achievements, institutional announcements and strategic initiatives.
* Build and maintain relationships with relevant national and sports media, publishers and other communication stakeholders.
* Lead communications around high\-profile sporting events, including the Commonwealth Games, Asian Games and LA 2028 journey.
* Identify and manage reputational and communications risks, including crisis and sensitive communications where required.



**2\. Content \& Storytelling** 



* Own the overall content strategy and editorial direction across IIS's digital and social ecosystem.
* Establish and maintain a consistent brand voice, tone and visual/editorial language across platforms.
* Develop content narratives around athletes, coaches, programmes, sporting achievements, institutional milestones and IIS's wider impact.
* Lead the ideation and execution of content across formats including video, social, long\-form storytelling, photography, graphics, web and editorial content.
* Plan and oversee content calendars around sporting events, athlete milestones, campaigns and institutional priorities.
* Work closely with creative teams, production partners, agencies and internal stakeholders to deliver high\-quality content.



**3\. Marketing \& Campaigns** 



* Develop and execute integrated marketing and communication campaigns to strengthen IIS's brand awareness and positioning.
* Lead content\-led launches and campaigns for new sports programmes, initiatives and IIS properties.
* Develop campaigns that translate IIS's athlete development and sporting impact into compelling public\-facing narratives.
* Oversee campaign planning, execution, measurement and optimisation across relevant channels.
* Identify opportunities to leverage major sporting events and cultural moments to increase IIS's visibility.



**4\. Athlete \& Sporting Communications** 



* Develop storytelling frameworks that bring IIS athlete journeys, performances and human\-interest stories to life.
* Lead communications and content planning around athletes participating in major international competitions.

title: Manager - Curriculum & Early Child Development
description:
**Designation Manager – Early Childhood Development \& Curriculum**

**Location: Domlur, Bengaluru**

**Level: Manager / Department Lead**

**About the Role** 

Zoodle Kid is looking for an experienced Early Childhood Development \& Curriculum Manager to lead the academic and developmental integrity of our programs for children aged 0–6 years. We are not looking for someone whose expertise is limited to curriculum writing or academic content. This role requires a professional with a deep understanding of Early Childhood Development (ECD), Early Childhood Education (ECE), pedagogy, developmental milestones, child psychology, age\-appropriate learning, and play\-based development along with the leadership maturity to translate that knowledge into high\-quality programs and a capable curriculum team. The person will take ownership of curriculum development, validation, research, team training, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement across Zoodle Kid's programs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1\. Early Childhood Development \& Pedagogy

* Bring strong subject expertise in child development from birth to 6 years.
* Understand developmental milestones across cognitive, language, physical, social, emotional, behavioural, and creative domains.
* Ensure activities and learning experiences are developmentally appropriate for each age group.
* Apply sound principles of ECE, pedagogy, child psychology, play\-based learning, and experiential learning.
* Translate developmental concepts and research into practical experiences parents can conduct with children at home.
* Understand individual developmental differences and avoid a one\-size\-fits\-all approach to childhood development.

2\. Curriculum Leadership

* Lead the research, development, refinement, and continuous improvement of Zoodle Kid's age\-wise curriculum.
* Ensure strong progression and continuity across 0–6 months, 6–12 months, 1–2, 2–3, 3–4, and 4–6 years. Ensure activities have clear developmental objectives rather than being included merely for engagement.
* Maintain alignment between activities, developmental milestones, learning outcomes, materials, and Zoodle Kid's 9Q framework.
* Identify curriculum gaps, redundancies, developmental mismatches, and opportunities for improvement.

3\. Validation \& Quality Assurance

* A major responsibility of this position is the ability to identify what is wrong, understand why it is wrong, and determine how it should be corrected.
* Validate curriculum documents, activity guides, scripts, learning materials, program videos, and parent\-facing content.
* Check for developmental appropriateness, factual accuracy, age suitability, safety, practicality, and pedagogical value.
* Identify errors or weak developmental reasoning before content reaches parents.
* Troubleshoot inconsistencies and provide clear corrective direction to the team.
* Establish validation checklists, standards, and review processes for curriculum quality.
* Coordinate expert/SME validation wherever specialist intervention is required.

4\. Research \& Development

* Continuously research developments in early childhood development, neuroscience, psychology, pedagogy, parenting, and learning sciences.
* Evaluate research critically rather than relying solely on trends or generic online information.
* Convert relevant research into practical, parent\-friendly learning experiences.
* Work with psychologists, pediatricians, therapists, educators, and other subject matter experts where necessary.
* Strengthen the scientific and developmental foundation behind Zoodle Kid's programs.

5\. Team Leadership \& Training

* Lead and mentor curriculum developers, associates, researchers, and related contributors.
* Train the team on ECD, developmental milestones, pedagogy, research methods, validation standards, and Zoodle Kid's framework.
* Be capable of explaining why something is developmentally right or wrong rather than simply approving or rejecting it.
* Conduct regular knowledge sessions, reviews, feedback discussions, and quality audits.
* Delegate effectively while maintaining accountability for final curriculum quality.
* Build a team capable of independently researching, questioning, validating, and improving content.

6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Video, Design, Product/Tech, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure accurate execution of curriculum.
* Translate curriculum requirements into clear instructions for non\-academic teams.
* Support Program Advisors and parent\-facing teams with developmental knowledge and training.
* Analyse recurring parent questions and feedback to identify opportunities for program improvement.

**Education Qualifications:**

* Master's degree preferred in one or more of the following: Early Childhood Education / Early Childhood Care \& Education Child Development / Human Development Developmental or Child Psychology Education / Pedagogy Psychology with strong ECD experience Developmental Sciences
* Other closely related disciplines Relevant professional certifications in ECE/ECCE, Montessori, developmental psychology, special education, or child development are an advantage.

**Experience** 

* Ideally 3\+ years of relevant experience, with meaningful exposure to early childhood development or education.
* Prior experience leading a curriculum, pedagogy, academic, ECD or program development team is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in curriculum design, review, validation, and team training. Experience working specifically with the 0–6 age group is highly desirable.
* Depth of expertise will be valued over years of experience alone.

*We Are Specifically Looking For*

We need someone who can look at an activity, curriculum document, or program video and confidently answer: **Is this right for this child's age?**  What developmental purpose does it serve? **Which milestone or developmental domain does it support?**  Is the underlying explanation scientifically and pedagogically sound? **Is it safe and realistic for a parent to execute?**  What is wrong with it, if anything? **How should we correct it?**  Can I teach my team to understand the same reasoning? If a candidate can consistently answer these questions with depth and clarity, they are likely the kind of professional we are looking for.

Pay: From ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Planning Lead
description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


Role purpose
  

The Planning Manager leads end\-to\-end demand, supply, production and inventory planning for the Vision Care business. The role ensures reliable product availability, optimized inventory and efficient use of manufacturing and distribution capacity while balancing customer service, cost and working\-capital objectives.
  

Key responsibilities
  

1\. Sales and operations planning
  

* 

Lead the monthly S\&OP/IBP cycle across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Manufacturing, Procurement and Logistics.
  

* 

Consolidate demand, capacity, supply, inventory and financial plans.
  

* 

Identify gaps and scenarios and facilitate management decisions.
  

* 

Maintain one agreed operational plan and track actions from planning reviews.
  

* 

Translate annual business plans into monthly and weekly operational plans.
  

2\. Demand planning
  

* 

Lead statistical forecasting and market\-input collection for lenses, coatings, consumables and related products.
  

* 

Review historical sales, seasonality, promotions, launches, tenders and customer trends.
  

* 

Challenge assumptions and resolve differences between commercial forecasts and statistical demand.
  

* 

Manage forecast accuracy and bias by product family, channel and region.
  

* 

Establish planning approaches for new products, phase\-outs and intermittent demand.
  

3\. Supply and production/Import planning
  

* 

Develop feasible supply and production plans across Import/Local plants, laboratories, distribution centers and external suppliers.
  

* 

Balance demand against material, machine, labor and supplier capacity.
  

* 

Set production priorities and manage bottlenecks, shortages and backlog.
  

* 

Coordinate make\-to\-stock, make\-to\-order and prescription\-lens requirements.
  

* 

Ensure timely escalation of supply risks with clear recovery plans.
  

* 

Work with Procurement on supplier constraints, lead times and material availability.
  

4\. Inventory management
  

* 

Define inventory targets, safety stocks, reorder parameters and segmentation policies.
  

* 

Optimize inventory across raw materials, semi\-finished lenses, finished goods and consumables.
  

* 

Monitor ageing, slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
  

* 

Coordinate mitigation actions for excess stock and expiry or obsolescence risks.
  

* 

Improve working capital without compromising agreed service levels.
  

5\. Product lifecycle and launch planning
  

* 

Lead supply\-chain readiness for new products, coatings, technologies and portfolio changes.
  

* 

Coordinate demand ramp\-up, material availability, production validation and initial stock.
  

* 

Manage end\-of\-life transitions and depletion of discontinued materials.
  

* 

Minimize write\-offs and customer\-service disruption during portfolio transitions.
  

6\. Customer\-service and exception management
  

* 

Monitor fill rate, order fulfilment, backorders and delivery performance.
  

* 

Lead cross\-functional response to major shortages and demand changes.
  

* 

Prioritize constrained supply using agreed commercial and customer\-service rules.
  

* 

Communicate recovery dates, risks and alternatives to relevant stakeholders.
  

7\. Systems, data and process improvement
  

* 

Ensure accurate planning parameters and master data in SAP and associated planning tools.
  

* 

Drive planning automation, analytics and process standardization.
  

* 

Improve forecast models, planning horizons, frozen periods and exception\-management rules.
  

* 

Support ERP, APS, IBP and digital supply\-chain initiatives.
  

* 

Maintain planning documentation, controls and audit readiness.
  

8\. Team leadership
  

* 

Build analytical, commercial and supply\-chain capabilities within the team.
  

* 

Promote fact\-based decisions, accountability and cross\-functional collaboration.
  

* 

Establish succession and competency\-development plans.
  

Key performance indicators
  

* 

Forecast accuracy and forecast bias
  

* 

Customer service level, OTIF and fill rate
  

* 

Production\-plan adherence
  

* 

Inventory value, days of inventory and inventory turns
  

* 

Slow\-moving and obsolete inventory
  

* 

Backorder value and ageing
  

* 

Capacity utilization
  

* 

Planning master\-data accuracy
  

* 

S\&OP action closure and decision quality
  

* 

Working capital and logistics\-expedite/Diversion costs  

  

Qualifications
  

* 

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Operations, Engineering (STEM background mandatory).
  

* 

Master’s degree or MBA is advantageous.
  

* 

APICS CPIM/CSCP, IBF or equivalent certification is advantageous.
  

* 

Typically, 6\-8 years of supply\-chain experience, including at least 4 years in a planning role in handling complex SKU portfolio handling and assortment planning
  

* 

Experience in medical technology, optical products, healthcare, precision manufacturing or consumer goods is desirable.
  

Technical competencies
  

* 

Strong knowledge of demand, supply, production and inventory planning.
  

* 

Practical experience with S\&OP or IBP processes.
  

* 

Advanced SAP experience, ideally including SD, MM, PP and APO/IBP.
  

* 

Strong Excel and data\-analysis capabilities; Power BI or similar tools are advantageous.
  

* 

Understanding of MRP, capacity planning, safety stock and product lifecycle management.
  

* 

Ability to analyze complex product portfolios with short lead\-time and customized\-order requirements.
  

* 

Familiarity with Lean, continuous improvement and root\-cause analysis.
  

* 

Leadership and behavioral competencies
  

* 

Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
  

* 

Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  

* 

Clear communication and effective meeting facilitation.
  

* 

Customer\-focused and commercially aware decision\-making.
  

* 

Confidence in managing ambiguity, constraints and competing priorities.
  

* 

Strong people leadership and coaching capability.
  

* 

High ownership, integrity and attention to detail.

title: Manager Procurement
description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


**Role Definition:**



Manages function and staff responsible for procurement of materials and services needed in the manufacturing process.


### **Responsibilities**


* Defining and communicating rules for supplier bids and managing high\-impact purchases. Evaluating the qualification of suppliers and negotiating prices.
* Managing daily activities associated with requesting quotes, issuing purchase orders, invoice/contract approval, grief resolution, job instruction, vendor contacts, supplier quality/delivery, record keeping and all other purchasing related activities.
* Assessing purchasing decisions through the analysis of historical and market information; recommending improvements.
* Managing the quality of purchased goods and services based on specified requirements. Solving major supplier related problems.


**Degree Requirement:** Bachelor’s / Master’s from Tier 1 University or College


**Skill Descriptors:**


*Quality Management:* Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Interprets results of quantitative and statistical tools and explains results to others.
* Develops programs for motivating personnel to meet or exceed quality goals.
* Communicates key benefits of a quality management process.
* Conducts and directs quality reviews.
* Develops expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.
* Develops quality assurance processes based on Six Sigma, ISO 9000 or Baldrige principles.


*Effective Communications:* Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
* Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
* Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
* Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
* Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
* Maintains focus on the topic at hand.


*Negotiating:* Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Ensures negotiators have awareness of complementary yet diverse interests.
* Successfully completes significant negotiations, both internal and external.
* Details the risks of negotiation breakdown from each party's perspective.
* Protects own position, while demonstrating willingness to achieve win\-win.
* Identifies similarities and differences in position and assesses impact on discussions.
* Detects and addresses lack of progress or a stalemate.


*Audit and Compliance Function:* Knowledge of major responsibilities and tasks of Audit and Compliance (A\&C) function; ability to manage the operation of A\&C function in various business environment.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Manages one or more A\&C functions or units.
* Facilitates compliance\-related business process implementation or improvement initiatives.
* Implements specific organizational changes made in response to the Sarbanes\-Oxley Act.
* Contributes to development of A\&C strategies and plans.
* Improves key relationships and dependencies among Audit, IT and other business functions.
* Contributes to the establishment of best practices for A\&C.


*Business Intelligence:* Knowledge of business intelligence; ability to utilize business processes and technologies for gathering, storing, analyzing, and providing access to data that helps the organization make better business decisions.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Organizes and maintains data to be captured in the data warehouse for BI applications.
* Evaluates alternative BI products in terms of their potential value to organization.
* Develops targeted marketing campaigns based on BI analysis.
* Develops processes for transforming aggregate data into useful business information.
* Analyzes BI gained from multiple and diverse environments.
* Evaluates key benefits, drawbacks and rationale for existing BI activities.


*Category Management:* Knowledge of category management within an organization's goods and services sector; ability to use this knowledge to analyze and improve the end\-to\-end procurement process and maximize business profitability.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Advises on streamlining the procurement strategy to realize the strategic benefits of category management.
* Designs and develops supplier agreements and procurement policies with standard terms and conditions.
* Identifies roadblocks in the implementation of category management and recommends innovative solutions.
* Prepares reports to evaluate the impact of category management on the procurement process and present ROI data to management.
* Supervises the execution of all stages of the category management process.
* Trains others on category management to ensure a streamlined procurement process.


*Supplier Management \- MFG:* Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Facilitates supplier partnering arrangements that share risk and reward.
* Monitors supplier performance; works to resolve discrepancies between performance and agreements.
* Develops quality standards and controls for suppliers.
* Builds and maintains partnerships with multiple and/or large suppliers.
* Evaluates issues and terminates supplier relationships as appropriate; works with legal departments.
* Ensures the fulfillment of report and record\-keeping requirements.


*Purchasing Tasks and Activities:* Knowledge of policies, regulations and processes of purchasing; ability to use practices and procedures for procurement of materials, components, equipment and services.



Level Extensive Experience:


* Works with the implementation of complex purchasing programs and tasks.
* Advises on the appropriate solutions to complex purchasing activity problems.

* Improves procurement processes to maximize products or services efficiency and effectiveness.
* Teaches others how to use advanced technologies and tools for purchasing activities.
* Evaluates issues and considerations for purchasing various goods and services.

**Company Description** 
 Ashtech India Pvt Ltd is an ISO 9001:2008 certified organization and a leading processor, manufacturer, distributor, and exporter of fly ash and infrastructure\-related products, with a turnover exceeding USD 55 million. The company operates with a strong asset base of over 1,000 experienced team members and a fleet of more than 550 commercial vehicles, enabling reliable quality, competitive pricing, and responsive service. Ashtech is recognized as a pioneer in introducing fly ash to the construction industries in India, Africa, and the Middle East, supplying processed fly ash for major infrastructure projects domestically and internationally. The company also develops innovative products such as SUPERPOZZ P500 (Ultra Fine Fly Ash), and runs advanced cement production units and ready\-mix concrete plants. The manager will conduct market analysis, track competitor activity, and prepare forecasts and reports to support growth and profitability targets. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with operations and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery, maintaining strong customer relationships, negotiating contracts and pricing, and representing the company at industry events and client meetings. The role also requires mentoring and guiding the sales team, ensuring adherence to company policies, and promoting Ashtech’s product portfolio and brand presence in the region.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills with diverse stakeholders, including contractors, developers, and project consultants.
* Proven experience working closely with operations, logistics, and supply chain teams to align customer demand with product availability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

* Comfort with frequent on\-site client visits in the Greater Chennai Area and surrounding regions

description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Job Purpose**



To lead a Business Unit wide multi\-functional team which manages all phases of the NSI (New Source Introduction) process for component\-sourcing projects.


**Job Duties:**



This position works with Engine Components \& Thermal Systems (ECTS) Engineering team, Platform Engineering, Customer Service, Purchasing, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Business Services, PMO, PSLD, Reman, and Suppliers to plan and execute critical sourcing projects for 3500, C175, 3600 \& Med Vee ECTS components.

Typical major internal customers include employees from two or more work groups in a Division. External contacts include suppliers from whom Caterpillar procure material to produce engines. description:
**Overview**
 RGM strategy Playbook \- Associate plays a pivotal role in our organization, with a primary focus on brand ladder and price pack architecture analysis, Mix Management and Promo Strategy. This role encompasses a range of responsibilities related to optimizing our product and pricing strategies to maximize brand equity, profitability, and consumer engagement.
   

  

 Key responsibilities of the Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate include:
   

  

* Conducting in\-depth market research and data analysis to identify and evaluate brand positioning / price pack architecture opportunities
* Analyzing consumer behavior and preferences to gain insights into how our brand ladder / pricing strategies impact purchasing decisions
* Developing and refining brand ladder and PPA models and methodologies to streamline decision\-making / enhance operational efficiency
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that our brand and pricing strategies align with overarching business objectives and regulatory requirements
* Utilizing data\-driven insights to enhance the overall consumer experience and perception of our brands and pricing structures
* Contributing to the long\-term brand and pricing strategy of the organization, actively participating in the creation of innovative approaches to optimize brand equity and profitability


 The Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate leverages advanced analytical skills and tools to shape our brand and pricing strategies, ensuring they are aligned with our strategic goals, compliance standards, and customer satisfaction objectives
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Perform advanced analytics using Tableau/Power BI and develop predictive models, regression modeling, price elasticity analysis, and promotion optimization to extract actionable insights from data
* Collaborate on sector NRM strategic projects, such as promotions optimization, terms priorities, competitor benchmarking, and Price Pack Architecture (PPA) initiatives, to drive revenue realization
* Conduct statistical and trend analysis to identify market opportunities, highlight sector strengths, and provide recommended corrective actions to enhance performance

**Qualifications**
 Key Skills/Experience Required
   

  

* Broader data analysis capabilities. Previous experience in Consumer Insights, Key account Management, Trade Marketing or CPG consulting

* Excellent visualisation skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable solutions and processes, enabling data\-driven decision\-making
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a strong command of PowerPoint, with the ability to quickly learn various in\-house software applications for data analysis and reporting
* Working knowledge of Power BI software is added advantage
* Ability to function effectively in a team environment and collaborate with individuals across the organization, as pricing and promotions strategies often require cross\-functional teamwork
* Good verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders and present findings and recommendations in a clear and compelling manner


 Differentiating Competencies Required
   

  

* Highly organized and responsive, with ability to work to SLAs and tight deadlines

* Language skills \- English fluent
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; proactively communicates using appropriate methods for situation and audience in clear, concise and professional manner

title: District Manager, Visakhapatnam
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**Job Summary**
---------------

  

The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.


The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.


This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.


This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.


The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.


As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.

**Principal Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------


**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in\-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts \& seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.
 **Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical \& product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.
 **Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports \& expenses.
* Prepare ad\-hoc reports on an as\-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co\-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.
 **Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles \& data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers \& staff.
**Expected Behaviour**
----------------------



The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;


We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.

* Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.


We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world\-class integrity and ethical business practices.

* Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.


We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.

* Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.


We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

* Give back to our communities and people in need.


We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Science Graduate with 3 – 5 yrs of work experience
* Preferred Qualifications in B.Pharma, Business, Marketing or Paramedical discipline.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

* Previous experience in OR/OT surgical support experience, preferably in orthopedic
* Demonstrated sales abilities \& a track record of successful selling to the medical profession

**Expected Areas of Competence (i.e. KSAs)**

-----------------------

title: Head- Group Marketing & Branding
description:
**Role Purpose** 




 The Head – Group Marketing \& Brand will be responsible for the overall marketing, branding and communication strategy across the Group and its businesses.
 



 The role will work closely with Group leadership and individual business heads to establish a consistent brand direction, strengthen the market position of each business, support new business and brand launches, and ensure effective marketing execution across all channels.
 



 The position will have end\-to\-end responsibility for Group marketing and brand activities, from strategy and planning through implementation, performance review and governance.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Group Marketing Strategy** 



* Develop and implement the overall marketing strategy for the Group and its businesses.
* Prepare annual marketing plans aligned with business priorities and growth objectives.
* Work with business heads to understand market requirements and develop relevant marketing plans for each business.
* Identify market opportunities, customer segments, competitor activity and emerging trends.
* Establish clear marketing priorities, budgets, timelines and expected outcomes.
* Review marketing performance regularly and recommend changes based on business requirements and results.



**2\. Brand Strategy \& Management** 



* Define and manage the brand positioning, architecture and identity of the Group and individual businesses.
* Establish brand guidelines and ensure consistent implementation across all companies and communication channels.
* Review existing brands and recommend repositioning, rebranding or consolidation where required.
* Ensure clear differentiation between businesses while maintaining an appropriate Group identity.
* Act as the custodian of the Group's brands and approve key brand and creative output.



 This expands the existing responsibility for portfolio strategy, positioning, architecture and brand standards.
 



**3\. New Brands, Products \& Business Launches** 



* Lead the marketing and branding requirements for new businesses, products and market entries.
* Manage brand development from concept to launch, including market research, positioning, naming, identity, packaging and go\-to\-market planning.
* Develop launch plans in coordination with business, sales and management teams.
* Support consumer\-facing/FMCG brands as applicable across the Group.
* Monitor post\-launch performance and recommend corrective actions where required.



 Richa's current KRA already places significant emphasis on taking brands from concept through market launch, including FMCG category, proposition, identity and packaging.
 



**4\. Digital Marketing \& Online Presence** 



* Lead the digital marketing strategy across Group businesses.
* Oversee Group and business websites, including content, user experience, SEO and ongoing optimization.
* Develop social media strategy and ensure appropriate management of Group and individual brand channels.
* Oversee digital campaigns, search, content marketing, email/CRM and other relevant channels.
* Ensure appropriate use of analytics and reporting to measure traffic, engagement, leads and campaign performance.
* Keep the Group's digital presence current and aligned with changes in search and AI\-driven discovery.



**5\. Marketing Campaigns \& Business Support** 



* Develop marketing campaigns based on the commercial objectives of individual businesses.
* Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to support lead generation, customer acquisition and market development.
* Develop appropriate marketing material, presentations, corporate profiles, brochures and sales support material.
* Ensure marketing activities have defined objectives, target audiences, budgets and measurable outcomes.
* Track campaign performance and marketing contribution to business growth.



**6\. Content \& Corporate Communication** 



* Establish the Group's communication and content framework.
* Ensure consistency in corporate messaging, tone of voice and key business narratives.
* Oversee corporate profiles, presentations, websites, marketing collateral and external communication.
* Review and approve key external communication before release.
* Ensure communication reflects the positioning and objectives of the relevant Group company.



**7\. Public Relations \& Reputation Management** 



* Develop and oversee PR and external communication plans for relevant Group businesses.
* Manage media, PR agencies and external communication partners.
* Support leadership communication, announcements, launches and corporate events.
* Monitor external coverage and manage reputational matters in coordination with management.
* Ensure external statements are appropriately reviewed and authorized.



**8\. Investor \& Corporate Communication** 



* Support marketing and communication requirements for listed Group entities.
* Coordinate the narrative, content and design of annual reports, quarterly reports, investor presentations and other corporate communication.
* Work with Finance, Company Secretarial, Investor Relations and leadership teams to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Ensure communication is completed within required reporting and governance timelines.



**9\. Agency \& Vendor Management** 



* Identify and appoint suitable marketing, creative, digital, website and PR agencies.
* Define scope, deliverables, timelines and commercials.
* Negotiate contracts and monitor agency performance.
* Review and approve agency output before release.
* Build an appropriate external partner network while controlling quality and cost.



**10\. Marketing Budget \& Performance** 



* Prepare and manage the Group marketing budget.
* Allocate budgets based on business priorities and approved marketing plans.
* Monitor marketing expenditure and ensure appropriate cost control.
* Establish marketing KPIs and reporting dashboards.
* Measure campaign effectiveness, digital performance, lead generation, brand growth and return on marketing spend.
* Present periodic marketing updates to Group leadership.



**11\. Team Leadership \& Group Governance** 



* Build and manage the Group marketing and brand function.
* Define responsibilities between Group Marketing and marketing resources within individual businesses.
* Set priorities, review performance and develop the capabilities of the team.
* Establish approval processes and marketing governance across Group companies.
* Ensure Group businesses follow agreed brand, communication and marketing standards.
* Take ownership of marketing requirements from planning through execution and closure.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* 15\+ years of experience in marketing, brand management, corporate communication or related functions, with significant leadership experience.
* Experience managing multiple brands, businesses or business verticals at Group level is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience in brand strategy, positioning and brand development.
* Experience developing and executing marketing strategies linked to business growth.
* Good understanding of digital marketing, performance marketing, social media, SEO, content and analytics.
* Experience launching new brands, products or businesses.
* Experience managing agencies, vendors and marketing budgets.
* Exposure to B2B and B2C/consumer businesses would be preferred.
* Exposure to listed companies, investor communication or annual\-report communication would be an advantage.
* Strong commercial understanding and ability to work closely with promoters, senior leadership and business heads.
* Ability to operate in a fast\-moving Group environment and manage multiple businesses and priorities simultaneously.
* **Hands\-on approach with the ability to build the function, processes and team from the ground up where required.**



  





**Key Competencies** 




 Strategic Marketing \| Brand Management \| Business \& Commercial Understanding \| Digital Marketing \| Performance Marketing \| Corporate Communication \| Brand Launches \| Market Research \| PR \& Reputation Management \| Agency Management \| Budget Management \| Marketing Analytics \| Stakeholder Management \| Team Leadership \| Execution \& Ownership

title: Territory Manager - Immunology & Neurology
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.
  
We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.
  
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.
  
We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.
  
If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  

About Lilly’s India Affiliate
  
Few careers offer the opportunity to work directly for the people your work is ultimately meant to serve.
  
Lilly’s India affiliate is one of them.
  
Whether you are building brand strategies, developing sales capabilities, creating market access, or enabling the teams that do — the work you do here ensures that Lilly’s medicines reach the people who need them.
  
  

Job Description
  
**Broad Objective of the Role:** Enhancing the customer experience by identifying the critical need and delivering optimal pharmaceutical based healthcare solutions to achieve business objectives.
  
  

Analyzing market trends and developing a sales plan; Meeting and engaging designated doctors in the assigned territory, promoting company products to customers; strengthening relationships with stakeholders like doctors, paramedics, retailers and stockists in order to achieve individual and pool sales targets using patient focused selling principles while adhering to Lilly compliance guidelines.
  
  

**Key Customers:** Doctors, paramedical \& hospital staff, retailers and stockists.
  
**Minimum Qualification:** Graduation in any field (preferably Science) with minimum one year of sales work experience.
  
**Key Competencies:** Good communication and presentation skills, basic knowledge of therapeutic area and product segment, Emotional Intelligence, Organizational Skills, Learning agility.
  
  

Area of Responsibility \& Key Activities
  
  

Sales and Territory Planning
  
Develop a detailed territory business plan for the portfolio by making strategic decisions about goals, resource investments, and monitor and measure the plan.
  
  

* Based on Retail Call Audit and market analysis, refresh and update MCL from the universal list provided by sales operations.
* Prepare a retail call list for important retailers.
* Prepare a patch plan as per customer availability and schedule.
* Prioritize business opportunities.
* Plan for achieving targets set by the company.
* Track and analyze weekly sales data in order to identify trends and make required modifications to the plan.
* Performance Metrics: Approval of plan by supervisor; Quality of analysis.


Conducting Customer Calls
  
  

* Meet the required number of customers as per SPP targets and call plan.
* Meet retailers as per SPP target and plan in order to gather information about product trends and competitor data.
* Meet compliance requirements on calls.
* Conduct effective pre\-call planning by setting objectives tailored to customer segment, needs, attitudes, motivations, environment and business priorities, then prepare potential solutions.
* Conduct post\-call analysis and record next call objective in approved CRM tool.
* Use relevant sales materials to address customer questions, objections, and concerns.
* Promote company products to customers as per the Patient Focused Selling Principles and by using aids provided by Marketing.
* Strengthen relationships with all stakeholders.
* Performance Metrics: SPP target v/s achievement; Adherence to compliance requirements; Sales target v/s achievement.


Customer, Paramedic Staff and Retailer Engagement
  
  

* Finalize doctors engagement plan for a Quarter.
* Conduct programs as per plan and steer all related logistics and coordination.
* Plan, develop, and implement effective communication (e.g. presentations) in a variety of settings.
* Identify speakers and audience for conducting programs, work with various departments to ensure timely documentation and certification of the speaker.
* Invite doctors for Marketing led programs.
* Conduct Retailer Awareness Programs.
* Conduct Nurses awareness programs to upgrade the knowledge of paramedic staff.
* Conduct programs as per compliance guidelines.
* Performance Metrics: Informal/formal feedback from stakeholders on quality of programs; Adherence to compliance requirements; Program attendance as per target.


Stockist Management
  
  

* Engage with stockists regularly to strengthen relationship.
* Gather information to analyze sales trends every week.
* Conduct physical stock verification at the Stockist.
* Maintain a balance between first line and second line sales as per the company guidelines.
* Participate in ensuring availability at various retailers like placing and collecting orders.
* Coordinate between Stockist and CFA at the time of closing.
* Identify new stockists and propose to ASM.
* Performance Metrics: Inventory plan v/s achievement.


Sales and SPP Reporting
  
  

* Timely reporting of all the doctor and retailer calls.
* Report details of programs conducted.
* Report any medical services request received from doctors through on\-demand.
* Present sales trends in monthly reviews.
* Performance Metrics: Regular and accurate reporting.


At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.
  
It is how we work.
  
We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.
  
This is not just a policy.
  
It is who we are.
