title: Content Marketing Manager, Prime Video
description:
**Description**
 Join the Prime Video Content Marketing team as a Content Marketing Manager supporting title campaigns across Australia and New Zealand — from global tentpoles to locally relevant content. Based in Mumbai and working AUNZ time\-zone hours, you'll be the operational backbone of AUNZ campaign delivery, coordinating closely with creative, media, social, and PR teams to ensure campaigns launch on time and on brief.
   

  

 This is the first India\-based role dedicated to AUNZ content marketing. You'll sit with the India team locally while embedding into the AUNZ marketing squad day\-to\-day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Support the planning and execution of title marketing campaigns for AUNZ, including global tentpoles and local originals
* Coordinate day\-to\-day with creative, media, social, and PR teams to keep campaigns on track — managing timelines, asset deliveries, feedback loops, and approvals
* Track and report on campaign performance, pulling together post\-campaign recaps and actionable insights to inform future strategy
* Manage operational workflows — briefing agencies, routing assets, maintaining campaign trackers, and ensuring stakeholder alignment
* Contribute to measurement frameworks, compiling data and surfacing trends that help the team optimise campaigns over time
* Support always\-on marketing activity alongside tentpole moments


**What Makes This Role Exciting**
* High\-visibility campaigns — you'll work to support Prime Video's biggest global launches and locally resonant content in AUNZ
* Cross\-functional hub — you'll build strong working relationships with creative, media, social, PR, and regional stakeholders
* Performance lens — you'll develop analytical skills that directly influence how the team allocates effort and investment
* First of its kind — you'll shape what this India\-based AUNZ marketing role looks like as it grows
* Global company, regional impact — you'll be part of a lean, fast\-moving team where your contributions are felt immediately


 This is an individual contributor role based in Mumbai, India. This role requires working AUNZ time\-zone hours.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day starts on AUNZ time, syncing with the Australia and New Zealand teams as their day kicks off:
   

  

 Morning (AUNZ hours): Check\-in on campaign trackers and flag any blockers ahead of the week's title launches. Jump on a stand\-up with the AUNZ creative agency to review asset deliveries . Follow up with the media team on paid placement timelines.
   

  

 Mid\-morning: Join the weekly campaign sync with the PR team to align on press outreach and talent moments tied to an upcoming global tentpole launch. Where necessary, update the campaign timeline and circulate next steps to stakeholders.
   

  

 Afternoon: Pull together performance data from last week's local title launch — compile viewership, social engagement, and media metrics into a recap. Surface key insights and draft recommendations for the next campaign cycle. Share the recap with your manager and the wider AUNZ marketing squad.
   

  

 Late afternoon: Connect with the social team on an upcoming title's content calendar, ensuring visibility across teams against the paid media plan. End the day reviewing media delivery trackers queued for the next tentpole to ensure all details required are on\-track.
   

  

**You'll Spend Your Time Across**
 Campaign coordination and operational delivery (creative, media, social, PR)
   

  

 Performance reporting and campaign measurement
   

  

 Stakeholder communication and cross\-functional alignment
   

  

 You'll regularly collaborate with: Creative producers, media partners, social teams, PR, and the Sr. Content Marketing Manager.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Prime Video Content Marketing team for AUNZ is responsible for bringing Prime Video's content slate to life for audiences across Australia and New Zealand. We develop and execute marketing campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and viewership — spanning global tentpole originals, local titles, and licensed content.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
* Experience managing or working within cross\-functional marketing and creative teams
* Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in multi\-territory campaign management
* Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
* Experience in the entertainment industry
* Experience in a marketing role and proficient with analytic tools
* Experience working independently with minimal supervision
* Experience working within a global company, with multi\-country responsibilities

 * Strong understanding of brand communication, digital marketing, email marketing, and B2B marketing.

* Working knowledge of website management, SEO, Google Analytics/GA4, Search Console, email marketing metrics, and basic digital performance metrics.
* Understanding of paid marketing platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.
* Strong project coordination, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and dependencies.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing performance data and identify actionable insights.
* Proactive approach with the ability to identify issues and opportunities independently.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams, leadership, and external agencies.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled marketing and productivity tools is an advantage.



  




 What You Will DoBrand \& Marketing Communication
 * Develop a strong understanding of YUJ Designs’ brand positioning, tone of voice, messaging, and guidelines.
* Ensure consistency across website content, social media, presentations, newsletters, external communications, and other marketing touchpoints.
* Execute marketing communication activities in coordination with the Marketing Lead and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain and organise key marketing assets, templates, brand collaterals, and communication repositories.



  




 Social Media Management \& Engagement
 * Support monthly social media planning, content calendars, and publishing across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies for content development, creatives, approvals, and publishing.
* Monitor channels and ensure timely responses to comments, messages, mentions, and relevant conversations.
* Track performance and identify content themes, formats, and topics that drive stronger engagement.
* Identify opportunities to drive relevant website traffic, enquiries, and leads through social channels.
* Monitor competitor and industry activity for relevant content and engagement opportunities.



  




 Email Marketing
 * Support email marketing campaigns, including planning, audience segmentation, content coordination, scheduling, and execution.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners on email copy, creatives, approvals, and deployment.
* Maintain email lists and ensure data is accurate, updated, and appropriately segmented.
* Monitor key metrics such as open rates, click\-through rates, engagement, and conversions.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve content, targeting, and engagement.
* Maintain email campaign calendars, templates, and performance trackers.



  




 Website Management \& Health Monitoring
 * Work closely with the Marketing Lead to ensure the website remains accurate, current, consistent, and conversion\-ready.
* Conduct regular website audits to identify:
* Outdated or incorrect information
* Broken links, redirects, or forms
* Missing or incorrect CTAs
* Content, formatting, alignment, or spacing issues
* Incorrect terminology, capitalisation, or punctuation
* Missing or incorrectly placed images
* Mobile responsiveness issues
* Incorrectly linked case studies, blogs, and service pages
* Issues with enquiry journeys
* Document website issues and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Follow up to ensure identified issues are closed and conduct regular website hygiene checks.



  




 Performance Marketing
 * Understand the fundamentals of performance marketing, paid media, and lead\-generation funnels.
* Support performance marketing initiatives across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Coordinate with agencies and internal stakeholders on campaign setup, targeting, creatives, messaging, and landing pages.
* Monitor key metrics including reach, CTR, CPC, CPL, lead quality, and conversion.
* Analyse campaign performance to identify better\-performing audiences, creatives, geographies, and messaging.
* Maintain performance trackers and support campaign reporting and optimisation.



  




 SEO \& Organic Growth
 * Coordinate with SEO partners on keyword implementation and on\-page optimisation.
* Support SEO requirements for new website pages, blogs, case studies, and other content.
* Monitor SEO performance and flag significant traffic or ranking drops.
* Ensure published content includes relevant keywords, metadata, internal links, and appropriate page structure.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic and content visibility.



  




 PR \& Brand Visibility
 * Identify relevant PR opportunities, publications, podcasts, industry platforms, events, and speaking opportunities.
* Coordinate with PR agencies and partners by providing briefs, company information, case studies, research, and leadership inputs.
* Track media coverage and maintain a PR visibility tracker.
* Identify opportunities for YUJ Designs and its leadership team to be featured in relevant business, technology, design, and industry publications.
* Support CEO and leadership thought\-leadership opportunities.
* Identify relevant awards and industry recognitions and coordinate nomination materials and deadlines.



  




 Content \& Proofreading
 * Proofread blogs, social media posts, website content, newsletters, emails, presentations, case studies, and marketing collateral.
* Check grammar, spelling, punctuation, formatting, factual accuracy, and brand language.
* Review content from a reader’s perspective and flag unclear, repetitive, overly generic, AI\-generated, or inconsistent content.
* Work with content and design teams to ensure final marketing assets meet quality standards before publishing.



  




 Marketing Campaign \& Project Coordination
 * Support the Marketing Lead in planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Maintain activity trackers, timelines, ownership matrices, and campaign calendars.
* Coordinate with Design, Content, Technology, SEO, PR, Sales, and external agencies.
* Follow up on action items and ensure timelines are met.
* Maintain records of campaign deliverables, approvals, and publishing schedules.
* Proactively flag delays, dependencies, risks, and gaps to ensure timely execution.



  




 Marketing Analytics \& Reporting
 * Maintain dashboards and trackers covering website traffic, social media, email marketing, lead generation, paid media, SEO, PR visibility, and content performance.
* Support the Marketing Lead with monthly marketing performance reviews.
* Track campaign and channel\-level performance against defined objectives.
* Use analytics and AI\-enabled tools to identify trends, audience behaviour, and performance patterns.
* Translate marketing data into actionable observations and recommendations.



  




 Marketing Operations \& Hygiene
 * Maintain marketing calendars, trackers, databases, and repositories.
* Ensure campaigns and communication assets are systematically archived and updated.
* Maintain databases of media contacts, awards, influencers, partners, industry platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Keep marketing assets, campaign files, reports, and approvals organised and accessible.
* Ensure marketing activities, follow\-ups, deliverables, and dependencies are tracked through completion.



  




 What Success Looks Like
 * Marketing activities are executed consistently, accurately, and on time.
* Social media, email, and digital channels remain active, relevant, and aligned with the YUJ brand.
* Website content and user journeys remain accurate, functional, and conversion\-ready.
* Marketing campaigns are tracked against measurable performance metrics.
* PR and brand visibility opportunities are identified and followed through.
* Marketing content maintains high quality and brand consistency.
* Trackers, calendars, databases, and repositories remain organised and up to date.
* Issues and dependencies are identified proactively and closed without repeated follow\-ups.
* The Marketing Lead has a reliable resource who can independently manage day\-to\-day marketing execution and coordination.

title: Marketing and Funnel Automation - Team Leader
description:
**About The Role\-**
 We are looking for a highly proactive, execution\-oriented, and technology\-driven marketing professional who can manage day\-to\-day marketing execution across social media, WhatsApp, email, events, campaigns, and reporting.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who understands that marketing is not just about creating content\- it is about ensuring that the right message reaches the right audience at the right time, across the right channels. You will work closely with the CMO, marketing team, operations team, designers, video editors, and clients to ensure campaigns and events are executed smoothly from planning to reporting.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should also have a strong understanding of marketing automation, CRM systems, AI tools, workflow integrations, spreadsheets, and data analysis.  A strong understanding of WhatsApp Business API (WABA), WhatsApp broadcasts, social media platforms, Meta Business Suite, email marketing, basic performance marketing, marketing automation, Zapier, Pabbly, n8n or similar automation platforms, AI systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, and n8n AI capabilities, CRM workflows, and data\-driven marketing operations will be highly valued.

**Marketing Execution \& Coordination**
* Take ownership of campaigns and events from planning and execution to tracking and reporting. Track tasks and campaign progress using Notion, Click\-Up, Trello, or similar tools.
* Proactively identify execution gaps and resolve issues before they impact campaigns or events.

* Monitor comments, DMs, WhatsApp engagement, and live event chats.

**WhatsApp, Email \& Campaign Execution**
* Manage WhatsApp Business API (WABA) campaigns, broadcasts, templates, reminders, and event communication.
* Execute WhatsApp, email, and social media campaigns for webinars, events, launches, and marketing activities.
* Plan and manage event communication including T\-7, T\-3, T\-1, T\-0 countdowns, live announcements, real\-time updates, and post\-event communication.
* Coordinate and publish real\-time event updates including speaker quotes, highlights, and key moments.
* Schedule and send marketing and event emails using MailerLite, Brevo, or similar platforms. Make basic updates to landing pages, event pages, banners, and campaign assets.


**Marketing Automation \& Workflow Integration**
* Be well\-versed in automation platforms such as Zapier, Pabbly Connect, n8n, Make, or similar tools.
* Build, manage, and troubleshoot automated workflows connecting marketing, CRM, communication, and operational platforms.
* Automate processes such as lead capture, lead assignment, notifications, follow\-ups, reminders, data entry, reporting, and task creation.
* Understand how to connect leads from one platform to another, ensuring accurate data flow from lead generation to CRM, sales, operations, and reporting.
* Monitor automation performance, identify workflow failures, and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve issues.
* Continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing and operational processes.


**AI Systems \& AI\-Powered Productivity**

* Use AI to improve content creation, research, reporting, productivity, and workflow management.
* Build practical AI\-powered automation systems for marketing and business operations.
* Connect AI tools with CRM systems, spreadsheets, automation platforms, and other business applications.
* Develop AI\-assisted workflows for lead qualification, content repurposing, campaign reporting, meeting summaries, data processing, and internal communication.


**CRM, Data Management \& Performance Reporting**
* Understand and manage CRM workflows, including lead capture, assignment, follow\-ups, status updates, and campaign tracking.
* Connect lead generation platforms, forms, WhatsApp, email, CRM, and other business systems to ensure accurate lead movement and timely follow\-up.
* Maintain accurate CRM data, lead databases, marketing trackers, and operational records using Google Sheets, Excel, or similar tools.
* Use formulas, filters, pivot tables, and dashboards to organise, consolidate, and analyse marketing data.
* Track and report campaign performance across WhatsApp, email, social media, landing pages, and ads.
* Prepare daily and weekly reports covering tasks, leads, spend, CPA, CPL, show\-ups, campaign status, and relevant performance metrics.
* Monitor Meta Ads KPIs such as CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, Frequency, and Spend, and identify performance issues.
* Analyse data to identify trends, lead movement, campaign gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Provide actionable insights to the CMO and relevant teams to support marketing and operational decision\-making.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and useful for improving campaign execution and overall marketing performance.


**Skills And Qualification\-**
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp Channel, and WhatsApp Business API (WABA).
* Practical understanding of WhatsApp broadcasts, templates, campaigns, and marketing automation.
* Good knowledge of Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling.
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads and performance marketing metrics such as CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, and Frequency.
* Basic knowledge of email marketing and landing pages.
* Strong copywriting skills for captions, hooks, CTAs, and short\-form marketing content.
* Comfortable communicating in English and Hinglish.
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and basic formulas.
* Comfortable using Notion, ClickUp, Trello, Canva, and other digital productivity tools.
* Strong AI adoption mindset and hands\-on experience with ChatGPT/Claude and other AI tools.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and stakeholders independently.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong follow\-through.
* Strong ownership mindset — someone who gets things done without waiting to be reminded.
* Ability to work calmly and efficiently under pressure, especially during events, launches, and high\-volume campaigns.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously without compromising accuracy or deadlines.

**WHY JOIN US?**
 You won't just be managing operations \- you'll be helping build the operating engine of an organisation working at the intersection of AI, education, technology and entrepreneurship.
   

  

 You will get the opportunity to work closely with experienced operators, founders, mentors and builders while being part of a team that believes in building real things and shipping them

title: B2B Marketing Manager / Assistant Manager
description:
**The Short Version**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 Someone with 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, or ABM who can identify high\-value accounts, build targeted campaigns, and translate marketing efforts into a real business pipeline. You should be comfortable owning both the strategy and execution, and have a strong understanding of CRM, prospecting, and B2B content.
 



  





**What the role is about:** 
 Building Kraftshala’s B2B marketing engine to engage companies that could hire our talent. You’ll own account targeting, ABM campaigns, LinkedIn / Email outreach, sales enablement content, CRM and marketing operations, and track how marketing converts target accounts into recruiter conversations and partnerships.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 
 This is a builder role — you’ll have the opportunity to create the B2B marketing playbook rather than inherit one. If you enjoy figuring out which accounts to target, what will get their attention, and how to turn that attention into business, you’ll get significant ownership and impact here.
 



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The Detailed Version**




  





**What you’ll do:** 




  





***Primary \- Account\-Based Marketing:***



* Build and manage a tiered target account list across big brands, large agencies, FMCG, and top SaaS companies, with clear logic for prioritising each segment.
* Design and run segment\-specific, account\-based campaigns across email and LinkedIn, targeting the people who influence hiring decisions.
* Move accounts from cold to hiring\-ready, and hand them over to the outreach team with the right context and insights.



  





***Secondary \- Sales Enablement:***



* Build the sales\-enablement content the outreach team needs for live conversations — case studies, testimonials, blogs, one\-pagers, and talent briefs.
* Maintain a lean, credible B2B presence across the channels where hiring decision\-makers spend their time.



  





**What you’ll own:** 




  




* Own the B2B marketing funnel from target\-account identification through account engagement and handoff to the outreach team.
* Build a repeatable ABM engine that can scale across priority segments and evolve based on what works.
* Ensure marketing efforts are closely connected to recruiter acquisition and business outcomes, rather than operating as a standalone brand function.
* Collaborate closely with sales/outreach and leadership to prioritise accounts, sharpen messaging, and improve the overall approach.
* Continuously measure, learn, and iterate based on account and campaign performance.



  





**Must Haves**




  




1. 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, ABM, growth marketing, or similar roles.
 *(We’re not too fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level, which is what we really care for.)*
2. Past roles could include B2B Marketing Manager/Associate, Demand Generation Manager, Growth Marketing Manager, ABM Manager, or similar roles in SaaS, EdTech, D2C, or other B2B businesses.
3. **Experience with:**


* Building and executing B2B/ABM campaigns across channels such as LinkedIn and email.
* Identifying and researching target accounts and decision\-makers, and tailoring campaigns based on account needs.
* Using CRM, marketing automation and prospecting tools to manage campaigns and account engagement.
* Creating B2B marketing and sales\-enablement content such as case studies, one\-pagers, talent briefs, and reports.
* Tracking campaign performance and account\-level engagement, with a clear focus on pipeline and business outcomes.



  





**Good to Haves**




  




* Experience working in a startup or lean team where you’ve had to build processes or campaigns from scratch.
* Experience marketing to enterprise/large accounts or working with multiple stakeholders in a B2B buying journey.
* Experience working closely with sales/business development teams to convert marketing activity into qualified opportunities.



  





**Recruitment Process**




  





 As a small team, it’s imperative that we get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes, and will be a mix of online and offline meetings.
 



  




1. **Conversation 1:** 
 This will be a call with the HR Team to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
2. **Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
3. **Conversation 2:** 
 This will be a conversation with our Head of Operations wherein you can expect to have a discussion on the technical exercise along with specific competencies required for the role.
4. **Conversation 3:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.
5. **Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.



  





**Location:** 




 Gurugram
 



  





 Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**Eicore Technologies · Gurgaon · Full\-time, In\-Office, Experience 4\-6years** 




  





**Eicore is rebuilding the insurance core as the operating system for autonomous insurers.** 




 Founded by people who came from the insurance industry, and trusted by leading insurers across India, Asia\-Pacific and the Middle East, we combine deep domain experience with a platform that has quietly run critical operations for over two decades, processing millions of policies and managing significant premium volumes every year. Names you know, including SBI, run on what we build.
 



 This is a founding\-team marketing role, with the canvas of a startup and none of the risk. The customers, the revenue and the credibility are already in place. You get to help build the marketing function on top of it, at a company that is about to have its most ambitious chapter.
 



 We are looking for a brilliant generalist to help build it.
 



  





**The role** 




 This is a broad, hands\-on role for someone who has done a bit of everything in marketing and wants to do more of it, with real ownership. You will work closely with our fractional CMO and directly with the founders, and see the impact of your work quickly, because there are no layers between you and the people making decisions.
 



 It is a thinker, dreamer and doer role. You will help shape how a modern insurance company shows up in the world and then roll up your sleeves and make it happen yourself. As we grow, you will help build the team, the partners and the tools around you.
 



 You should be
 **AI\-native** 
 : someone who reaches for AI tools by instinct, uses them to work faster and better, and is excited to help build a marketing function that is AI\-first from the ground up.
 



  





**What you will work across** 



* **Digital marketing** 
 , campaigns, LinkedIn, email, web, and the numbers behind them
* **Content marketing** 
 , from thought leadership to product stories to social, written like a human, not a brand
* **Brand** 
 , keeping everything, we put out sharp, consistent and premium
* **PR and communications** 
 , press, announcements, and building our voice in the market
* **Field and event marketing** 
 , roundtables, conferences and the moments that put us in front of insurers
* **Marketing operations and AI** 
 , the tools, workflows and AI infrastructure that let a lean team punch far above its weight



 You will not be expected to be a world expert in all of these on day one. You will be expected to have
 *done* 
 most of them, to learn fast, and to be the kind of person who figures out the rest.
 



  





**You will thrive here if you** 



* **Write well and know it.** 
 Not "communicate clearly", well. Most of what you make here is words, and the difference between adequate and good is the difference between an analyst returning your call and not.
* **Are a genuine generalist who gets a kick out of shipping.** 
 Around 4 to 6 years across B2B marketing, in tech, SaaS, fintech or insurance, with enough range that you have run an event, written a launch, argued with a designer, and fixed a campaign that was not working. We care more about the shape of that than the number.
* **Think like an owner** 
 and move without waiting to be told.
* **Find insurance more interesting than boring.** 
 You will get curious about claims, underwriting, and why an insurer in Kuala Lumpur has different problems than one in Mumbai.
* **Have your own way of working with AI and can defend it.** 
 We will ask you to walk us through it. "I use ChatGPT a lot" is not an answer.



  





**Why this is worth your time** 



* This is a world class product, and you will be marketing it to the world. Taking cutting edge platform concepts and making them land with the people who buy them.
* You will sit in the thick of B2B enterprise SaaS, at the point where AI agents and humans start working side by side. Not a trend deck, an actual product doing it.
* You will help build a marketing function from early days, at a company that already has the customers and credibility most startups spend a decade chasing.
* You will work directly with the founders, and learn the business, not just the marketing.
* You will own real scope, not a corner of someone else's plan.
* You will do the most interesting work of your career so far, if you are the right person.



  





 If that sounds like you, we would like to meet you.

title: SEO Intern
description:
**About Trackier**
 Trackier is a leading SaaS platform serving businesses across 20\+ countries worldwide. For over a decade, we have empowered brands, advertisers, agencies, and ad networks with innovative Performance Marketing and Mobile Marketing solutions that drive growth and maximize conversions.
   

  

 We empower marketers worldwide with advanced technology and a customer\-first approach. We help businesses build impactful campaigns, create exceptional user experiences, and ensure data privacy. Our smart solutions are designed to optimize marketing strategies, enhance efficiency, and foster long\-term customer relationships based on trust. Trackier was founded to solve a critical challenge—enabling marketers to accurately measure success and build meaningful customer connections.
   

  

 During this six\-month internship, you'll work closely with the SEO and content teams to research publishing opportunities, create external content, and support off\-page SEO and link\-building initiatives.
   

  

 We're looking for structured, curious learners who are interested in understanding how SEO, content, and authority building contribute to organic growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Research \& Opportunity Discovery**
* Research third\-party websites, blogs, publications, communities, and other platforms for relevant publishing opportunities
* Evaluate websites based on relevance, content quality, audience fit, and basic SEO indicators
* Research competitors to identify their mentions, backlinks, publishing opportunities, and external visibility
* Conduct topic and audience research to identify relevant content opportunities


**Content Creation \& Guest Posting**
* Research and write original guest posts, articles, and supporting content for external publication
* Adapt writing style, topic, structure, and depth based on the target publication and audience
* Work with SEO and content teams to align content with link\-building and off\-page SEO objectives
* Maintain records and track external content opportunities and submissions


**SEO \& Optimization**
* Develop a practical understanding of backlinks, anchor text, search intent, domain authority, referring domains, and off\-page SEO
* Understand how on\-page content, external authority, and search intent contribute to organic visibility
* Learn to evaluate and prioritize publishing opportunities using relevant SEO indicators and tools


**Requirements**
* Currently pursuing or recently completed an undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Journalism, Media, or a related field. Candidates from other backgrounds with strong research and writing skills are also encouraged to apply
* Strong written English and ability to structure information clearly
* Strong research skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to research\-heavy work
* Willingness to learn SEO beyond simply following keyword checklists
* Ability to work independently once objectives are defined and respond positively to feedback
* Prior formal education in SEO is not required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to SEO, content marketing, link building, digital PR, or guest posting
* Experience writing blogs, articles, essays, newsletters, or other long\-form content
* Familiarity with keywords, search intent, backlinks, anchor text, domain authority, or referring domains
* Experience with Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, or similar SEO tools
* Previous internships, freelance work, college projects, or personal projects related to SEO or content


**Benefits**
 By the end of six months, you'll understand how content and SEO work together to improve organic visibility and authority.
   

  

* Learn to identify and evaluate valuable third\-party publishing opportunities
* Gain hands\-on experience in competitor, topic, and audience research
* Learn to write and adapt guest content for different publications and audiences
* Develop an understanding of backlinks, off\-page SEO, search intent, authority building, and organic growth
* Gain exposure to the relationship between on\-page content and off\-page authority
* Build published writing samples and experience working on real SEO campaigns
* Develop a stronger, structured research methodology and the ability to take an opportunity from discovery and topic selection through writing, submission, and tracking
* 5\-day working week in a flexible, remote environment focused on learning, creativity, and professional growth

As we close our seed round, we're looking for someone who eats, sleeps, and breathes social media to own our presence across the internet.

 plan the content, post it on time, and make sure we're always showing up for our audience.

 scripts for videos, captions for posts, ideas for campaigns in a language people understand and enjoy.

 Post on LinkedIn and Twitter too share brand stories, join cultural conversations, and build Dharmik's brand online.
* **Make our pages look the part.** 
 Improve images, copy, and listings on our website and Amazon so when someone lands on our page, they want to buy.
* **Watch the numbers, move fast.** 
 Track what's working reach, engagement, saves, follower growth and keep pushing what gets results.



 In short: own the story, put it out into the world, bring creators into the fold and help build a brand that will outlast all of us, with creativity and ownership as the first principles.

* **Stipend:** 
 ₹45,000/month (₹10,000 cash \+ ₹35,000 towards housing) with shared accommodation provided.

 You're not supporting someone else's social strategy — you're building ours. Real decisions, real stakes, real results.
* **Work directly with the founder:** 
 Every brief, every collab, every content call — you'll be in the room where it happens.
* **Real growth:** 
 This role grows into Head of Social / Brand / Partnerships as we scale. Our last 2 interns became founding members within 4 months — one is now Chief of Staff with equity.

 A close\-knit crew working from a villa in Gurgaon — startup crash\-pad meets family, where you ship hard, learn fast, and have real fun.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Real experience running social media for a brand, creator, or startup — even if it was your own handle.
* Strong writing instincts in Hindi, Hinglish, and English — you know how to write for Instagram, not a press release.

* **Location:**

 ASAP



  





 If you love building communities, obsess over content, and want to put India's most exciting spiritual lifestyle brand on the map — this one's for you.

title: Senior Partnerships Manager - US
description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
 We're hiring a
 **Partnership Manager** 
 to build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem. This role is about creating long\-term revenue through strategic partnerships, not just managing existing relationships.
   

  

 You'll identify, recruit, and enable consulting firms, channel partners, resellers, system integrators, and managed service providers who can take Sprinto to new customers and markets. From building the partner pipeline to driving joint go\-to\-market initiatives and co\-selling opportunities, you'll own the partner journey end to end.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships are built on mutual growth. Someone who can influence senior stakeholders, create repeatable partner programs, and turn relationships into predictable pipeline and revenue.
   

  

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
* Build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem by recruiting consulting firms, MSPs, MSSPs, system integrators, resellers, and channel partners
* Own the end\-to\-end partner lifecycle, from prospecting and qualification to onboarding, enablement, and long\-term success
* Design and execute joint go\-to\-market strategies, including co\-selling, co\-marketing, and partner\-led growth initiatives
* Develop partner enablement assets, business plans, sales collateral, and value proposition decks to help partners sell Sprinto effectively
* Partner closely with Sales teams on strategic opportunities and participate in customer conversations alongside partners
* Track partner health through pipeline generation, deal registrations, win rates, deal velocity, and overall revenue contribution
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align on business goals, performance, and growth opportunities
* Own partner operations, including CRM and PRM hygiene, partner tiering, deal registration processes, and reporting
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to launch partner programs and campaigns that accelerate growth


**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* 5–8 years of overall experience, including 3\+ years in SaaS partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles
* Must have recent experience building and scaling partner programs across US
* Strong understanding of partner\-led GTM motions, channel sales, and indirect revenue models
* Proven ability to recruit, enable, and grow strategic partners that contribute measurable pipeline and revenue
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or participating in enterprise sales cycles
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills across executive and operational stakeholders
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams
* Highly organized, self\-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment


 This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who
   

  

  

* Enjoys building partnerships from scratch instead of simply managing existing accounts
* Thinks beyond partner recruitment and focuses on long\-term partner success and revenue generation
* Can balance strategic relationship\-building with operational excellence
* Loves collaborating across teams to create scalable GTM programs

title: Growth Champion
description:
**About Be Limitless** 


 Be Limitless is a feature\-rich job search marketplace — built as a hybrid of Naukri.com, Instagram, and LinkedIn. The platform brings together customers (employers and recruiters) and candidates (job seekers) in one place, with the discovery and engagement layer of a social platform and the intent\-driven matching of a job board.
 





 We are well\-funded and putting real capital behind scaling this platform aggressively.
 



**The Opportunity** 


 We've built the product. What we haven't cracked yet is the classic marketplace cold\-start problem: getting both sides — customers and candidates — active on the platform at the same time, and keeping them there.
 





 This role exists to solve exactly that. There is no existing playbook to execute — the person in this role will build one from scratch, through direct hustle, before it becomes a repeatable growth motion for a wider team to scale.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

 •     Own early\-stage growth across both sides of the marketplace — customers and candidates — as a single, accountable owner of the cold\-start problem.
 



 •     Personally drive acquisition of the first 100 customers and the first 1 lakh candidates through direct outreach, partnerships, community\-building, and hands\-on growth tactics.
 



 •     Design and run unconventional, low\-cost go\-to\-market experiments; double down on what works and kill what doesn't.
 



 •     Build the early acquisition and retention playbook — the foundation a growth team will scale once traction is proven.
 



 •     Work closely with product and marketing to turn direct market feedback into fast platform improvements.
 



 •     Track and report on growth metrics, and iterate quickly based on data rather than assumption.
 



 •     Act as the face of Be Limitless in the market during this early phase — building direct relationships with founding customers and candidate communities.
 



  




**What We're Looking For** 

 •     Proven experience scaling a two\-sided marketplace or platform from zero to meaningful traction — ideally in job search, recruitment, social, or consumer tech.
 



 •     A genuinely entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable without a playbook, biased toward action over process.
 



 •     Strong sales and business development instincts, with a track record of personally closing early customers.
 



 •     A young, high\-energy, hands\-on operator — this is a builder role first, not a management role, in its early phase.
 



 •     Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration in a startup\-like environment.
 



 •     Excellent communication skills — equally credible speaking to a corporate customer and a first\-time job seeker.
 



  




**Nice to Have** 

 •     Experience in recruitment, HR\-tech, job search, or talent marketplace businesses.
 



 •     A track record in growth hacking, community\-led growth, or content/influencer\-driven acquisition.
 



 •     An existing network among employers, recruiters, and/or job seekers in India.
 



  




**What You'll Get** 

 •     Genuine ownership of strategy and execution — not implementation of someone else's plan.
 



 •     The chance to build a category\-defining platform from the ground up, backed by serious capital.
 



 •     Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives tied to the growth you drive.
 



 •     Direct access to, and mentorship from, the founding leadership team.
 



  




**How to Apply** 


 Send your resume along with a short note on how you've solved a similar cold\-start problem before — what you did, and what the results were — to \[add application email / link].

title: Farm Manager
description:
**JD FOR FARM MANAGER**

**Location:** Vellaputhur, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 20 to 25 Years  
**Qualification:** Degree in Agriculture (Mandatory)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time With Accommodation Language: English, Hindi \& Tamil (Mandatory )

**Farm Operations Management**: Overseeing day\-to\-day operations of the farm, including crop cultivation, livestock care, and maintenance of farm facilities.

1\. **Staff Management**: Hiring, training, scheduling, and supervising farm workers or labourer’s to ensure efficient operation of the farm.

2\. **Crop Planning and Management**: Developing crop rotation plans, selecting appropriate crops for planting, and managing planting, harvesting, and post\-harvest activities.

3\. **Livestock Care**: Ensuring the health and well\-being of livestock, including feeding, watering, monitoring for illness, and coordinating with veterinarians as needed.

4\. **Equipment Maintenance**: Maintaining farm equipment and machinery to ensure they are in good working condition. This includes scheduling regular maintenance and repairs as needed.

5\. **Budgeting and Financial Management**: Developing and managing the farm budget, including monitoring expenses, tracking revenues, and making financial decisions to ensure the profitability of the farm.

6\. **Marketing and Sales**: Identifying market opportunities for farm products, developing marketing strategies, and managing sales channels such as farmers' markets, CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) programs, or direct sales to restaurants and retailers.

7\. **Environmental Stewardship**: Implementing sustainable farming practices to minimize environmental impact, conserve natural resources, and promote soil health and biodiversity.

8\. **Compliance and Regulation**: Ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to farming, food safety, labour, and environmental protection.

9\. **Record Keeping**: Maintaining accurate records of farm activities, including crop yields, livestock inventory, financial transactions, and regulatory compliance documentation.

10\. **Facility Management**: Managing farm buildings, infrastructure, and utilities to ensure they are well\-maintained and operational.

11\. **Pest and Disease Management**: Implementing integrated pest management strategies to control pests and diseases while minimizing the use of chemical pesticides.

12\. **Community Relations**: Building positive relationships with neighbours, community organizations, and local authorities to foster goodwill and address any concerns related to the farm's operations.

13\. **Emergency Response**: Developing and implementing emergency response plans to address situations such as severe weather, livestock emergencies, or equipment failures.

14\. **Continued Learning and Professional Development**: Staying informed about advancements in farming techniques, technologies, and regulations through on\-going education and professional development opportunities.

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
Position Overview

The **Customer Relationship Manager (CRM)** will be responsible for managing and enhancing Glow's overall client relationship journey, from initial enquiry to consultation, treatment, and post\-service engagement.

The role will have a strong focus on **client escalation management, lead tracking and conversion, online doctor consultations, review management, and quality auditing of Case Manager interactions**.

The CRM will work closely with Case Managers, Doctors, Centre Managers, Front Desk, and Operations teams to ensure every client receives a consistent, professional, and premium experience aligned with Glow's luxury brand standards.

Reporting To

COO

Key Responsibilities1\. Client Escalation Management

* Take ownership of client escalations and ensure concerns are addressed promptly and professionally.
* Act as a senior point of contact for complex, sensitive, or high\-value client concerns.
* Understand the root cause of complaints and coordinate with relevant teams to identify appropriate resolutions.
* Ensure timely service recovery while protecting the client relationship and Glow's brand experience.
* Maintain an escalation tracker and monitor cases until complete closure.
* Identify recurring complaints and recommend corrective and preventive actions to management.
* Follow up with clients after resolution to ensure satisfaction and rebuild trust where required.

2\. Client Enquiry \& Lead Conversion Management

* Monitor client enquiries received through various channels, including calls, WhatsApp, website enquiries, social media, digital campaigns, and other lead\-generation platforms.
* Maintain accurate data on incoming enquiries and their source.
* Track the complete journey from **Enquiry → Contacted → Consultation Booked → Consultation Completed → Treatment Conversion**.
* Analyse enquiry\-to\-consultation and consultation\-to\-treatment conversion ratios.
* Identify high\-performing and underperforming lead sources.
* Work with Case Managers to improve follow\-up quality and conversion rates.
* Identify lost, pending, dormant, and unresponsive leads and develop strategies for re\-engagement.
* Prepare regular conversion reports and provide actionable insights to management.

3\. Online Doctor Consultation Management

* Coordinate and schedule online consultations between clients and Glow's Doctors.
* Ensure clients are contacted and scheduled within the required turnaround time.
* Coordinate with Doctors and Case Managers to ensure availability and smooth consultation scheduling.
* Monitor scheduled, completed, cancelled, and missed online consultations.
* Follow up with clients who have not completed their scheduled consultations.
* Track conversion of online consultations into in\-clinic appointments and treatments.

4\. Review \& Reputation Management

* Monitor client reviews and feedback across relevant platforms, including Google and other approved channels.
* Track positive and negative feedback and identify recurring themes.
* Coordinate appropriate responses to client reviews in line with Glow's communication standards.
* Escalate negative or sensitive reviews to the appropriate management team for resolution.
* Analyse review trends to identify opportunities for improving client experience.

5\. Product \& Service Feedback Management

* Actively collect and consolidate **client feedback on products, treatments, services, and overall experience**.
* Identify recurring feedback regarding product efficacy, quality, pricing, availability, packaging, usage experience, or client preferences.
* Capture feedback received through Case Managers, Front Desk, Doctors, Therapists, reviews, WhatsApp, calls, and direct client interactions.
* Differentiate between **product\-related concerns, service\-related concerns, and client expectations** to identify the underlying issue.
* Maintain a structured **Product \& Service Feedback Tracker** and analyse trends periodically.
* Share relevant product feedback and recurring client concerns with **Management, Procurement, Operations, Doctors, Therapists, and other relevant teams**.
* Highlight products or services receiving consistently positive or negative feedback.
* Identify potential opportunities for introducing new products, services, packages, or improvements based on client needs and preferences.
* Ensure product\-related complaints are escalated promptly to the appropriate team for investigation and resolution.
* Track corrective actions and communicate relevant updates to clients where required.
* Provide management with **actionable client insights**, rather than simply reporting feedback.

6\. Quality Auditing of Case Manager Calls

* Conduct regular quality audits of Case Manager calls to clients.
* Evaluate calls against defined quality parameters and communication standards.
* Assess greeting, understanding of client requirements, product/service knowledge, communication, appointment conversion, follow\-up, objection handling, upselling/cross\-selling, accuracy, professionalism, and closure.
* Maintain individual Case Manager quality scores.
* Identify recurring gaps and provide structured feedback and coaching.
* Track improvement following feedback and training interventions.
* Escalate serious deviations, misinformation, or inappropriate communication to management.

7\. Client Follow\-up \& Relationship Management

* Monitor follow\-ups for prospective, existing, inactive, and high\-value clients.
* Ensure clients receive timely communication regarding consultations, appointments, treatments, packages, and relevant offers.
* Identify opportunities to re\-engage dormant clients.
* Support Case Managers in developing stronger client relationships and improving retention.
* Ensure important client interactions are documented accurately in the relevant CRM/system.

8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Case Managers, Centre Managers, Doctors, Front Desk, Marketing, Procurement, Operations, and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate resolution of client issues that require involvement from multiple departments.
* Ensure client feedback and insights are communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Support management in implementing client experience and product/service improvement initiatives.
* Identify operational or product gaps that negatively impact the client journey and recommend solutions.

Reporting \& Analytics

The CRM will be responsible for maintaining and analysing key client experience and conversion data, including:

* Total client enquiries
* Enquiries by source
* Enquiry\-to\-contact ratio
* Contact\-to\-consultation conversion
* Consultation\-to\-treatment conversion
* Overall lead\-to\-client conversion
* Online consultation bookings
* Online consultation completion rate
* No\-show and cancellation rates
* Follow\-up completion
* Dormant lead reactivation
* Client escalation volume
* Escalation resolution time
* Review ratings and sentiment
* Case Manager call quality scores

The role should convert this data into **actionable insights**, rather than simply maintaining reports.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Client Experience

* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalation Resolution Rate
* Escalation Closure Time
* Repeat Complaint Rate
* Review Rating \& Sentiment

Lead Conversion

* Enquiry\-to\-Contact Ratio
* Contact\-to\-Consultation Conversion
* Consultation\-to\-Treatment Conversion
* Overall Lead Conversion Rate
* Dormant Lead Reactivation Rate

Online Consultations

* Online Consultation Booking Rate
* Consultation Completion Rate
* Online Consultation\-to\-Treatment Conversion

Case Manager Quality

* Call Quality Audit Score
* Follow\-up Compliance
* Conversion Performance
* Improvement After Coaching

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* **3–6 years of experience** in Customer Relationship Management, Client Experience, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Healthcare, Hospitality, Beauty, Wellness, or a premium service environment.
* Experience in managing client escalations and analysing conversion data is strongly preferred.
* Experience in call quality auditing, CRM systems, and lead management will be an advantage.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong client relationship and escalation\-management skills.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation abilities.
* Good understanding of sales funnels and conversion metrics.
* Strong listening and call\-auditing skills.
* Ability to coach and provide constructive feedback.
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to handle sensitive and high\-value client interactions with discretion.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets and CRM proficiency.
* Highly organised with excellent follow\-up discipline.
* Professional, polished, and service\-oriented personality.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **highly client\-centric, analytical, commercially aware, and confident in handling difficult conversations**.

They should be someone who can look at a client enquiry not merely as a data point, but understand the entire journey—from the first enquiry and Case Manager call to the online consultation, treatment conversion, review, and long\-term relationship.

The individual should have the maturity to handle escalations independently, the analytical ability to identify conversion gaps, and the communication skills to coach Case Managers towards better client interactions and business outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means **fewer unresolved escalations, stronger client satisfaction, higher enquiry\-to\-client conversion, better online consultation utilization, improved reviews, and consistently high\-quality Case Manager interactions**.

The CRM will play a critical role in ensuring that every client interaction reflects Glow's standards of **luxury, professionalism, responsiveness, and exceptional care**.

description:

 MedTech Sales
   

  

**Job Sub Function**
 Clinical Sales – Hospital/Hospital Systems (Commission)
   

  

**Job Category**
 Professional
   

  

**All Job Posting Locations:**
 Mumbai, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 Lead the Neurovascular business for India \& SEA with full country P\&L accountability. Drive commercial strategy, operational execution, clinical engagement, and cross functional alignment to grow the portfolio while maintaining the highest standards of patient safety, quality, and compliance. Build and lead a high‑performing India \& SEA leadership team and partner with APAC and Global teams to localize and execute launch and lifecycle plans.
   

  

 Core accountabilities
   

  

* Own the India \& SEA P\&L for Neurovascular: annual planning, forecasting, margin management, and business reviews with APAC leadership.
* Define and deliver India \& SEA go‑to‑market strategy: market segmentation, pricing, channel mix (direct vs distributor), tender approach, and key account plans.
* Drive commercial execution: meet or exceed revenue, market share and profitability targets across priority segments (public/private hospitals, tertiary centers, Neuro Interventional programs).
* Lead country team: hire, coach, develop and retain high‑caliber managers (Area managers / CSR’s). Set clear performance targets and accountability.
* Clinical \& KOL engagement: partner with Medical and Clinical Affairs to design and deliver training, proctorships and evidence generation to accelerate adoption.
* New product introductions: own India \& SEA launch planning and execution, local clinical rollout, hospital onboarding, and post‑launch performance.
* Regulatory \& quality oversight: ensure all commercial and clinical activities comply with local regulatory, quality and ethical requirements; work with RA/QA on approvals and vigilance.
* Commercial operations: optimize demand planning, inventory management, pricing execution and distributor performance with Supply Chain and Operations.
* Stakeholder management: build trusted relationships with KOLs, hospital leadership, government/payer stakeholders and strategic distributors. Represent the company at conferences, advisory boards and institutional meetings.
* Market insight \& influence: provide timely market intelligence to APAC/Global functions to influence portfolio strategy, investments and R\&D priorities.


 Key performance indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Revenue vs plan and YoY growth (by product / segment).
* Market share in targeted neurovascular segments.
* Gross margin / profitability vs target.
* New product adoption metrics (Market Share growth, penetration in target centers).
* Clinical engagement: number and quality of trainings/proctorships and investigator studies.
* Customer satisfaction / account retention for top accounts.
* Team performance and retention / leadership bench strength.
* Compliance audit outcomes and regulatory milestone achievement.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* 12\+ years in medical devices / medtech or closely related healthcare industry with progressive commercial leadership experience.
* Minimum 7\+ years managing teams with direct people leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated P\&L ownership and track record of delivering revenue and margin results.
* Experience in high‑complexity specialty businesses; direct neurovascular experience essential. Experience in interventional cardiology, peripheral vascular, or related specialties acceptable
* Proven success engaging KOLs and driving clinical adoption within Indian hospitals and healthcare systems.
* Experience launching complex devices and managing lifecycle activities.
* Strong understanding of India regulatory, reimbursement and tender environments.


**Preferred / Differentiating**
* Prior experience running a country P\&L for a specialty device business.
* Relationships with Neuro Interventional KOLs and leading tertiary centers in India \& SEA region
* Experience with digital commercialization tools (CRM, analytics) and commercial transformation.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred; clinical background (nursing/clinical qualification) is a plus.


 Core competencies \& leadership behaviors
   

  

* Strategic commercial acumen with strong financial discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale cross‑functional teams.
* High stakeholder influence and negotiation skills.
* Customer and patient‑centric mindset; commitment to quality and compliance.
* Data‑driven decision making and commercial rigor.
* Strong communication and presence with clinicians, hospital leadership and internal senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative, resilient and adaptable in matrixed environments.


 Education

* MBA or advanced degree preferred.


 Travel

title: (Associate) Director, Expansion & Partnerships, AI Access Initiative (EAII)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
   

  

**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)**
 We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence \- presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
   

  

 Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI\-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low\- and middle\-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3\.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open\-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI\-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
   

  

 We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long\-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M\+ people with cost\-effective, evidence\-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last\-mile delivery.
   

  

**The Role**
 2AI is building fast. We have a founding team, two live program portfolios, and a pipeline of opportunities that will drive significant expansion. The programs we are running have credible pathways to 100s of millions of people. While incubated at Evidence Action, we plan to spin out in Q4 '26\.
   

  

 Our Agriculture portfolio is scaling AI\-enabled weather forecasting services to reach tens of millions of smallholder farmers, in close partnership with state and national governments in India. The next phase is to expand this work: deciding which countries we move into next and building what it takes to operate there. We are seeking a rigorous, high\-ownership Associate Director or Director, Expansion \& Partnerships to own that expansion end to end, from market selection and government and telco partnerships through to standing up offices and teams in new markets.
   

  

 This role is based in India and sits on 2AI's global team, reporting into the VP, Agriculture. It includes people leadership, managing at least one senior manager across the program. You will work closely with our India country team and other in\-country team members to scope and expand programming.
   

  

**You Will:**
* Identify new markets for forecast delivery: In conjunction with the VP, Agriculture, develop the criteria for market selection and prioritize countries to expand into
* Stand up new markets: Once a new market is confirmed, support the set\-up of offices and the hiring of high\-quality staff with the requisite skills to implement large\-scale forecast delivery
* Oversee development of forecasts for new regions: Collaborate with academics to ensure forecasts are developed, tested, and ready to disseminate in new countries. This could include hiring and managing post\-doctoral students to support in model benchmarking or dataset support
* Lead telco partnerships: Identify target telcos and lead engagement, negotiation, and relationship management to set up sustainable telco\-based dissemination systems
* Hire and manage in\-country scoping support: Where staff on the ground are needed to determine whether there is an opportunity in a new market, hire and oversee them, for example short\-term consultants
* Build and maintain government relationships: Create new and nurture existing relationships with the government bodies needed to operate and disseminate forecasts in a new market, including agriculture departments and meteorological agencies
* Partner with stakeholders: Create new and nurture existing relationships with academic institutions, delivery partners, and other agriculture organizations.
* Develop best practices and thought leadership: Across all of the above, build best practices and replicable toolkits that can be applied elsewhere by others. Share key learnings with the sector through toolkits, blogs, and other public\-good resources


**Requirements**
 The ideal candidate is an exceptional builder with the ability to drive outcomes in a fast\-moving, high\-stakes environment. Given the startup nature of this work, we seek contributors with high throughput, strong work ethic, and willingness to lean in and work extended hours.
   

  

 You will likely have:
   

  

* 7\-10\+ years' experience as a builder in international development, consulting, or an agriculture adjacent organization
* Strong communication skills in English with experience working with international teams
* A proven track record of significantly scaling organizations and/or programs to deliver impact at scale, preferably in close partnership with national governments. Direct experience taking a program or organization into a new region is a plus
* Demonstrated success building and negotiating partnerships with governments and the private sector. Experience with telcos, mobile network operators, or platform partners is a strong plus
* Training or early career experience in a high\-rigor environment (e.g., top\-tier management consulting, high\-growth NGO program leadership, strategy/econ research) and the ability to rapidly get up to speed in new technical areas including AI/ML forecasting concepts
* A track record as a strong people manager and builder: able to set clear standards, empower others, and cultivate a high\-performance culture across distributed and field\-based teams
* Experience working with Asian and/or African governments to drive large\-scale change, with a strong preference for direct experience working with ministries of agriculture or national meteorological agencies

 **Vice President Influencer Marketing**

 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Influencer Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Develop and own the overall influencer and creator marketing strategy aligned with brand and business objectives.

* Identify emerging creator trends, platforms, formats, and opportunities.
* Define the right mix of macro, mid\-tier, micro, and nano influencers for different campaign objectives.

**2\. Creator Partnerships**

* Develop compelling creator briefs, campaign concepts, and content frameworks.
* Ensure creator content is authentic while meeting brand, legal, and compliance requirements.

**4\. Performance \& Analytics** 



* Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks for influencer campaigns.
* Track metrics including reach, engagement, views, EMV, conversions, CAC/ROI, revenue, and incremental impact.
* Use data and insights to optimize creator selection, content strategy, and investment allocation.
* Build regular executive\-level reporting and recommendations.

* Experience managing significant marketing budgets and cross\-functional teams.

title: District Manager, North & East India
description:
Requisition ID: 17021
Job Location(s):
Gurugram, HR, IN, 122022


Time in Office: Hybrid
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.


**Overview**
------------


The **District Manager, North \+ East India** for Crocs is responsible for leading end\-to\-end operational execution across Retail DTC and Wholesale Partner Monobrand stores in the assigned geography, reporting to the National Retail Operations Manager (skip level: Commercial Director). The role drives regional business delivery, store and partner operating standards, inventory productivity, replenishment effectiveness, talent hiring and capability, and network expansion readiness, partnering closely with Commercial, Product, Marketing, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, Visual Merchandising, Retail, Human Resources, Real Estate, franchisee and wholesale partner teams.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Own sell\-out, profitability and operational performance across DTC and Partner Monobrand stores in North \+ East India, driving achievement of the regional annual operating plan, comp growth and productivity targets through weekly and monthly operating reviews.
* Ensure consistent execution of retail operating standards, SOPs, store visit discipline, performance review completion, DTC audit compliance and VM compliance, building scalable regional processes for operating cadence, governance and action tracking.
* Drive regional inventory productivity through effective stock deployment, replenishment discipline and stock balancing, monitoring WOH, ageing, sell\-through, shrinkage and store\-level gaps with Planning and Supply Chain.
* Jointly own DTC store expansion, including market mapping, catchment assessment and property scouting with Commercial and Real Estate teams, and ensure new store operational readiness across hiring, training, VM, stock and launch checklists.
* Establish a structured review cadence with franchise, Partner Monobrand and wholesale partners covering sell\-out, inventory health, replenishment, store standards and action closure, ensuring adherence to commercial and brand standards.
* Own Store Manager hiring and coordinate end\-to\-end store team hiring for existing and new DTC stores in partnership with Human Resources, and influence partner staffing quality for Partner Monobrand stores.
* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers and field operations teams, building a performance\-oriented culture focused on accountability, execution excellence, succession planning and talent retention.
* Act as the regional operating link across Commercial, Product, Marketing, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, VM, HR, Real Estate and partners, ensuring timely closure of priorities, escalations and corrective actions with clear, data\-led updates.
**What You'll Bring to the Table**
----------------------------------


* MBA preferred; Bachelor’s degree in Business, Retail Management, Operations, Supply Chain or a related discipline – or equivalent years of relevant and related experience.
* Minimum 8–12 years of experience in Retail Operations, Wholesale Operations, Franchise Management or Commercial Operations, with multi\-state exposure preferred.
* Background knowledge in retail hiring, new store openings and property/site evaluation.
* Strong understanding of retail operations, store P\&L, inventory productivity, replenishment processes and partner governance.
* Highly influential across cross\-functional stakeholders and external partners, including situations without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-location operations and Store Managers, identify business risks early and drive corrective action.
* Ability to attract, select and build strong Store Manager and frontline teams, with strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication and people leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across North \+ East India, with a field\-oriented, process\-driven and data\-led approach.
The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.

  

At Crocs, Inc. we believe in the power of a blend of in\-person and virtual collaboration to drive creativity and strengthen relationships. Your participation in this flexible schedule plays a key role in building a connected and successful team. In\-office requirements vary by our work personas: Resident (5 days), Collaborator (4 days), Connector (2\-3 days), Explorer (fully remote). This role has been aligned to the Collaborator persona.
