description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Position Summary (Enter the description) \- Power \& Utilities Sector Leader responsible for driving sector\-led growth through origination, deal shaping, and execution of large\-scale transformation programs, with a strong emphasis on strengthening sales enablement and pipeline quality.
   

  

 Acts as a senior industry advisor, translating energy transition and utilities disruption into actionable client opportunities while building a differentiated sector proposition and positioning the firm as a partner of choice for complex, high\-value engagements.
   

  

**Objective and purpose:**
* Lead the growth agenda for the Power \& Utilities sector in GDS, defining strategic priorities, target accounts, and differentiated plays to scale the practice and drive sustained revenue growth.
* Drive origination and closure of large, complex transformation opportunities, translating sector themes such as energy transition, grid modernization, and asset optimization into actionable, high\-value deals.
* Act as a trusted advisor to P\&U C\-suite leaders, shaping enterprise transformation agendas across generation, transmission, distribution, and customer operations with a clear link to business outcomes.
* Institutionalize strong sales enablement across the sector, embedding disciplined pipeline management, pursuit excellence, sector narratives, and commercial frameworks to improve win rates and consistency.
* Build and commercialize differentiated sector offerings, including repeatable frameworks, assets, and go\-to\-market propositions, while strengthening market positioning through thought leadership and industry engagement.


**Scope of the position:**
* Own the GDS Power \& Utilities sector agenda across priority accounts, aligning global client needs with GDS capabilities to identify and shape high\-value transformation opportunities across the utilities value chain.
* Lead end\-to\-end pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, commercial structuring, and deal closure, ensuring strong integration with onshore teams and global account leadership.
* Drive sales enablement at scale, embedding consistent pipeline discipline, qualification frameworks, reusable sector narratives, and pursuit playbooks to improve win rates and cost of sales efficiency across deals.
* Lead integrated go\-to\-market initiatives, working across Consulting, SaT, Tax, and Assurance to bring unified, market\-facing sector solutions and drive coordinated account penetration.
* Develop and industrialize sector\-specific assets and accelerators, including playbooks, benchmarks, and solution components that enable faster deal shaping, repeatable delivery, and differentiated positioning.
* Build and maintain senior client relationships, engaging C\-suite stakeholders to position the firm as a strategic partner across energy transition, regulatory change, infrastructure modernization, and customer transformation agendas.
* Build and scale GDS alliance and ecosystem capabilities for the P\&U sector, working closely with global teams to operationalize and support partnerships, enhancing solution depth and strengthening competitiveness in large deals
* Build and scale a high\-performing P\&U capability within GDS, enhancing domain depth, pursuit leadership, and delivery excellence to support sustained sector growth and competitive advantage.


**Essential Functions Of The Job (Enter The Description)**
* Sponsor and steer priority pursuits and engagements, providing senior direction on deal strategy, solution architecture, and executive messaging to maximize win probability and value realization.
* Shape differentiated client propositions, translating complex utilities challenges (e.g., grid resilience, decarbonization, regulatory compliance, asset performance) into clear, outcome\-driven transformation narratives for senior stakeholders.
* Govern quality and consistency of proposals and deliverables, ensuring alignment with client priorities, commercial expectations, and delivery feasibility across large, multi\-tower programs.
* Drive commercial rigor in deal\-making, including pricing strategy, margin management, and contract structuring for complex transformation programs.
* Enable cross\-functional solution integration, ensuring seamless alignment of capabilities across consulting, technology, risk, and core utility operations
* Influence executive\-level client decision\-making, leading high\-stakes conversations, facilitating alignment across stakeholders, and positioning transformation initiatives in the context of enterprise value creation.
* Oversee development and evolution of sector IP, ensuring that frameworks, benchmarks, and solution components remain relevant to evolving industry trends and are effectively applied in client contexts
* Ensure strong alignment between deal strategy and delivery approach, guiding teams on shaping scalable, GDS‑led delivery models that are commercially viable, feasible, and differentiated during pursuits.
* Coach and develop senior team members on pursuit leadership and client engagement, strengthening capability in solutioning, storytelling, and executive\-level communication.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities (Enter The Description)**
* Evaluate and prioritize pursuit opportunities, applying judgment on deal size, strategic fit, client buying appetite, competitive positioning, and win probability to guide sector focus and resource allocation.
* Make strategic decisions on solution positioning and value definition, determining which transformation levers (e.g., energy transition, grid modernization, cost optimization) to emphasize based on client context and value potential.
* Direct commercial and pricing strategy for complex deals, balancing competitiveness, margin expectations, and delivery feasibility to secure priority opportunities.
* Determine optimal GDS involvement across pursuits, making decisions on when and how to position GDS capabilities within deal constructs, including the choice of delivery model, offshore leverage, and integration with onshore teams to maximize competitiveness and value realization.
* Assess and prioritize sector investments, including development of assets, offerings, and alliance capabilities, based on market demand, pipeline trends, and potential for differentiation.
* Analyze market trends and disruption themes in Power \& Utilities, including regulatory shifts, decarbonization priorities, infrastructure investment cycles, and evolving customer models, to inform sector strategy and pursuit direction.


**Education And Experience (Enter The Description)**

**Good to have (Differentiators)**

* Exposure to grid and infrastructure modernization, including smart grids, digital substations, asset performance optimization, and resilience programs, reflecting the increasing digitization of network operations.

* Ability to translate global disruption trends into scalable market propositions, including navigating regulatory complexity, ESG mandates, and capital investment cycles, while identifying new growth and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience in building and leveraging ecosystem\-led solutions, including working with hyperscalers, platform providers, and industrial technology partners to shape integrated, future\-ready offerings in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.

**In 12 Months**

**Skills And Experience**

* Proven ability to lead and motivate a team.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment, think strategically, and execute with precision.


**Measures Of Success – Strategic Impact**
 Platform understanding: Demonstrating strong understanding of platforms, proposing the relevant partnerships for the task
   

  

 Agility: Comfortable with use of AI tools to improve efficiency, create processes and augment proposals

 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment.  WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. description:
**Role Objective**

To drive Brillare's supply planning and logistics operations, ensuring the right products are available at the right place and time to support the company's rapid growth across channels and geographies.

The role will have a strong focus on demand and supply planning, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and delivery performance, while working closely with Production and Purchase teams to ensure seamless availability of finished goods.

The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on supply chain professional who can build robust planning processes, improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory, and ensure high service levels without excessive working capital or stock\-outs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Demand \& Supply Planning**

● Own the demand and supply planning process across SKUs, channels, and geographies.

● Translate sales forecasts, marketing campaigns, new product launches, and channel expansion plans into actionable production and procurement requirements.

● Build and strengthen the S\&OP process in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Production, and Purchase teams.

● Improve forecast accuracy and ensure optimal inventory availability across the network.

● Minimize stock\-outs, excess inventory, obsolescence, and working capital lock\-up.

**2\. Logistics, Warehousing \& Delivery Excellence**

● Own the movement of finished goods from manufacturing locations to warehouses, distributors, retail partners, and customers.

● Drive strong logistics and delivery performance across GT, MT, e\-commerce, quick commerce, EBOs, and other relevant channels.

● Ensure high levels of **OTIF (On\-Time In\-Full)** and service\-level excellence.

● Monitor and improve order fulfilment, dispatch planning, delivery timelines, freight costs, and logistics partner performance.

● Identify bottlenecks across warehousing and distribution and implement scalable solutions.

**3\. Inventory \& Working Capital Management**

● Maintain optimal inventory levels across raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods.

● Establish inventory norms and monitor ageing, slow\-moving, and obsolete inventory.

● Balance product availability with working capital efficiency.

● Build dashboards and MIS to provide visibility on stock availability, inventory health, forecast accuracy, and service levels.

**4\. Production Planning Coordination**

● Work closely with manufacturing teams to align production schedules with demand forecasts and inventory requirements.

● Understand production capacities, lead times, constraints, and batch economics to create realistic supply plans.

● Ensure adequate capacity planning for business growth, seasonal peaks, promotions, and new product launches.

● Proactively identify potential supply constraints and develop mitigation plans.

**5\. Purchase \& Procurement Coordination**

● Work closely with the Purchase team to ensure timely availability of raw materials and packaging materials.

● Understand procurement lead times, vendor dependencies, and material availability risks.

● Support supplier planning and ensure procurement schedules are aligned with production requirements.

● Help identify opportunities to improve material availability and reduce supply disruptions.

**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

● Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Production, Purchase, Finance, Quality, and R\&D teams.

● Support new product launches by ensuring material, production, inventory, and logistics readiness.

● Drive process improvements across planning, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.

● Build scalable systems and processes capable of supporting rapid business growth.

**Ideal Candidate ProfileExperience \& Background**

● 6–10 years in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain in:

○ FMCG

○ Personal Care

○ Beauty / Pharma / Consumer products

**● Strong experience in:**

○ Demand planning

○ Warehousing, logistics \& Delivery

● Exposure to new product launches is a strong plus

**Skills \& Attributes**

● Systems\-builder — can scale operations, not just run them

● Highly analytical, structured, and data\-driven

● Strong ownership mindset — treats factory, inventory \& cost as their own P\&L

● Comfortable in fast\-changing, high\-growth environments

● Calm, mature, and execution\-focused

**Educational \& Professional Credentials**

● IIT / NIT / Tier\-1 Engineering College preferred

● MBA / Operations specialisation is a plus

● Strong pedigree in MNC FMCG / high\-quality manufacturing setups

Pay: Up to ₹1,700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Clinical Application Specialist (Guj, MP & CH)
description:
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next\-generation, life\-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

The **Clinical Sales** role is responsible for driving Leica Biosystems’ Core Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry (IHC), and Digital Pathology growth through a strong combination of clinical application expertise and direct sales execution. The role will support customers across the assigned territory through technical consultation, product demonstrations, proof\-of\-principle activities, customer training, troubleshooting, and scientific engagement, while also carrying sales targets and contributing directly to opportunity creation, funnel progression, revenue conversion, and market share expansion.

  

This position reports to the **Regional Manager, West** and is part of the Sales/Commercial organization located in **Ahmedabad, India** and will be fully remote to cover the Westregion.

 **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Provide clinical application expertise across Core Histopathology, IHC, Digital Pathology, IVD, and RUO portfolios through customer training, troubleshooting, technical consultation, workflow optimization, and scientific discussions with pathologists, laboratory professionals, researchers, and key opinion leaders.
* Drive pre\-sales and post\-sales customer engagement by planning and executing product demonstrations, workshops, scientific meetings, academic programs, exhibitions, customer education initiatives, and Proof of Principle activities including evaluations, sampling programs, and customer validations.
* Carry and deliver assigned sales targets by identifying, creating, qualifying, and converting opportunities through direct customer engagement, while supporting business objectives, revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain a robust sales funnel, ensure accurate CRM opportunity tracking, prepare monthly activity reports, and document customer interactions, application support activities, follow\-up actions, and business outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with sales, marketing, channel partners, regional and global application teams, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues, gather market and competitive intelligence, strengthen customer relationships, and support strategic business decisions.

 **The essential requirements of the job include****:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pathology, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry, Pathology Applications, Clinical Diagnostics, Diagnostic Sales, or Technical Sales.
* Demonstrated knowledge of pathology workflows, antibody\-based assays, immunohistochemistry, companion diagnostic applications, and related cancer diagnostics workflows.
* Proficiency in customer\-facing application support, product demonstrations, technical troubleshooting, customer training, opportunity tracking, Microsoft Office applications, and CRM tools.
* Ability to travel 60–80% within the assigned territory and other geographies as business needs require.

 **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Experience working with pathology laboratories, cancer diagnostics, immunohistochemistry reagents, companion diagnostics, or primary antibodies.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing application specialist, product specialist, clinical sales specialist, technical sales, or diagnostic sales role.
* Exposure to distributor/channel partner management, territory development, market intelligence, and competitive analysis.

  

Leica Biosystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Performance Marketing Expert
description:
JOB TITLE: Performance Marketing Expert - Google Ads LOCATION: Pune-Hybrid (In-office every Wednesday) WORKING HOURS: 12:00 PM 9:00 PM IST EXPERIENCE: 8+ Years 
 ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a highly experienced Performance Marketing Expert Google Ads to own and drive paid acquisition and B2B lead generation initiatives end-to-end. This is a hands-on, independent role for a performance marketing professional who can take ownership of a significant advertising budget, target, and account with minimal supervision. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Google Ads, Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, GA4, and Google Tag Manager (GTM), along with strong capabilities in conversion tracking, attribution, and campaign optimization. The primary mandate is to generate a qualified pipeline from CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, VP Engineering, and other senior technology decision-makers at mid-market consumer companies, primarily in the US market. The role will be measured on MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and revenue impact, rather than clicks, impressions, or traffic alone. We are looking for a self-driven performance marketer who treats paid media like a business, continuously identifies opportunities for optimization, and can independently diagnose and solve campaign, tracking, and performance challenges. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 B2B Lead Generation & Paid Media Strategy Own the end-to-end paid search strategy for generating qualified B2B pipeline.
• Develop campaigns targeting CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, VP Engineering, and other technical/executive decision-makers.
• Build audience, keyword, targeting, and messaging strategies aligned with technical executive personas.
• Structure paid campaigns around the complete funnel: Awareness MQL SQL Opportunity Revenue.
• Develop targeting strategies using relevant firmographic attributes, job titles, company size, industry, intent signals, and geographic targeting.
• Continuously optimize targeting to improve lead quality and pipeline contribution, not simply lead volume.
• Work closely with Sales and RevOps teams to align on lead scoring, MQL/SQL definitions, lead quality, and sales hand-off criteria.
• Partner with Content and ABM teams to align paid campaigns, landing pages, messaging, and named-account strategies.
• Identify new paid acquisition opportunities and continuously test new approaches. 
 Google Ads Management Plan, build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, and YouTube.
• Own Google Ads account architecture, campaign structure, targeting, and budget allocation.
• Develop and manage comprehensive keyword strategies.
• Manage match types, negative keyword lists, search terms, Quality Score, ad relevance, and landing page relevance.
• Develop and test multiple ad variations and messaging approaches.
• Manage advanced bidding strategies including Target CPA, Target ROAS, Maximize Conversions, and other relevant automated bidding strategies.
• Monitor campaign and account health regularly.
• Analyze and troubleshoot changes in spend, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, Quality Score, and impression share.
• Manage budget pacing and reallocation across campaigns based on performance.
• Conduct structured A/B testing across ad copy, targeting, landing pages, bidding strategies, and campaign structures.
• Stay updated on Google Ads policy changes, platform updates, new features, and betas and proactively implement relevant opportunities. 
 GA4 & Conversion Tracking Own and maintain Google Analytics 4 (GA4) configuration for paid media measurement.
• Configure and manage events, conversion events, custom dimensions, custom metrics, audiences, funnels, and exploration reports.
• Implement and QA conversion tracking for form submissions, calls, website conversions, e-commerce actions where applicable, and offline conversions.
• Ensure accurate integration between Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM systems.
• Analyze user journeys and conversion paths to identify performance opportunities.
• Troubleshoot discrepancies between Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM data.
• Support attribution and measurement initiatives for multi-touch B2B sales journeys.
• Ensure paid media performance is measured against qualified business outcomes. 
 Google Tag Manager (GTM) & Tracking Infrastructure Independently configure and manage Google Tag Manager containers.
• Create and manage tags, triggers, variables, custom events, and conversion tracking.
• Define and maintain website data layer requirements.
• Work with developers to implement and validate tracking requirements.
• Use custom JavaScript/data layer variables where required.
• QA tracking implementations before and after website releases.
• Identify and resolve tracking gaps, broken tags, duplicate events, and attribution discrepancies.
• Maintain clean and reliable tracking infrastructure across the marketing funnel.
• Ensure data consistency between GTM GA4 Google Ads CRM. 
 Analytics, Attribution & Reporting Build and maintain performance dashboards using Looker Studio or similar reporting platforms.
• Connect and analyze Google Ads and GA4 data to provide a complete view of campaign performance.
• Track key metrics including MQLs, SQLs, MQL-to-SQL conversion, CPL, CPA, ROAS, pipeline contribution, and revenue.
• Implement appropriate UTM structures and campaign tracking standards.
• Analyze conversion paths and attribution across long, multi-touch B2B sales cycles.
• Identify discrepancies and data-quality issues across advertising, analytics, and CRM platforms.
• Translate complex campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.
• Provide regular performance reporting focused on business impact rather than vanity metrics. 
 Strategy, Optimization & Budget Management Translate business objectives into measurable paid media strategies.
• Develop campaign forecasts, budgets, and performance targets in collaboration with leadership.
• Monitor spend and optimize budget allocation based on lead quality and revenue potential.
• Identify underperforming campaigns, audiences, keywords, and creatives and take corrective action.
• Continuously test new keywords, audiences, ad messaging, landing pages, bidding strategies, campaign structures, and conversion approaches.
• Evaluate incrementality and attribution to understand the true contribution of paid search.
• Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining lead quality and commercial efficiency.
• Stay ahead of changes in paid search, measurement, privacy, and advertising technology. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Sales, RevOps, Content, Design, Web, ABM, and Marketing teams.
• Work with Sales to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting.
• Partner with Content and Design teams on ad creative and landing page optimization.
• Work with Web/Engineering teams on tracking, data layer, and conversion implementation.
• Collaborate with RevOps to establish reliable lead attribution and closed-loop reporting.
• Present performance insights and recommendations to leadership and business stakeholders. 
 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE: .
• 8+ years of hands-on experience in Google Ads / Paid Search / Performance Marketing. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Technology, or a related field.
• Proven track record of independently managing and optimizing large and complex Google Ads accounts.
• Deep expertise in Google Search Ads, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, keyword strategy, bid management, campaign architecture, and Quality Score optimization.
• Strong hands-on expertise with GA4, including event-based tracking, conversions, audiences, and reporting.
• Strong hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including tags, triggers, variables, data layers, and custom JavaScript variables.
• Strong understanding of conversion tracking and attribution.
• Experience connecting Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM systems.
• Strong understanding of UTM structures, funnel tracking, and lead attribution.
• Comfortable with spreadsheet-level data analysis, including formulas, pivot tables, and performance modelling.
• Experience with Looker Studio or similar dashboarding tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Proven experience with B2B lead generation, preferably targeting technical and executive personas.
• Experience with long, multi-touch B2B sales cycles and connecting paid media performance to MQL, SQL, pipeline, and revenue.
• Ability to independently own strategy, execution, optimization, reporting, and performance improvement. 
 SKILLS & COMPETENCIES: Expert-level Google Ads / Paid Search expertise.
• Strong B2B demand-generation mindset.
• Advanced campaign architecture and optimization capabilities.
• Strong GA4 & GTM expertise.
• Strong conversion tracking and attribution knowledge.
• Data-driven decision-making and analytical skills.
• Strong understanding of lead-generation funnels and revenue attribution.
• Advanced keyword research and targeting capabilities.
• Strong experimentation and A/B testing mindset.
• Strong budget management and forecasting skills.
• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to independently identify performance gaps and implement solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Highly self-driven and comfortable operating with minimal supervision.
• Strong commercial mindset with a focus on pipeline and revenue rather than vanity metrics.
• Curious and proactive about emerging Google Ads, analytics, tracking, and performance marketing trends. 
 NICE TO HAVE: Experience with Microsoft Ads (Bing), Meta Ads, or other paid media platforms.
• Experience with GTM Server-Side Tagging.
• Knowledge of Google Consent Mode and privacy-compliant tracking.
• Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms.
• Basic SQL or scripting knowledge for reporting and data analysis.
• Experience with offline conversion imports and CRM-based conversion optimization.
• Experience with ABM-led paid acquisition campaigns.
• Experience running campaigns focused on the US market.
• Experience targeting enterprise technology decision-makers. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs): MQLs: Qualified leads generated through Google Ads campaigns.
• SQLs: Sales-qualified leads generated through paid media.
• MQL-to-SQL Conversion: Quality and conversion efficiency of paid-generated leads.
• Pipeline Contribution: Revenue pipeline attributable to paid campaigns.
• Closed-Won Revenue: Revenue traceable to qualified leads generated through paid media.
• CPL / CPA: Cost efficiency tracked in the context of lead quality and revenue.
• ROAS: Return on advertising investment where applicable.
• Conversion Rate: Performance across key funnel stages.
• Tracking Accuracy: Reliability and consistency across GTM, GA4, Google Ads, and CRM.
• Budget Efficiency: Effective allocation and scaling of paid media investment.

description:
**Experience**: 0\-2 years. A live portfolio matters more than the years.

**Scope**: Excellent Publicity's own website and organic, local and AI\-search presence. No client servicing.

**Fixed CTC**: ₹3,00,000 \- ₹4,80,000 p.a. The band is wide because a portfolio moves it.

**Variable**: Performance bonus up to one month's fixed, annually, on organic and AI\-search enquiries

**One website. Your numbers. No client servicing.**

Own Excellent Publicity's organic and AI\-search presence end to end: one domain, direct tech access, and qualified enquiries as the outcome.

Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000\+ brands including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM\-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000\+ successful campaigns. We are an energetic young team of almost 100 people across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru \& Dubai, with a strong in\-house tech team building superlative AI\-powered products.

Buyers searching media costs, formats and agencies, or asking AI tools who to use, are high\-intent prospects. **Make Excellent Publicity visible and cited when those searches happen.** Every enquiry you capture routes straight to our sales pods.

**What you will actually do**

**SEO, the foundation**

* Own technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data and JavaScript rendering.
* Build keyword and content strategy around buyer intent: rates, costs, cities, media formats and "how do I advertise on X" queries.
* Scale programmatic SEO across media format and city pages with our in\-house tech team.
* Own on\-page SEO, internal linking, content briefs, digital PR and link acquisition.
* Own Google Business Profile: services, categories, posts and updates, photos, Q\&A, reviews and local\-search consistency.

**AEO \& GEO, where it is going**

* Get Excellent Publicity cited in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini for agency, cost and campaign\-planning queries.
* Track AI share of voice, and own our Knowledge Panel, entity and citation footprint, schema and source\-authority signals.
* Maintain credible participation on Reddit, Quora and relevant communities: answer buyer questions, join discussions, and publish and update useful posts that strengthen brand mentions, SEO and AI\-search citation potential.

**Reporting**

* Monthly GA4 and Search Console reporting focused on qualified enquiries from organic and AI search.

**Tools you will use**

Ahrefs · GSC · GA4 · Screaming Frog · Semrush · schema · Looker Studio · AI\-search tracking tools. Full stack paid for, plus a course and conference budget.

**Who we are looking for**

* **One live URL you have ranked,** plus a clear explanation of what you did.
* **You understand why pages rank** and can work comfortably with Search Console and spreadsheets.
* **You have experimented with AI search** and understand sources, entities, mentions and citations.
* **Clear written English** for briefs, answers, posts and content.
* **You want ownership of one domain** and results that compound over time.

**Bonus:** HTML and CSS, WordPress, Webflow or Next.js, automation, programmatic or affiliate SEO.

**Your first 90 days:**

**1st and 2nd Week \-**  Audit sites and search. Set technical, ranking, AI\-visibility and enquiry baselines.

**3rd \- 8th Week** \- Ship priority fixes, first programmatic pages, GBP improvements and the AEO and GEO baseline.

**9th \- 12th Week** \- Tie organic and AI search to qualified enquiries, and establish an ongoing content and community cadence.

**Where this goes**

Search Strategist, then Senior Search Strategist or SEO Lead, then Head of Organic Growth, owning inbound demand across SEO, AEO and GEO. AEO and GEO expertise is scarce enough right now that being early is a career advantage, and here you build it on our own asset, where the results are yours to point at.

**How to apply**

**Email chahal@excellentpublicity.com or WhatsApp \+917486031011\. Subject line: Search \- Ahmedabad**

**1\.** Your CV, plus one URL you have influenced the rankings of, and what you did.

**2\.** Spend ten minutes on excellentpublicity.com and tell us, in three or four lines, the first thing you would change and why.

The second one is what we will read first. Shortlisted candidates hear from us within 4 working days.

AEDEN FRUITS INTERNATIONAL PVT LTD

ABOUT AEDEN FRUITS INTERNATIONAL

Aeden Fruits International Pvt Ltd is a leading fruit and vegetable supplier operating across India. We are scaling our digital presence to reach modern retail, food service, and e\-commerce customers. Our Digital Marketing team is building content strategy around video, podcasts, social media, and thought leadership to establish Aeden as a trusted voice in the fresh produce industry.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Digital Marketing \& Content Creator Intern is a unique opportunity for someone passionate about content creation, storytelling, and the digital landscape — but unsure where to start professionally. You will work as the on\-camera talent and content contributor for Aeden's digital initiatives, including podcast hosting, video acting, product demonstrations, testimonials, and social media presence. This is a hands\-on learning role designed to build your portfolio while contributing to Aeden's brand growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESPodcast \& Audio Content

· Host Aeden's podcast series on agribusiness, supply chain, and fresh produce trends

· Conduct interviews with industry experts, farmers, and thought leaders

· Prepare talking points and research topics before recording

· Assist in podcast planning, scheduling, and distribution

· Participate in podcast editing and post\-production feedback

· Engage with listeners and build podcast community

Video Content \& On\-Camera Presence

· Act as on\-camera talent for Aeden marketing videos

· Host product demonstration videos (fruit varieties, quality, freshness)

· Create testimonial and educational videos for customers and stakeholders

· Participate in behind\-the\-scenes content and warehouse/farm tours

· Perform in social media videos, reels, and short\-form content

· Assist with video planning, scripting, and content ideation

Digital Content Production

· Support video shooting, recording, and production setup

· Collaborate with videographers and content producers

· Provide feedback on scripting, messaging, and creative direction

· Assist with content editing and post\-production reviews

· Participate in brainstorming sessions for content strategy

Social Media \& Community Engagement

· Feature in social media content (Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook)

· Engage with audience comments and community feedback

· Assist with social media content planning and scheduling

· Help build brand personality across digital channels

· Support live streaming and interactive digital events

Learning \& Skill Development

· Learn podcast production, editing, and distribution best practices

· Develop on\-camera presence, public speaking, and communication skills

· Understand digital marketing strategy and content planning

· Gain exposure to video production workflow and post\-production

· Build a personal portfolio of content work

· Receive mentorship from Digital Marketing team

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONSEducation

· Currently pursuing or recently completed Bachelor's degree (any stream); Communications, Media, Marketing, Journalism, or Entrepreneurship preferred but not mandatory

Skills \& Competencies

· Comfortable on camera and with public speaking (no prior acting/hosting experience required)

· Good communication skills with clear diction and articulation

· Basic understanding of social media and digital platforms

· Willingness to learn podcast production and video creation

· Proficiency in basic MS Office and Google Workspace

· Adaptability and comfort with trying new things

· Enthusiasm for content creation and storytelling

Personal Attributes

· Genuine interest in content creation and digital marketing (entry\-level okay)

· Open\-minded and eager to learn from experienced team members

· Reliable, punctual, and committed to assignments

· Collaborative and team\-oriented approach

· Willingness to be the "face" of Aeden's digital initiatives

· Comfortable with constructive feedback and iteration

· Passion for fresh produce, agriculture, or food industry (helpful but not required)

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

· Prior experience in content creation, blogging, or social media management

· Experience in public speaking, theater, debate, or media clubs

· Basic knowledge of video editing software (Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut)

· Familiarity with podcast platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, RSS feeds)

· Personal blog, YouTube channel, or social media presence (even if small)

· Graphic design or visual communication skills

· Interest in agribusiness, supply chain, or sustainability topics

WHAT YOU'LL GAIN FROM THIS INTERNSHIP

· Hands\-on experience in podcast hosting and production

· Real\-world video production and on\-camera talent experience

· Mentorship from experienced digital marketing and content professionals

· Portfolio pieces (podcast episodes, videos, social content) to showcase to future employers

· Understanding of content strategy, audience engagement, and digital marketing

· Exposure to agribusiness and supply chain communications

· Networking opportunities in the content creation and marketing space

· Potential for performance\-based extension to part\-time or full\-time role

· Certificate of completion and strong reference letter

· Foundational skills to launch a career in content creation, marketing, or media

INTERNSHIP TERMS \& CONDITIONSDuration \& Schedule

· Initial Duration: 3–6 months (flexible based on learning progression)

· Work days: Monday to Friday (6 hours per day) \+ occasional Saturday shoots/events

· Working hours: 10:00 AM – 4:30 PM (flexible for content production schedules)

· Production days may have flexible hours for shooting, podcasting, or events

Compensation \& Benefits

· Monthly stipend: ₹5,000–₹7,000 (disbursed monthly via bank transfer)

· Higher stipend offered based on prior experience or exceptional performance

· No health insurance, PF, or statutory benefits during internship

· Reimbursement: Local transportation costs covered for shoots/events

· Portfolio materials (videos, podcast episodes) provided at internship end

Expectations \& Conduct

· Interns are bound by Aeden's Code of Conduct, confidentiality policy, and brand guidelines

· Attendance and punctuality at scheduled shoots, podcasts, and meetings are mandatory

· Professional behavior on and off\-camera is expected (brand representative)

· Creative input and feedback are welcomed; willingness to take direction is essential

· Confidentiality: Do not share unreleased content or internal discussions publicly

· Use of Aeden's name/logo only with explicit approval from marketing team

· Any breach of conduct or guidelines may result in internship termination

Post\-Internship

· Performance evaluation at end of internship period

· Strong performers may be offered part\-time or full\-time role in marketing/content

· Certificate of completion, reference letter, and portfolio compilation provided

· Opportunity to remain as freelance content contributor (optional)

· No contractual obligation for either party beyond the internship period

WORKING CONDITIONS \& ENVIRONMENT

· Primary location: Aeden HQ, Kochi, with occasional on\-site shoots at warehouse/operations

· Work environment: Office\-based, studio/podcast recording space, and field shoots

· Content production: May involve early morning or evening shoots for specific campaigns

· On\-camera presence: Professional grooming and appearance expected during shoots

· Collaboration: Frequent interaction with videographers, editors, and marketing team

· Flexibility: Willingness to adapt to production schedules and creative direction

· Travel: Occasional local travel for on\-location shoots (within Kochi/Kerala region)

LEARNING ROADMAP

This internship is designed as a learning experience with structured progression:

· Month 1: Onboarding, podcast basics, on\-camera training, brand messaging

· Month 2–3: Lead podcast episodes, feature in multiple videos, build portfolio

· Month 4–6: Mentor junior content contributors, lead content strategy ideas, independent projects

APPLICATION PROCESS

1\. To apply:

1\. Submit a resume highlighting relevant background (education, prior content work, media club participation, etc.)

2\. Provide a brief cover letter (200–300 words) explaining why you're interested in content creation and why Aeden appeals to you

3\. Share links to your portfolio (personal blog, YouTube channel, Instagram, podcast, or any content work — even if small)

4\. Submit a 1–2 minute video introduction (casual, smartphone video is fine) talking about yourself and why you want this role

5\. Be prepared for a casual conversation about digital marketing, content creation, and your learning goals

Send applications to: Sam, HR Manager, Aeden Fruits International Pvt Ltd

Email: hr@aedenfruits.com

Pay: Up to ₹7,000\.00 per month
